tech_pk_cracker_desc: Uma alimentação direta de energia térmica superaquece a atmosfera e agita o núcleo do planeta, desencadeando eventos tectônicos desastrosos. Uma explosão concussiva final é lançada, rachando o planeta ao meio.
tech_habitat_1_desc: Permite a construção de Habitats Orbitais autossuficientes.
tech_habitat_2_desc: Nossos habitats iniciais eram primitivos comparados aos designs eficientes que agora podemos desenvolver.
tech_habitat_2_effect: Libera a Decisão Planetária: Aprimorar para Complexo de Habitat Expandido
tech_habitat_3_desc: Anos de melhorias aos nossos Habitats Orbitais nos levaram a criar novos designs mais eficazes.
tech_habitat_3_effect: Libera a Decisão Planetária: Aprimorar para Complexo de Habitat Avançado
tech_bio_reactor_desc:
Powered by biological material, the bio reactor is a relatively clean generator of energy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Power Plant.
tech_mine_volatile_motes_desc: Partículas Voláteis são partículas inconstantes que são difíceis de serem trabalhadas. Para poder extraí-las sem causar uma reação em cadeia de explosões, campos de energia devem ser usados para estabilizar as partículas.
tech_mine_exotic_gases_desc: Bolsões de Gases Exóticos são raros e geralmente inacessíveis por meios convencionais. Tais depósitos só podem ser alcançados usando tecnologia especial de extração.
tech_prescient_data_modeling_desc: Os poderes precognitivos de Numa estão em ação ou é apenas uma questão de habilidades manuais? De qualquer forma, este modelo de previsão da bolsa de valores galáctica fará a previsão das flutuações na economia com precisão divina.
tech_resort_colonies_desc: Com o estudo cuidadoso voltado ao paisagismo e à ciência da diversão, a construção de mundos inteiros dedicados ao lazer pode ser viabilizada.
tech_penal_colonies_desc: Através do desenvolvimento de mundos penais especiais, criminosos podem ser reabilitados através de trabalho honesto e duro. Alguns podem precisar de reabilitação permanente.
tech_slave_colonies_desc: Através da criação de mundos de geração de escravos, podemos garantir que sempre teremos um fornecimento fixo de trabalhadores descartáveis.
tech_destroyers_desc: Apesar de serem maiores que as Corvetas, as configurações de casco do Destróier ainda geram naves de ataque comparativamente ágeis.
tech_cruisers_desc: Originalmente desenvolvidos como uma configuração de casco para uma nave colonial experimental da próxima geração, os pontos rígidos amplos do projeto tornam-no ideal para carregar armamentos pesados.
tech_battleships_desc: O maior das naves militares padrão. Os Encouraçados são muito bem armados e possuem diversas baterias de fogo.
tech_titans_desc: Projetar naves desta escala permite uma combinação letal de poder de fogo excepcional e apoio auxiliar de ponta. Configurações do tipo Titã podem servir como capitânias muito versáteis e capazes de ajudar naves próximas ou capturar inimigos.
tech_starbase_1_desc: Uma base estelar é o ponto de apoio de um planeta no espaço, um centro para troca e comércio, assim como a base para naves militares e civis
tech_starbase_3_desc: Our engineering projects continue to grow, not only in scope, but in size as well. As a result we begin to better understand the design challenges on what we are constructing in space.
tech_starbase_4_desc: Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.
tech_starbase_5_desc: While buildings like space elevators and skyhooks have existed for some time in one form or another, now we can look into the application of these kind of mega structures on the government level. Either for transport or defence may these buildings serve as the pinnacle masterpieces of our constructions efforts.
tech_strike_craft_1_desc: Designed to operate with a base of operation close by, these transorbital fighters could be used to harass enemy ships.
tech_assault_armies_desc: When exploration turns to interstellar war, we require more people to defend our worlds and conquer those of our enemies. As these armies will be larger than any our civilisation has previously fielded, we need to revolutionise how we think about organising, training, supplying, and deploying them. The establishment of an 'Interplanetary Expeditionary Force' is the first step towards this goal.
tech_thrusters_1_desc: Nuclear fusion is the process of combining atoms to create larger atoms. When this occurs, energy is released. Thus, nuclear fusion reactors create incredibly hot plasma. This plasma has many uses. One such use is to expel it from a spacecraft, providing significantly more thrust than a chemical burn thruster. Miniaturising these thrusters allows them to be used in missiles and torpedoes.
tech_housing_1_desc: A capacidade de alterar os padrões climáticos de um planeta para suprimir fenômenos destrutivos facilitará a existência de residências e abrirá novas áreas para habitação.
tech_housing_2_desc: Com a tecnologia de gravidade direcional, construções na superfícies de planetas podem ser mais altas do que nunca sem arriscar o desabamento estrutural. O céu é o limite!
tech_housing_agrarian_idyll_desc: Através do estabelecimento de comunas rurais com clima controlado, conseguimos suportar uma população maior, sem atrapalhar nosso estilo de vida agrário.
tech_mechanized_mining_desc: A aplicação de engenharia mecânica a uma extração mineral é uma exigência fundamental para qualquer sociedade industrial.
tech_basic_industry_desc: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilisation.
tech_synthetic_leaders_desc: Equipados com uma personalidade, sintéticos finalmente serão capazes de interagir em termos iguais com o restante de nossos cidadãos. Algumas unidades podem até assumir papéis de liderança.
tech_robomodding_desc: Modelos de montagem regraváveis permitem a criação de projetos de robôs feitos sob medida.
tech_robomodding_m_desc: A padronização de modelos de montagem permite uma especialização aprimorada da população maquinária.
tech_space_construction_desc: Orbital satellites around a planetary body allow for a criss-crossing network that can cover the entire surface.
tech_mine_living_metal_desc: Extrair e processar os metais vivos é extremamente difícil, mas a aplicação bem sucedida de ligas mutáveis resulta em vantagens incomparáveis.
tech_mine_rare_crystals_desc: Extrair estes cristais sem danificá-los ou destruí-los, é um processo extremamente delicado. Isso requer um equipamento avançado capaz de ter precisão milimétrica.
tech_mega_engineering_desc: Para concluir os projetos de construção de escalas verdadeiramente assombrosas, primeiro devemos adquirir uma compreensão fundamental das necessidades de engenharia e armazenamento de recursos para tais megaestruturas.
tech_basic_science_lab_1_desc: Spintronic computers exploit the intrinsic spin of an electron as a further degree of freedom, allowing for an increase in data storage and transfer.
tech_synchronized_defences_desc: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.
tech_exotic_gases_desc: Gases Exóticos podem ser produzidos artificialmente, mas é um processo difícil que requer um processo de refino avançado.
tech_volatile_motes_desc: Além das preocupações científicas óbvias, a criação artificial de Partículas Voláteis é um processo extremamente delicado e complicado que requer equipamento altamente especializado.
tech_rare_crystals_desc: O processo de cristalização é complicado e difícil, mas cristais sintéticos podem ser fabricados usando usinas industriais especializadas.
tech_mine_dark_matter_desc: Esta substância exótica possui muitas propriedades que parecem desafiar as leis da física. Concentrações extraíveis só podem ser encontradas próximas a Buracos Negros ou em certas nebulosas.
tech_fission_power_desc: Nuclear fusion is a process where atomic nuclei and subatomic particles fuse together resulting in new atomic nuclei, particles and released energy. Fitting starships with fusion reactors will provide enough power for travel at low warp speeds and to power life support and a limited range of other systems.
tech_sensors_2_desc: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
tech_sensors_3_desc: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
tech_power_plant_1_desc: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy are one of the cornerstones for any modern civilisation.
tech_power_hub_1_desc: Geothermal power is power generated by geothermal energy. Technologies in use include dry steam power stations, flash steam power stations, and binary cycle power stations.
tech_wormhole_stabilization_desc: Um buraco de minhoca subespecial que ocorre naturalmente é algo instável, e seus níveis de energia flutuantes tipicamente impossibilitam uma viagem segura entre suas aberturas conectadas. Porém, há maneiras de estabilizar sua matriz temporariamente.
tech_industrial_farming_desc: Fazendas industriais de grande escala cultivando alimentos ricos em nutrientes permitem que uma civilização aumente seu crescimento populacional.
tech_mine_zro_desc: Um aerossol extremamente raro de partículas exóticas. Ele foi depositado em diversos mundos por meio de impactos de meteoro, mas sua origem verdadeira é um mistério. Se ingerido por indivíduoscom capacidades psiônicas, o Zro age como um poderoso (e viciante) fármaco que aumenta habilidades psíquicas.
tech_alien_life_studies_desc: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.
tech_colonization_1_desc: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand 'colony ships', confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to their new home.
tech_frontier_health_desc: The adaptation of healthcare to outer space and otherworldly bodies.
tech_mountain_range_desc: Com o advento das tecnologias de fusão limpa, automação e compressão de matéria, era só uma questão de tempo até a remoção de montanha se tornar remoção de cadeia montanhosa.
tech_volcano_desc: Avanços na tecnologia de material e nas técnicas de mineração profunda permitem a geo-engenharia em profundidades e temperaturas até então impensáveis. Bolsões de magma agora podem ser explorados, suprimidos ou até realocados.
tech_dangerous_wildlife_desc: Perturbação tática de habitats naturais combinada com padrões convergentes de busca e destruição podem eliminar de maneira eficaz a vida selvagem hostil em um intervalo de tempo muito curto.
tech_dense_jungle_desc: Catalogação minuciosa, e modelamento computadorizado de ecossistemas exobotânicos, junto com edição de genes e mecanismos de dispersão, nos permitirão remodelar as comunidades vegetais de acordo com nossa vontade.
tech_quicksand_basin_desc: O processo de deposição de solo normalmente leva milhões de anos. Com o fraturamento avançado, engenharia química e tecnologias de gerenciamento hidráulico, até mesmo o substrato mais pobre pode ser transformado em solo fértil.
tech_noxious_swamp_desc: Raças sapientes vêm conquistando de volta terras pantanosas há milhares de anos. Um sistema coordenado de aquedutos modulares, bombas hidráulicas, máquinas de remediação química e compactadores de solo automáticos podem conquistar de volta terras com velocidades sem precedentes.
tech_massive_glacier_desc: Sistemas orbitais de espelhos e sombras podem causar mudanças dramáticas nos climas planetários, quando usados de maneira apropriada.
tech_toxic_kelp_desc: Com poder de processamento suficiente, sensores de rede e estações distribuidoras, até mesmo as correntes oceânicas podem ser gerenciadas a um bom nível de controle.
tech_deep_sinkhole_desc: Muitos planetas possuem vazios extensos abaixo da superfície. Técnicas de exploração e construção subterrâneas podem aumentar bastante a área habitável de alguns mundos.
tech_space_trading_desc: Our economy is thriving, but there are ways to make it prosper even more. Let us further those gains by investing into a building that can only help grow our prosperity by allowing an influx of new goods to trade with other empires and our colonies within our borders.
tech_ecological_adaptation_desc: While expanding our reach to strange new worlds, we have colonized several planets which are near unlivable for our peoples. Now we can modify the atmospheres of these planets to make them more habitable, so our citizens can thrive.
tech_climate_restoration_desc: Ao avançar nosso conhecimento sobre transformação atmosférica, conseguiremos terraformar até os mundos mais devastados ecologicamente.
tech_epigenetic_triggers_desc: Advanced DNA methylation techniques allow for functionally significant alterations to be made to arbitrary genomes.
tech_gene_tailoring_desc: No longer will we be limited by the basic biological structure of our species when striving to improve them. However, doing this can come at a great cost of our own individuality, is it truly worth considering going down this path?
tech_selected_lineages_desc: Um planejamento reprodutivo cuidadoso deve ser incentivado, caso contrário estamos jogando fora legados genéticos valiosos.
tech_capacity_boosters_desc: Não deixamos nada para o acaso, não importa o custo. Através do gerenciamento exato de bancos de DNA construiremos os líderes do amanhã.
tech_interstellar_fleet_traditions_desc: A body of knowledge regarding combat behaviors is useless without a strong code governing its use.
tech_command_matrix_desc: The SDI project is our proposed strategy to deal with the realities of space travel and the potential for combat with alien races.
tech_ground_defense_planning_desc: Há muitos impérios alienígenas que adorariam tomar nossos mundos para si próprios. Precisamos estar preparados para eles, caso o pior aconteça.
tech_psionic_theory_desc: A mente é de muitas formas um reflexo do universo em si, um microcosmo. Nem todos os seres vivos poderão chegar até esse nível de conhecimento, mas suas mentes são ferramentas maiores que qualquer outra.
tech_telepathy_desc: The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. All species may not reach this insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.
tech_xeno_diplomacy_desc: Communications with alien lifeforms without mutual understanding of the cultures or historical background is a recipe for disaster. By researching possible first contact scenarios, we can at least issue formal instructions on first contact and diplomatic procedures.
tech_interstellar_campaigns_desc: The logistics of interstellar war require a good deal of planning to take place before we lay claim to any territory or make any demand on our adversaries. A massive quantity of statistical data has been compiled to aid in that planning phase, with the result that we can reliably expect more of our desires to be enforced in any given conflict.
tech_galactic_campaigns_desc: Conflict between vast space empires has been a fact of life for long enough for the development of an entire academic field devoted specifically to the study of interstellar warfare. With this new generation of top-tier experts on hand as advisors, we can be assured of even more efficiency in planning and carrying out our military campaigns.
tech_planetary_government_desc: Proper regulation of our industries and processes will lead to better planetary yields on all fronts, lest we drown ourselves in our own red tape.
tech_cloak_combat_effect: Crews are trained to use the cloaking device to ambush foes, resulting in a brief period of increased damage, fire rate & evasion whilst our opposition tries to understand what has hit it.
tech_cloak_defensive_effect: Training for our crews to take full advantage of our ability to cloak our ships, allowing them to move faster whilst cloaked.
tech_advanced_warheads_desc: The initial forays into space weaponry showcase the requirement for new guided warheads to be designed.
tech_andorian_phaser_1_desc: Accurate and reasonably powerful nadion particle beams. While most phasers appear yellow or orange, the higher frequencies used by Andorian phaser nadion emitters cause a stylishly blue output.
tech_antiproton_cannon_1_desc: Firing bursts of anti-protons, these cannons are capable of partially dissolving their target at a subatomic level. Energy released from the annihilation of the targets protons by the anti-protons causes a heating effect, pushing the remaining particles apart causing further damage.
tech_artificial_gravity_desc: Low gravity environments make our lives much too difficult. Some ships have tried to use centrifugal forces generated by spinning ship segments to simulate gravity. This is moderately effective but wildly complicates starship design. By pooling everything we've learnt about gravity thus far, it's hoped that a much simpler way of generating a gravity field will soon be found.
tech_arxolite_corruption_1_desc: The Arxolite Corruption, which works by changing the internal structure of the victim's crystalline chemistry leading to death, is a highly complex disease. We have learnt enough about it to be able to research a treatment to slow it down, if not cure it.
tech_arxolite_corruption_2_desc: A cure for Arxolite Corruption can now be developed. Utilising modified cortical inhibitors to corner the disease before eradication, we can also cure the remaining infected population.
tech_assimilation_1_desc: The dispersal of airborne nanites into the atmosphere of a planet or ship would be an optimal method of assimilating large areas without the need for a full nanite injection. Research is required into the self-replication abilities and survivability of the nanites in a hostile environment.
tech_assimilation_2_desc: Atmospheric dispersion showed that assimilation could easily take place over a large scale; however, many imperfect beings we have encountered tend to centralise their populations in large areas known as 'cities'. A rapid nanite dispersal carpeting the entirety of these population structures would increase the rate of assimilation.
tech_astrometrics_labs_desc: With Astrometrics, we can now begin to focus our research into three specialties, physics, biology, and engineering. We will need new labs for each of these different lines of research.
tech_automated_exploring_borg_desc: The translation of exploration missions into calculable algorithms enables vessels to discover new systems by themselves and bring back data of previously unknown systems.
tech_automated_exploring_desc: Newly developed protocols allow our science ships and crews to identify and choose their own paths of exploration out amongst the stars, without the need for constant orders from command.
tech_automated_units_desc: Placing autonomous units' processing nodes into a large network creates a small artificial intelligence network that can be used within our vessels.
tech_black_ops_desc: Thinking outside the box has often provided some of the most beneficial technologies in our existence. The creation of an entire research programme dedicated to those who are known to discover unique solutions to problems will increase the likelihood that we can research these rarer technologies.
tech_borg_defense_desc: Modulating the deflector field to minimise resistance could allow for an adaptive deflector field.
tech_borg_hull_desc: Most species would consider metal incapable of being alive; however, we are not so small minded. By using nanoprobes and matter-energy conversion technology, we can tend to our metal hulls in the same way than an organic body tends to its skin. With some further experimentation we can refine the implementation of this technology.
tech_borg_queen_chamber_desc: Creation of a new protocol for a Borg Queen will allow this high functioning Borg to focus the drones and bring order to chaos.
tech_borg_thruster_desc: Our vessels hull designs are based on simple geometric shapes. They have multiple axis of symmetry, no real front or back. It would be inefficient to limit ourselves to a single direction of motion as most species do, we are capable of more. Thrusters exhaust ports can be mounted on each hull surface and feed by a decentralised network of impulse plasma generator nodes.
tech_borghel_prey_desc: Glory should not be shared so easily, and our vessels should exemplify that. Small, yet powerful, vessels should allow our warriors to test their honour and seek glory for the Empire.
tech_bureau_colonial_desc: Colonies all have different needs at differing levels of development. Researching the colonisation process allows for any bottlenecks in colonisation to be fixed and the process to be smoothed out.
tech_cardassian_phaser_1_desc: Unique type of phaser which seeks to maximise destructive efficiency and minimise wear on the nadion emitter. The phaser beam oscillates slightly, aiming to introduce a disruptive interference pattern in the strong and weak nuclear forces between two locations. When successful, a larger area loses atomic cohesion than would be possible with a standard phaser.
tech_centauran_flu_1_desc: The Centauran Flu, which kills its victims due to extreme lethargy, can now be treated with new stimulants to slow down the disease.
tech_centauran_flu_2_desc: A vaccine to immunise the remaining population against the Centauran Flu can now be developed. Utilising cellular regeneration and entertainment chambers, we can also cure the remaining population with the flu.
tech_civilian_infrastructure_desc: Research into improvements for civilian infrastructure is of vital importance to a growing empire. The more civilian population behind our efforts, the more rapid our expansion and exploitation of resources can be.
tech_cloak_combat_desc: Just like how a predatory creature uses stealth to ambush its prey, our ships can move faster and cause more damage when using the cloak as a weapon.
tech_cloak_defensive_desc: Training for our crews to take full advantage of our ability to cloak our ships.
tech_colonize_y_class_desc: The temperatures of Tholia are ideal for the crystalline bodies of the Tholian, one that can only be matched by Demon class planets.
tech_cortical_processing_desc: The Collective gathers a vast amount of information. We need a way to better assimilate and disseminate this data. Combining our advanced knowledge of computational systems with our cyborg nature, we should be able to create a type of cortical processing subunit. Each unit will be responsible for sorting and distributing data to the drones aboard a vessel or unicomplex.
tech_cross_breeding_desc: The strands of DNA between two species may allow for cross-breeding of each race, as long as simple medical procedures are undertaken to ensure both parents' genes bond correctly.
tech_cutting_beam_1_desc: Our current generation of weapons are cumbersome, power hungry and destructive. They are imperfect. A new weapon has been devised, a high-powered laser cutting beam, that may destroy a target with ease but also allows us to dissect them for easier assimilation.
tech_darsay_history: The Secret History of the D'Arsay
tech_darsay_history_desc: After years of research, the D'Arsay Archive has revealed to us the secrets of its progenitor society.
tech_deassimilate_1_desc: Research into the reprogramming of the nanites inside assimilated drones allows us to to slowly return these Borg to the correct ethos.
tech_defense_army_desc: There may come a time when other races regard our worlds with great envy, and draw plans to attack us. We must be ready.
tech_deflector_field_desc: Travelling at high speeds across the quadrant has its own navigational problems from micrometeoroids and other small debris that would destroy a small vessel at a high enough velocity. The deflector dish projects a field to push these particles out of the way of a vessel, and can be adapted for minor defensive purposes.
tech_disruptor_cannon_1_desc: Disruptor cannons rapidly fire weak energy discharges to vaporize their target. Although they lack accuracy, the low energy of each shot reduces the damage lost with a miss. This means that they have a higher potential damage output than some of the more accurate weapon systems.
tech_disruptor_klingon_cannon_1_desc: Powerful disruptors which use tetryons to rip apart the atomic structure of the target. The discovery of tetryons, a subatomic particle that is only stable in subspace, is a recent occurrence. We anticipate that further investigation will lead us to designs for more potent designs.
tech_early_photonic_desc: Early photonic torpedoes are the next step in antimatter warhead torpedo designs. They feature a more potent warhead than spatial torpedoes, and launch speeds can be increased due to lower mass requirements.
tech_emergency_backup_desc: When main systems go down it can often prove fatal for those onboard. Emergency systems can be introduced to give a window of opportunity to restore the main systems and provide security for those onboard.
tech_emette_frigate_desc: The initial Warp Delta designs call for a triangular hull with two warp nacelles situated above the hull. Major research and development is required to undertake these first steps into the unknown.
tech_engineering_02838_desc: Improvements upon the cheaper frontline destroyers will allow them to be quickly produced whilst maintaining the newest and most up to date technology. Maintenance costs remain high; however, the offensive capacity outweighs the size.
tech_engineering_02839_desc: Improvements upon the cheaper frontline destroyers will allow them to be quickly produced whilst maintaining the newest and most up to date technology. Maintenance costs remain high; however, the offensive capacity outweighs the size.
tech_engineering_02840_desc: Improvements upon the cheaper frontline destroyers will allow them to be quickly produced whilst maintaining the newest and most up to date technology. Maintenance costs remain high; however, the offensive capacity outweighs the size.
tech_engineering_02843_desc: Advances in construction technology allow our Cruisers to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard.
tech_engineering_02844_desc: Advances in construction technology allow our Cruisers to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard.
tech_engineering_02845_desc: Advances in construction technology allow our Cruisers to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard.
tech_engineering_02848_desc: Advances in construction technology allow our Battlecruisers to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain relatively fragile whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02849_desc: Advances in construction technology allow our Battlecruisers to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain relatively fragile whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02850_desc: Advances in construction technology allow our Battlecruisers to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain relatively fragile whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02853_desc: Advances in construction technology allows our Battleships to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain slow, but heavily armoured, whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02853a_desc: Advances in construction technology allows our Battleships to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain slow, but heavily armoured, whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02854_desc: Advances in construction technology allows our Battleships to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain slow, but heavily armoured, whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02855_desc: Advances in construction technology allows our Battleships to be built with more redundancy and with the most up to date technology onboard. They remain slow, but heavily armoured, whilst packing a large array of offensive weaponry.
tech_engineering_02858_desc: The construction of the heavy raider prototype has allowed advances with the construction methods used to create advanced heavy raiders.
tech_engineering_02859_desc: The construction of the heavy raider prototype has allowed advances with the construction methods used to create advanced heavy raiders.
tech_engineering_02860_desc: The construction of the heavy raider prototype has allowed advances with the construction methods used to create advanced heavy raiders.
tech_engineering_02864_desc: Adaptation of our living vessels to non-fluidic space allows larger and more potent designs to be created to ensure incursions into fluidic space are stopped.
tech_engineering_02865_desc: Once at home amongst fluidic space, we now have a new home amongst the solid and vast darkness of this universe. The pinnacle of our biovessel design adapted fully to this universe begins here.
tech_engineering_02891_desc: Efficient usage of limited resources results in a small, flexible, expendable package designed to seek out new resources for the Collective. Extolling the nature of the Collective where no individual is worth more than the whole.
tech_engineering_02892_desc: Congruent sturdy shapes form the pinnacle of the Borg. The triangle being the strongest shape when pressed upon its apex. Strong angular forms allow for armoured sides, and sharp corners allow for extended weaponry.
tech_engineering_02920_desc: The continued expansion of our starbases across the stars requires abundant resources and research to ensure our empire can maintain its control over large distances.
tech_engineering_02924_desc: Designed to operate with a base of operation close by, these transorbital fighters could be used to harass enemy ships.
tech_engineering_02925_desc: Hidden hangars could be located across our planets containing sub orbital fighters that are capable of engaging invading troops.
tech_engineering_02926_desc: Advances in fighter technology mean that the next step is well equipped for both dogfighting and anti-capital operations, dedicated fighters that can pack a punch.
tech_engineering_02927_desc: Research has been undertaken to design small strikecraft that can take on small starships by themselves, or provide a serious deterrent to larger starships.
tech_engineering_02931_desc: The simple, but effective, conical design of the Cone is ideal for a rapid scout vessel. Its hardened outer shell can be outfitted with multi-specialist systems that can easily be rotated into place.
tech_engineering_03116_desc: Built from miniaturised assembly segments, to form a flexible, compound impulse assembly, this multi vector thruster manifold provides omni-directional thrust.
tech_engineering_03117_desc: Dedicated matter-antimatter reactors power the omni-directional impulse field. These small reactors will feed the impulse engines with warp plasma, which is usually reserved for energising the warp coils.
tech_engineering_03119_desc: The ancient ways of forging weapons have been rediscovered, which created weapons far beyond their time in the past. By researching ways to apply modern technology to our techniques, we can produce some of the finest weaponry the galaxy has ever seen.
tech_engineering_03211_desc: Kemocite is a mineral that is a multiphasic isotope of a radiolytic compound. Its highly unstable nature requires unique containment protocols be developed for usage in warheads.
tech_engineering_03212_desc: Early torpedo research has led us down the path of an Anicium torpedo. Projections suggest that combining Anicium and a Yurium catalyst will yield an explosive so powerful that it could even disrupt subspace rifts.
tech_engineering_03213_desc: Bilitrium is a rare, crystalline element that can be an incredibly powerful source of energy when combined with an antimatter converter. The development of antimatter breeders and containment chambers for the two unmixed components is of vital importance.
tech_engineering_03214_desc: Chemical synthesis has led to the creation of a compound named trilithium, an explosive of great power. Acting as an inhibitor of nuclear reactions, such as the fusion processes within the interior of stars, even a small amount of trilithium is potentially enough to halt fusion in a star, resulting in a quantum implosion. This raw power in torpedo form will be a deadly addition to our arsenal.
tech_engineering_03224_desc: Spatial charges (or subspatial charges, when fired into subspace) are variable-yield explosive devices. Their variable yield means that mining charges can be quite easily jury-rigged into military grade explosives.
tech_engineering_03225_desc: The rapid transferal of kinetic energy into thermal energy is quite well understood, but with the advent of superluminal travel and combat the previous generation has been severely lacking. Improvements to our warheads can utilise the kinetic energy of an impact to further improve yield.
tech_engineering_03226_desc: Part of the problem of early torpedoes is the redirection of much of the blast away from the target. The advent of new directed charges can utilise that energy and push it towards the target, rather than away.
tech_engineering_03227_desc: Nucleonic particles are substances found within polaric fields. They are composed of highly charged particles, primarily ferric ions, as well as other unidentifiable elements. They are also extremely magnetic, causing them to be drawn and adhere to metal surfaces. By utilising them within our warheads, we can ensure the charges more easily track the hulls of enemy vessels.
tech_engineering_03503_desc: Lessons learnt over the past few years of space flight have allowed designers to create the idea for a larger, more robust starship - a light cruiser.
tech_engineering_03504_desc: The NX Project, also known as the NX Program or NX Test Program, is Starfleet's effort to develop a starship using the engine designed by the Warp Five program.
tech_engineering_03505_desc: The results from the NX programme offer some insight into our next step, including the latest technologies in refitting our starships.
tech_engineering_03506_desc: Expeditions into the depths of space can require anything from a battlecruiser to a research laboratory. Our initial forays into this have resulted in a potential design for a multi-mission vessel, capable of undertaking numerous types of mission by itself.
tech_engineering_03507_desc: As technologies progress and new hull materials become available, our vessels need to be able to travel deeper into outer space than ever before. A new light cruiser design would get us there.
tech_engineering_03508_desc: Advancements to the multi-mission cruiser require new hulls to accommodate the new technology. One such prototype is a potential future workhorse of the fleet.
tech_engineering_03509_desc: Dangers of deep space continue to become more common, and ship construction techniques have improved enough for designers to come up with the first heavy cruiser design.
tech_engineering_03510_desc: Further enhancements to cruiser technology have led to multiple options for the fleet, including unique options for some extreme science.
tech_engineering_03512_desc: The first decades of space travel have shown what works and what doesn't. The development of new hull materials has resulted in the potential for new vessels, much more potent than the previous generation.
tech_engineering_03513_desc: The advent of duotronic computers allows for the construction of larger vessels, automated enough that the crew can still be manageable. The heavy cruiser Constitution design is ideal for the nascent five-year mission plan.
tech_engineering_03514_desc: The five-year mission programmes have offered unique insights into the shortcomings of our fleet, whilst operating away from regular supply. Technologies to rectify the shortcomings and bolster the positives can be put into place for the next generation of starships.
tech_engineering_03515_desc: The largest pitfall to our current technology is the mismatch of previous generation vessels attempting to run the latest technology. A refit programme which will modernise the fleet could be undertaken, as well as potentially creating a newer, more modern cruiser.
tech_engineering_03516_desc: After the recent conflicts across the galaxy, we are in an arms race to ensure we can maintain our sovereignty. The creation of new ship types where exploration is no longer the primary objective allows for new designs to come to the forefront.
tech_engineering_03517_desc: The exploration cruiser is a starship classification term used to describe a type of cruiser starship designed for exploration, and to operate entirely independently from starbase supply. These are larger vessels, outfitted to be capable of holding their own in the unknown.
tech_engineering_03518_desc: The Galaxy Class Starship Development Project is the project responsible for the development of a new type of vessel for Starfleet. The Galaxy class is designed to be one of the most powerful and capable starships of its generation, with a crew complement of over a thousand and the multi-mission capability to act as a central hub for a fleet of smaller starships.
tech_engineering_03520_desc: Our design philosophy has never been war first, each of our starships has always had a multi-mission role in mind. With the dangers in the galaxy at present however, the board has a design for a vessel class devoted entirely to weapons and armour - the Defiant.
tech_engineering_03524_desc: Experimental technologies and future proofing are the order of the day here. New technologies require new testbed designs in order to test them for maximum effectiveness.
tech_engineering_03525_desc: Improvements to our exploration cruisers have allowed us to design a prototype for a new class of Exploration Cruiser.
tech_engineering_03526_desc: Improvements from the field, and technological progress, have allowed us to work on an improved prototype for the Heavy Escort.

tech_engineering_03602_desc: The Great Houses clamour for a new vessel capable of scouting out enemy defences and systems, to find targets for glorious battle!
tech_engineering_03603_desc: The requirement for a new powerful, yet flexible, design utilising the latest weapons technologies grows within the Empire, and our military has drawn up plans for a new vessel based on the older D4 models.
tech_engineering_03604_desc: The plans have been laid down on the drawing boards for a larger and more potent type of vessel known as a raider. This is codenamed the D6 project.
tech_engineering_03605_desc: Further advances by our neighbouring races require a vessel capable of leading other vessels into battle. Codenamed the D7 project, this battlecruiser should strike fear into our enemies.
tech_engineering_03606_desc: The Great Houses have begun to fight amongst themselves to determine what makes our battlecruisers strong. The creation of a prototype will allow the Empire to choose a specialisation.
tech_engineering_03607_desc: Rapid manufacturing of powerful vessels for our warriors to gain glory in are the most popular designs that the Great Houses desire.
tech_engineering_03608_desc: Designed to take on fleets of enemy vessels, our warships shall be the strongest vessels in our navy.
tech_engineering_03609_desc: The Great Houses bicker and shout over what should go into the new advanced raider prototypes. The creation of a prototype will allow the Empire to choose a specialisation.
tech_engineering_03610_desc: In order to project Klingon power across the quadrant, larger vessels are required. The Vor'Cha project is a unique new design larger than any previous, outfitted with devastating weaponry.
tech_engineering_03611_desc: In order to secure our power, the Empire should have its own vessels, more powerful than any of the Great Houses. Research should be conducted into ensuring this vessel is the keystone of our Empire.
tech_engineering_03612_desc: With the advent of new vessels from other races, we require a vessel filled with powerful weaponry. A true symbol of Klingon might - a true Fist of Kahless!
tech_engineering_03613_desc: The Great Houses continue to fight amongst themselves to determine which strength should be amplified in our warships. The creation of a prototype will allow the Empire to choose a specialisation.
tech_engineering_03614_desc: We have learnt many lessons about the shortcomings of our Raptor design from the fires of glorious battle. We should put some of these lessons into practice.

tech_engineering_03654_desc: Designed to wage war, these larger vessels are capable of fighting one on one with our enemies' heavy cruisers.
tech_engineering_03655_desc: For exploration further from our borders, a new designe entitled 'Starbird' has been placed onto the drawing board.
tech_engineering_03656_desc: Improvements to our warbird designs after field testing should now be possible.

tech_engineering_03661_desc: Improving the survivability of our Bird-of-Prey designs should enable them to take on smaller enemy vessels easily.
tech_engineering_03662_desc: Utilising a forced quantum singularity and the most advanced cloaking device, the D'Deridex is designed to be one of the most advanced vessels within the Alpha Quadrant.
tech_engineering_03663_desc: The designs of the Reman slaves offer a sturdier, yet still frightening, amount of power. Incorporating their principles into our own could be beneficial.
tech_engineering_03664_desc: The Romulan Star Empire cannot fall behind our neighbours. The Sword class shall be the pinnacle of our ship design, a massive warship capable of destroying lesser fleets single handedly.
tech_engineering_03665_desc: A rapid and dangerous interceptor craft has been placed onto the drawing board. This vessel should be the pinnacle of our interceptor technology.

tech_engineering_12200_desc: Our engineers continue to come up with new and exciting designs, that are ready to take shape outside of our solar system. We should continue to expand upon these projects to offworld areas, as the more we build, the more we learn.
tech_engineering_12201_desc: An antimatter weapon was a device using antimatter as a power source, as a propellant, or as an explosive, in the case of the theoretical photon torpedo.
tech_engineering_12202_desc: A plasma weapon is a type of direct energy particle weapon that used plasma as a means of inflicting damage to the target.
tech_engineering_12352_desc: The Excelsior has served as the premier vessel of the line and then the workhorse for Starfleet for many years, this project aims to introduce the next generation of Excelsior-influenced designs, the exciting Excelsior II and Obena Classes.
tech_engineering_12353_desc: Fueled by recent defeats Starfleet has begun to look at new technology to redesign its aging ships using a brand new aesthetic.
tech_engineering_12354_desc: Prototypes using the most advanced ship building methodology have been delivered from Jupiter Station, and our scientists will work to perfect the design.
tech_engineering_12355_desc: It became clear that specialised class of ship was needed to carry Starfleet fighters into the battle area. While classes like the Akira and Curry were modifications of existing classes and capable of carrying fighters, Starfleet Command also wanted an all new dedicated class to carry fighters along with the battle fleet.
tech_engineering_12508_desc: Heavy modular vessels capable of withstanding a large amount of punishment are on the drawing boards, allowing for the creation of the Ares class and a smaller, more flexible vessel known as the Miranda.
tech_engineering_12805_desc: The largest and most powerful vessels that we estimate to be used within our arsenal will require a much more complex and advanced shipyard.
tech_engineering_12811_desc: Privately-owned trading stations offer the ability for private citizens from across the galaxy to meet and trade with each other.
tech_engineering_12821_desc: State-of-the-art orbital construction techniques result in starships of unrivaled capabilities and spaceports the size of major planetside cities.
tech_engineering_12824_desc: The advances in construction techniques allows for massive installations and vessels that are like cities floating in space. They can support a crew of thousands and are often equipped with firepower rivaling that of a fleet.
tech_engineering_12827_desc: Plans for immense starships and starbases capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up.
tech_engineering_12836_desc: The manufacturing requirements for objects of the size and reliability needed for large scale space projects will require research.
tech_engineering_12846_desc: Avanços em tecnologia de construção permitem com que nossas estações sejam construídas com mais redundância e com a tecnologia mais moderna abordo.
tech_engineering_12885_desc: The sublight navigational hazards of objects and other spacecraft in inhabited systems often require traffic control.
tech_engineering_12887_desc: Prefabricated offsite construction allows for improved station engineering.
tech_engineering_12900_desc: Designed to offer full targeting capabilities across a wide spectrum, the defense grid is a powerful deterrent.
tech_engineering_12901_desc: Creation of static defenses that do not travel with the currents of fluidic space has been a challenge. A potential solution is a breached anchor, ensuring the defences remain static.
tech_engineering_12902_desc: Omega is perfection. The sheer power of this particle means that a single stable molecule is capable of generating the same power output as a warp core.
tech_engineering_12903_desc: Utilising advances in boronite production and the stabilisation of Omega particles, the Collective's vessels can be upgraded with new Omega designs.
tech_engineering_12904_desc: Utilising advances in boronite production and the stabilisation of Omega particles, the Collective's vessels can be upgraded with new Omega designs.

tech_engineering_12914_desc: The modular nature of the Cell ships allows for the joining of many vessels into one. For more static structures, we should investigate reinforcing the interlocks to ensure full structural integrity.
tech_engineering_12915_desc: The shifting nature of the Helix has many external pressures and forces thrust against it, requiring new algorithms to manage the power flow across large amounts of modular cell ships.
tech_engineering_12916_desc: As the Helix grows, new designs are required in order to ensure structural integrity of the whole is kept strong.
tech_engineering_12917_desc: The optimisation of all systems within the Helix allows it to grow to an extremely large size.
tech_engineering_13001_desc: The ability to automate the mining process of simple rocks, such as asteroids, should be possible now with improved automation.
tech_engineering_13013_desc: Exotic matter covers a range of very rare resources which can be utilised for their unique properties.
tech_engineering_13025_desc: High-energy particle weaponry employs subatomic power. This technology bends the quantum forces that govern the very fabric of the universe, manipulating their innate characteristics to sear through matter. Unseen energy on a quantum level transforms into a destructive force on a grand scale.
tech_engineering_13027_desc: The reamplification of used dilithium crystals may be possible to reenergise them.
tech_engineering_13029_desc: Initial tests into utilising gamma radiation to power up the dilithium crystalline matrix show promising results.
tech_engineering_13038_desc: It's like crystal mining, but not.
tech_engineering_13041_desc: The application of planetary industrial base requires further research into how the logistical challenge of combining an entire worlds industrial output into one entity.
tech_engineering_13042_desc: Automation of construction allows for a massive amount of industrial output with a limited population.
tech_engineering_13043_desc: Dedicated replication platforms allow for more complex machinery to simply be replicated rather than fabricated.
tech_engineering_13044_desc: The industrial hive is a foundry where each manufacturing plant is located in order to minimise downtime due to transportation of goods.
tech_engineering_13045_desc: Machinery that can adapt and adjust to changes in manufacturing output.
tech_engineering_13046_desc: Smaller nanite assemblers can be utilised in order to produce nanites which can produce complex machinery.
tech_engineering_13047_desc: A motivator or a motivator unit is a device that was primarily used to convert other forms of energy such as chemical or electrical energy into kinetic or mechanical energy.
tech_engineering_13048_desc: An entire world dedicated to the production of material.
tech_engineering_13073_desc: The continued expansion of the Collective's starbases across the stars requires abundant resources and research to ensure the Collective can maintain its cohesion and control over large distances.
tech_engineering_13076_desc: Magnesite is a form of magnesium carbonate and is known to be a readily available material for hull production.
tech_engineering_13077_desc: Energy usage throughout the transwarp matrix is constantly utilised with a high throughput, allowing for improved calculations and processing. By allowing energy matrices to transfer information at transwarp velocities, we can increase the overall energy throughput and storage.
tech_engineering_13078_desc: New asteroid tunneling methods allow for upgrades to our asteroid bases.
tech_engineering_13082_desc: Layering honeycomb structures and additional bulkheads throughout our vessels provides increased survivability in the event the hull is breached.
tech_engineering_13083_desc: By utilising easily replaceable sections, we can create a modular hull design where sections can be replaced to suit the vessel's current mission. Whilst not as strong as other designs, it is the most cost-effective way to design a vessel.
tech_engineering_13089_desc: Kelindide arranged into a honeycombed pattern can disperse energy across the armoured hull.
tech_engineering_13090_desc: Layered armour plates that counteract weapon attacks are part of the new kelindide range of hull armour.
tech_engineering_13097_desc: The creation of a hull that is simply non-reactive to energy bursts is a very cost-effective way of providing protection for a vessel.
tech_engineering_13098_desc: Polyduranide is a metallic material used for construction purposes. It is cheap and easy to mass produce via machinery but tough to replicate.
tech_engineering_13099_desc: An unreactive plasticised mesh covering for the hull of our vessels could allow them to offer substantial protection in a way that is extremely cost-effective to do so.
tech_engineering_13128_desc: Small replication devices for complex machinery allow for the replacement of parts on a regular basis without requiring expensive processing node input.
tech_engineering_13133_desc: Complex replicator units can be installed across entire structures, allowing for improved access to tools, replacements, or upgrades.
tech_engineering_13519_desc: Utilising the lessons learnt in the Galaxy Project, our scientists can expand the design principles to the rest of the fleet. Improvements to our existing cruisers should be possible.
tech_engineering_13521_desc: To combat the warships of other races the Federation requires a new starship design school that prioritises weaponry over multi-mission performance.
tech_engineering_13522_desc: The advances with warp technologies now provide new opportunities to streamline the hull of our vessels.
tech_engineering_13523_desc: Situations arise that are too unimportant for a larger starship but still need to be resolved by something with strong capabilities. The creation of smaller vessels such as the Saber class has been brought to the drawing room.
tech_engineering_13551_desc: The type 7-class shuttles are designed to deal with situations that demand a vessel more capable than the older Class F shuttlecraft, but still able to fit inside a regular shuttlebay.
tech_engineering_13553_desc: The Danube-class designs are meant to deal with situations that demand a vessel more capable than a standard shuttlecraft, but lower profile than a full-sized starship.
tech_engineering_13554_desc: Taking the concept of the Delta Flyer type shuttle to its logical conclusion provides the most nimble and powerful fighter craft in the Federation's arsenal.
tech_engineering_13604_desc: Designing a new powerful Bird-of-Prey is a difficult task, but technology advances mean large cannons can now be mounted on the wings of our designs. The curved wing design is reminiscent of the Blas Rika bird on Qo'noS.
tech_engineering_13607_desc: The reunification of the houses of the Klingon Empire allows for new designs to be created which incorporate the best designs from each house.
tech_engineering_13666_desc: A viscious and powerful new streamlined warbird has been placed onto the drawing board. This vessel, tentatively titled Vreedex, should be the pinnacle of our warbird technology.
tech_engineering_14003_desc: Red matter is an artificial substance manufactured from decalithium, a form of highly refined Dilithium crystal. On impact it has been theorised to cause ruptures to space resulting in black holes. However in small quantities it makes a dangerous and poweful explosive.
tech_engineering_14018_desc: Assimilation of our last targets has provided the collective knowledge of the rare alloy Victurium and the benefits of applying this material to the hull of our ships.
tech_engineering_14026: Rapid Fire Photon Mk. XXX Torpedo
tech_engineering_14026_desc: Refinements in the launching mechanisms of the Mk.XXV allow for a faster reload speed reducing a fraction of a second from the time it takes to prepare and launch a torpedo at an enemy vessel.
tech_engineering_14027_desc: Greater availability of warp plasma rated composite materials means they can be used in the construction of photon torpedo cases and their launchers, providing two advantages. The launchers can recharge faster, and a small amount of warp plasma can be mixed into the gas propellant, increasing its expansion rate. These launchers can fire higher yield light torpedoes without sacrificing velocity.
tech_engineering_14028_desc: Prior efforts to focus the internal targeting sensors within the warhead has previously been hampered by the thin warp field generated by the torpedo. Advances in shielding have allowed engineers to increase the accuracy and penetration of the warhead.
tech_engineering_14029_desc: Further refinement to the fields generated by the warhead increases the potensy of the weapon yield using state of the art technicques developed as part of ongoing work into warp drive.
tech_engineering_14030_desc: We have concluded that upgrading the quality of Dilithium at the core of our weaponary will provide increases to damage in the event that offensive action is required.
tech_engineering_14031_desc: Decalithium is a highly rare isotope and element, although extremely rare it possesses a tenfold increase over basic lithium and an explosion that matches.
tech_engineering_17016_desc: Chroniton Shielding allows a vessel to phase themselves out of time providing near impenetrable shield.
tech_engineering_17017_desc: Chroniton Drive allows a vessel to travel great distances and remain outside of the time stream.
tech_engineering_17018_desc: The Chroniton Core is at the heart of the Imperium's ability to manipulate time, keeping a ship out of the time stream and powering the immense Incursion Beam weapon.
tech_engineering_17019_desc: The ability to manipulate the timestream is a powerful, yet dangerous technology and requires specialist locations and equipment to safely house the work.
tech_engineering_17020_desc: Chroniton Shielding allows a vessel to phase themselves out of time providing near impenetrable shield.
tech_engineering_17022_desc: Fueled by the best quality Kemocite that the Xindi can produce the reactor is designed to power the most powerful of ships.
tech_engineering_17026_desc: Super heated charged Kemocite particles fired through an intense focusing beam can create a weapon of unrivalled power and destruction.
tech_engineering_22101_desc: Duranium is an extremely strong metal alloy that is used by many species for starship hulls due to its suitability as armour.
tech_engineering_22106_desc: Construction in space presents our Engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.
tech_engineering_22108_desc: Utilising all the resources of a solar system requires planning into navigational routes, orbital bodies and logistical planning.
tech_engineering_22109_desc: As our reach grows ever larger throughout the galaxy, new projects to take advantage of new construction techniques utilising the latest technologies can be created.
tech_engineering_22209_desc: Outsourcing the creation of new mining and research stations to the private sector allows for their own resources to be used in bolstering the stations defensive systems.
tech_engineering_22312_desc: The initial forays into space have provided us a wealth of information. New vessels must be constructed to delve deeper and further than ever before.
tech_engineering_22315_desc: As technology progresses and new hull materials become available, our vessels need to be able to travel further and undertake more work than ever before.
tech_engineering_22316_desc: Redesigning new hulls for new technologies is a time consuming process, especially as older hulls are often still valid. Refits utilising the newest technology can be applied to older vessels.
tech_engineering_22319_desc: Older designs that are still capable can be further improved by advanced retrofits with the latest technology.
tech_engineering_22321_desc: Prototypes of the latest advanced cruiser design have been put forward, and requires further research to fully develop the design.
tech_engineering_22322_desc: As technology progresses and new hull materials become available, our vessels need to be able to travel further and undertake more work than ever before.
tech_engineering_22334_desc: A small utility craft that can be outfitted with weaponry. The pod comprises a spherical cockpit connected to an aft section containing four extendable stabilising vanes, which could rotate freely around the cockpit to maintain position and attitude.
tech_engineering_22341_desc: An upgrade of the Danube-class, the Yellowstone-class is equipped with tetryon plasma warp nacelles and designed for a variety of mission profiles.
tech_engineering_22342_desc: The rule of an interstellar empire requires a palace that is as mobile as it is deadly. The construction of a vast flagship vessel to provide a flagship for the Empire will require much research.
tech_engineering_22345_desc: Terran scientists have been set the task of reverse engineering the mighty Vengeance-Class Dreadnought.
tech_engineering_22351_desc: Uraei is a program that is intended to shepherd and control a galactic power to secure a prosperous future for its user.
tech_engineering_22422_desc: The Sarcophagus, or Ship of the Dead, is an Klingon starship that serves as the command vessel of a house. It is covered with thousands of hollow, ornamental, metallic pods that are tightly interlocked to form a symbolic armour.
tech_engineering_22634_desc: By creating adjoining colony buttresses to the main hub we can increase the amount of civilian housing on the planet, utilising the resources of all other adjoining buttresses.
tech_engineering_22636_desc: Also known as arcologies, these enormous structures are self-contained in that every need of a citizen can be met within the tower, from health, to work, to ecosystem.
tech_engineering_22641_desc: The construction of buildings and structures without the constraints of gravity allows a freedom of engineering and architecture never before seen.
tech_engineering_22642_desc: Stretching across a continent, these space age metropolises are vast cities or conurbation which make up a significant economic, political, and cultural center for a world, and an important hub for planetary connections, commerce, and communications.
tech_engineering_22648_desc: The combining of motivators on a large scale allows for rapid construction of mass scale parts. By linking them together, a single set of hyper-linked motivators could take a ton of raw minerals and turn it into working and functional products by the end of the chain.
tech_engineering_22650_desc: Nano scale motivators can be used and programmed to perform a variety of automated tasks, ensuring the efficiency of production increases.
tech_engineering_22651_desc: With the invention of controlled gravity plating, the construction of buildings and starships has changed allowing for what would be once infeasible structures due to gravity to now be created.
tech_engineering_22657_desc: Trellium is a mineral that can used as a hull material. The rarest, Trellium-D, cannot be synthesised easily and is the most effective form of hull plating.
tech_engineering_22658_desc: Using Trellium-D for its unique properties against anomalies allows for a hardened shielding on many vessels, which increases structural integrity.
tech_engineering_22662_desc: Ablative armor is was originally designed as a primitive heat shielding for spacecraft. Over time it has been refined into an armor designed to disintegrate at a controlled rate under directed energy blasts, providing an additional layer of defense for starships.
tech_engineering_22813_desc: Sarium krellide is a material which stored large amounts of energy and which is usually used in power cells or explosives.
tech_engineering_32c_design: Discover a future worth fighting for
tech_engineering_32c_design_desc: As a reward for our efforts in defeating the Andromedan invaders we have been gifted the designs, but not the advanced technology of the ships that came to our aid to defend the future.
tech_engineering_ablative_607_desc: Using a technology similar to replicators, this generator can create an nearly impenetrable layer of additional armor outside of the normal hull of the ship.
tech_engineering_achilles_desc: The Achilles-class starship is a strategic heavy cruiser developed by the Federation in response to large cruisers owned by rival galactic powers.
tech_engineering_advanced_547_desc: Recent developments in starship construction allows for far more robust and modular designs, with simplified production lines and scalable components that can fit a wide range of starships. Research and development centres can now plan for highly specialised ships that are best suited for the task at hand.
tech_engineering_advanced_587_desc: Current demands are starting to outpace our ability to produce materials and in order to keep up with demands, more advanced refining techniques are required.
tech_engineering_advanced_589_desc: Topaline is a rare mineral critical to the function of key systems. Naturally-occurring, Topaline is mostly used as a key shield component.
tech_engineering_advanced_649_desc: There are a range of improvements that can be made to make the existing spatial torpedo design more effective. Improved blast shields will channel more of the explosion towards the front of the torpedo. With our increased expertise in spaceborne sensors, scientists have devised an ECM suite that will make the torpedo harder to track and counteract.
tech_engineering_advanced_711_desc: In times of conflict, we need ships specifically designed to engage the enemy. These ships are outfitted with additional tactical slots to best outperform our enemies in offensive abilities.
tech_engineering_advanced_712_desc: These ships are designed to survive! Additional engineering stations and modules on our ships allow us to outfit our ships with extra armor and hull plating as well as shield generators, thus improving our chances of survival in a fight.
tech_engineering_advanced_713_desc: No fleet can survive without proper support vessels. Ships of this specialisation are designed with scientific countermeasures and evasion in mind.
tech_engineering_akyaz_desc: There are plans to replace aging designs for the federations Border Patrol Scout using technology tested in the Excelsior.
tech_engineering_annoraxian_desc: Krenim weapon ship is a warship of the Krenim Imperium capable of erasing civilisations from history. Its design and construction is spearheaded by Annorax, a military temporal scientist.
tech_engineering_anti-matter_652_desc: Warp cores, a common reactor for powering starships and their warp drives, use a controlled matter/antimatter reaction to generate energy. This means that anti-matter creation, storage, and manipulation technologies and infrastructure are already well established. They can be easily weaponized, leading to a new breed of variable-yield, high-potential warheads.
tech_engineering_armor_670_desc: Extending, expanding and manipulating the Calabi-Yau manifold, the Quantum Torpedo can phase in and out of existence in the brief nanoseconds before the manifold collapses. This allows the Torpedo to pierce the armor and the hull of some ships and explode within, drastically increasing the potential damage.
tech_engineering_assault_546_desc: The most advanced starship design the Milky Way has seen in a long time, assault cruisers are equipped with powerful forward spinal weapons, capable of obliterating opponents from afar while still fielding enough normal beam and torpedo weaponry to deal with other ships up close. Its high maintenance and cost make this ship class more of a luxury, however.
tech_engineering_avidyne_633_desc: Research on gravity assisted engines has been abandoned. Our technology and scientific knowledge are not yet advanced enough to make it work correctly. For now, the Avidyne Propulsion Research and Testing Complex is attempting to apply the latest plasma dynamics research to impulse engines. New engine designs based on this work should allow us to use impulse plasma more effectively.
tech_engineering_battlecruiser_543_desc: Battlecruisers field the largest torpedo batteries of any known ship design. Their strong salvoes are able to obliterate smaller vessels in an instant, but high maintenance and weak defensive systems limit their ability to serve as the core for a fleet.
tech_engineering_battleship_544_desc: The battleship is one of the the largest vessels to serve in the navy of any empire. Its enormous defensive and support capabilities makes it fearsome opponents in combat, while her upgraded fuel storage allows it to reach directly into every distant system.
tech_engineering_bird-of-prey_716_desc: The invention of the warp drive opens up new possibilities for our civilisation, both peaceful and violent. The Bird-of-Prey class of vessel will allow us to bring powerful cannons to bear on any who dare violate our space. They will project the strength and fury of our hearts upon the homes of our enemies. In time we will need to conceive larger and specialised ships to maintain our dominance.
tech_engineering_buildable_599_desc: Advances in synaptic positronic networks allow the creation of synthetic beings.
tech_engineering_central_565_desc: An object in space is subject to immense velocities, micro-collisions, and extreme temperature variances. Appropriate reinforcement technology can help relieve these stresses.
tech_engineering_century_desc: The Century Project began its development shortly after the development of the Intrepid Class. With the more combat oriented Sovereign Class being pushed into service to tackle the increasing threat levels, it was realised that a dedicated explorer was needed for the future of Starfleet's exploration. Much like the Intrepid design complemented the Galaxy design.
tech_engineering_charged_689_desc: The Charged Plasma Torpedo loads a somewhat higher payload of warp plasma, but requires more energy to contain the plasma while the torpedoes are in their tubes.
tech_engineering_cruiser_542_desc: A significant advancement in starship design, the cruiser's impressive size is matched by its array of larger scale weapons and additional defensive systems. While it can take a beating on the battlefield, its reduced manoeuvrability can leave it vulnerable to swarms of smaller vessels.
tech_engineering_dauntless_desc: The quantum slipstream drive (also informally called quantum drive or slipstream drive) is an advanced form of propulsion technology which has the capability of exceeding a starship's maximum warp factor by an unprecedented degree.
tech_engineering_decision_1354_desc: Nanites released into the crust and mantle of a planet can mine rich deposits from under the surface of the world rapidly.
tech_engineering_deep_558_desc: These massive defensive outposts provide extensive protection against enemy incursion, and serve to deter less enthusiastic adversaries from nefarious behavior.
tech_engineering_deep_655_desc: A prototype, extreme-range, high-yield torpedo. Designed for bombarding targets from a safe distance, moderate tracking capability was added to help reduce the inaccuracy inherent to projectiles travelling large distances. Due to our engineer's inexperience with this type of weapon, photon launchers adapted to fire 'Deep Strike' torpedoes will suffer long reload times.
tech_engineering_defense_556_desc: Processes for platforms guarding the approaches to low planetary orbits without interfering with planetary traffic.
tech_engineering_deimos_desc: The Deimos-class dedicated to the Starfleet Intelligence department Section 31. It is equipped with sophisticated stealth equipment and enables attacks and infiltration from the shadows.
tech_engineering_destroyer_541_desc: Significantly larger than the patrol frigate, the destroyer is a very cheap and effective frontline ship that is capable of being quickly produced while fielding tons of offensive capabilities for its price. However, a major increase in maintenance costs makes them hard to sustain in peace times.
tech_engineering_dilithium_598_desc: Dilithium hydroxyl is a gaseous dilithium compound. It has been noted to form a significant portion of several nebulae. Collecting and distilling this will help ensure our fleets have adequate amounts of dilithium for decades or even centuries to come.
tech_engineering_duranium-victurium_614_: The implementation of Duranium alloy to our starships have been a monumental success. Now, we just discovered a new metal alloy called Victurium, which seems to be just as strong as Duranium. If we combine these two metallic alloys together, we will have the basis of an even stronger hull that further increases the durability of our ships' hulls.
tech_engineering_dynamic_679_desc: Advances in multiphasic technology have led to prototype multiphasic warheads. Instead of using EM bubbles, the matter is phased so that it can occupy the same space as the antimatter, without actually touching. To detonate, they are brought back into phase allowing a larger payload in a small package.
tech_engineering_ekoor_desc: The new Ekoor Class ships will put us on an equal footing with those who are fooling enough to challenge the Union.
tech_engineering_engineering_567_desc: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.
tech_engineering_engineering_577_desc: With the need of a specialised workforce comes a need for specialised facilities to carry out delicate work and experiments.
tech_engineering_enriched_692_desc: With increase torpedo case and containment shielding, we can now increase the plasma yield of our torpedoes, thereby increasing the damage output of our torpedoes.
tech_engineering_extraction_581_desc: Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.
tech_engineering_farragut_1_desc: The Farragut type consists of a saucer section without a separate engineering section. The main deflector and nacelle pylons are mounted directly on the ventral surface of the saucer. This class has a crew complement of approximately four hundred. It is equipped with phasers and deflector shields, and has a maximum speed of warp 9.
tech_engineering_fortified_561_desc: Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improve the resilience of Military Stations.
tech_engineering_geothermal_590_desc: New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.
tech_engineering_global_650_desc: The basics of intersystem warfare at vast speeds require new tracking technology and larger yields. Loading space missiles with fusion warheads far beyond what would be used on a planetary scale enables our forces to have a weapon capable of hurting the enemy.
tech_engineering_gouge_578_desc: Intrusive surface mining is extremely useful in the acquisition of arcybite and other minerals.
tech_engineering_gravimetric_697_desc: Photon torpedoes outfitted with gravimetric charges emit a complex phase variance of gravitons to create a gravimetric distortion capable of tearing starships apart.
tech_engineering_gravity-sheer_698_desc: These torpedoes utilise changes in gravity and inertial dampening fields to enhance their targeting, explosion direction, and force of impact, further enhancing destructive power but also greatly increasing accuracy and tracking.
tech_engineering_great_houses_hq_desc: The Klingon Great Houses drive the empire forward and ensure that the Klingon Empire is constantly moving a challenge.
tech_engineering_heavy_545_desc: 'If you get into a fight, strike first, and strike hard!' This advice serves as the inspiration for the design behind the heavy raider. Able to quickly jump to high warp speeds, ships of this class carry impressive offensive capabilities despite their small size and high manoeuvrability.
tech_engineering_heavy_610_desc: By sacrificing some agility and manoeuvrability, we can heavily armour our starships in the densest materials we can find.
tech_engineering_heavy_674_desc: Interlaced negative mass particles and polarons result in highly unstable, but effective, shield penetrating blast.
tech_engineering_high-yield_656_desc: Photon torpedoes can be developed according to two philosophies: 'hit harder' or 'hit more often'. By adopting the 'hit harder' philosophy we can develop torpedo launchers capable of firing heavier torpedoes with increased range. These will take more power to operate and have a much slower fire rate than standard torpedoes. Their size will also reduce their accuracy and tracking capability.
tech_engineering_hyper-impulse_637_desc: Taking the concept of warp reactor driven impulse engines to its logical conclusion, means having dedicated matter-antimatter reactors powering the impulse engines. These small reactors will feed the impulse engines with warp plasma, which is usually reserved for energising the warp coils. There are significant engineering challenges between now, and a working prototype fitted into a starship.
tech_engineering_improved_604_desc: Using superior construction methods, we can increase the density of the hull plating relay array along the exterior hull. Each array in the relay polarizes the hull at a different frequency, increasing the density, strength and efficiency of the polarising field.
tech_engineering_improved_635_desc: Avidyne impulse drives have suffered from handling problems, often being described as twitchy or jumpy. This problem has been traced to incompatibilities between the pulsed plasma exhaust, and the exhaust manifold geometry. This manifold design was restricted by the materials available. As new materials have been developed, it might now be possible to design a compatible manifold geometry.
tech_engineering_improved_678: Rapid Fire Photon Mk. XXV Torpedo
tech_engineering_improved_678_desc: Greater availability of warp plasma rated composite materials means they can be used in the construction of photon torpedo cases and their launchers, providing two advantages. The launchers can recharge faster, and a small amount of warp plasma can be mixed into the gas propellant, increasing its expansion rate. These launchers can fire higher yield light torpedoes without sacrificing velocity.
tech_engineering_impulse_631_desc: Impulse thrusters vent high energy plasma to provide thrust. There are two main distinctions between them and fusion thrusters. Impulse thrusters can use plasma from a warp core in addition to a fusion reactor, and they generally use a more complex exhaust manifold to greatly increase their efficiency. By further developing this technology, we can achieve even greater sublight speeds.
tech_engineering_industry_1201_desc: Research into improvements for our civilian vessels is just as important as our military. Improvements to construction and science ships can increase our expansion rate.
tech_engineering_industry_1207_desc: Our engineering expertise has finally advanced to the point at which we have begun to harness the power of entire star systems. The ability to build true mega-structures, such as those theorised by scientist Freeman Dyson in the mid-20th century, is now within our grasp.
tech_engineering_industry_1222_desc: A vast symbol of the power of the power of our Empire. It is the will of our leaders that we create a vessel capable of destroying an entire fleet at once.
tech_engineering_industry_1228_desc: Improvements to the structural integrity field and hull materials allow for stronger, more resilient hulls.
tech_engineering_industry_1229_desc: Standardisation of cargo modules and interfaces allows a standardised workbee to be constructed. This allows rapid deployment of hull panels and ensures standardised plating with no weak points.
tech_engineering_industry_1251_desc: The Sphere embodies perfect simplicity. It can be described in one simple thought; every point is equidistant to its centre. It has infinite faces, each infinitely small, blending seamlessly to form a single surface. This mirrors the nature of the Collective; many voices, a single purpose. It has the smallest surface area to volume ratio of any 3D shape; we must emulate its perfect efficiency.
tech_engineering_industry_1252_desc: A Diamond is little more than a cube which has been tilted and stretched. Its profile can be superimposed over a sphere, to provide an armoured and weaponised exoframe. The inner sphere can then carry delicate, sensitive equipment in relative safety. Despite the deceptively fragile look of this intricate design, it will function well as a hive guardian and support vessel.
tech_engineering_industry_1253_desc: The Cube is another simple shape; twelve edges share a single length. It tessellates infinitely, growing in complexity, as does the Collective. The surface area of the cube is much higher than the sphere, and less vulnerable than the Diamond.
