Everything combines to make the cube an excellent shape for a heavy combat and assimilation focused vessel, uniting more worlds in Borg solidarity.
tech_engineering_industry_1254_desc: The Cube has proven to be an effective vessel design. However, species with a comparable level of combat technology pose a threat to it. To ensure their resistance is futile, a series of upgrades can be made to make the Cube more resilient, maximising its tactical efficiency function. Higher density exoplating covering a wider portion of the hull is the first adaption to be tested.
tech_engineering_industry_1255_desc: Cubes and Tactical Cubes sufficiently handle most hostile encounters. We wish to handle species with comparable technology to us with the same efficacy as those who are less developed. The unity granted to us by the Hive will enable us to create an enormous scaled-up Cube, which will go unmatched in size, firepower, and durability.
tech_engineering_industry_1258_desc: By miniaturising the warp core, we can install cores on our fighter craft. These deep-space fighters can then move rapidly and overwhelm enemy vessels.
tech_engineering_industry_1259_desc: To counter the threat of enemy fighters and to ensure a deep strike capability, research into long-range fighter engagements is required. Solving the issues of logistics and endurance shall be one of the main priorities.
tech_engineering_industry_1260_desc: Advances in fighter technology mean that the next step is well-equipped for both dogfighting and anti-capital operations, dedicated fighters that can pack a punch.
tech_engineering_industry_1261_desc: Waste heat energy can be recycled throughout all the systems onboard, allowing for increased efficiency
tech_engineering_industry_1262_desc: Potentially more powerful cybernetic implants could be installed into biological beings in order to increase their cognition and motor functions.
tech_engineering_industry_1263_desc: Small courier ships used by the civilian fleet for communications and dispatches have provided us with incremental improvements that we could use on our own strike craft.
tech_engineering_industry_1266_desc: Requiring the largest vessels available to the Dominion, the fleet carrier design is a flagship and fleet command and control unit all in one. A single one of these vessels should be able to pacify most worlds.
tech_engineering_industry_1278_desc: By linking numerous stationary weapon turrets and planetary defenses through one grid, targeting by one sensor could mean that all weapons could fire upon it.
tech_engineering_industry_1285_desc: By potentially introducing areas where commerce can take place, we can defray the cost of construction into the private sector.
tech_engineering_industry_1286_desc: Advancements in starbase construction bring new methods of building deep space stations. Modular systems and more readily available resources mean that starbases can be constructed more readily.
tech_engineering_industry_1289_desc: The main disadvantage to a military station is that it cannot move. We can, however, turn this into an advantage for our onboard weapon systems by routing more power through the primary transfer buffer coils and allowing targeting arrays to pick targets independently of the main systems.
tech_engineering_industry_1298_desc: Many of the lower mammalian life forms found in the galaxy do not understand our Doctrine and true place in the galaxy. Our space must be kept clean of these primitive races, and to do that, we require a vessel that can patrol and defend our borders with impunity.
tech_engineering_industry_1299_desc: Doctrine states that we were the first intelligent beings to evolve in this region of space, and as such as we have an ancient and rightful claim over it. Non-indigenous beings have no rights, and with that in mind, we require a vessel that can enforce our power over those that seek to disrupt Doctrine.
tech_engineering_industry_1300_desc: Our manifest destiny and claim over all space is written in the very annals of Doctrine. Our special virtues, our belief and our irresistible destiny to expand across the stars requires vessels of tremendous power and size. These flagships will bring Doctrine to every arm of the galaxy.
tech_engineering_industry_1301_desc: Leaving fragile planetary bodies behind and roaming the stars that belong to us is a dream we have for millennia. The creation of vast vessels capable of housing entire populations of our people is almost within our grasp.
tech_engineering_industry_1302_desc: Designed for short-range planetary and orbital transport, the Shuttlepod is equipped with limited weaponry.
tech_engineering_industry_1303_desc: Constructed with a duranium metal shell, the class F was propelled by an ion engine and protected by a deflector shield. It has a much larger range than previous vessels of this type.
tech_engineering_industry_1304_desc: The Peregrine Assault Fighter is lightly armed with cannons, very fast, maneuverable, and protected by armour and shielding. In large numbers these fighters pose a threat to even capital ships.
tech_engineering_industry_1305_desc: The Delta Flyer is a vessel that is designed to handle environments that would be too hazardous for a standard shuttlecraft or fighter craft and for situations where sending in a starship is foolhardy. Its long range weaponry and warp engines ensure these ships can strike deep into the heart of enemy fleets.
tech_engineering_industry_1306_desc: Designed to be launched from the surface or low orbit, these pursuit craft are short-ranged ships designed for defence.
tech_engineering_industry_1307_desc: Small, stealthy fighters, these attack ships are designed to scout enemy activity without being caught; however, they are also equipped with weaponry in order to be used in fleet actions.
tech_engineering_industry_1308_desc: The Hideki-class attack ships, also referred to as Cardassian fighters, are a type of small warship with heavy weapons designed to operate in fleet environments.
tech_engineering_industry_1309_desc: Small and nimble with enhanced weaponry and shielding, these pursuit craft can take on small vessels one on one and pose a serious threat in large numbers.
tech_engineering_industry_1310_desc: DuQwI' Fighters are armed with dual disruptor cannons and photon torpedo launchers but are very short-range and have limited defences.
tech_engineering_industry_1311_desc: S'Kul Heavy Raiders are styled after the Fek'Ihri designs and are armed with powerful weapons but with short-range and limited defences.
tech_engineering_industry_1312_desc: The increase in energy output from our reactors allows us to pack a much larger punch into a smaller size, enabling our forces to field small vessels capable of striking hard and fast.
tech_engineering_industry_1313_desc: Serving on these ships was often considered a mixed blessing - the weapons of the craft were largely incapable of damaging larger enemy craft unless in large numbers, but the NuQ'DuJ would likely be destroyed in the battle, bringing glory and an honorable death to the vessel's crew.
tech_engineering_industry_1314_desc: Jian defenders are lightly armed with dual disruptor banks and light plasma launchers but are very short-range and have limited defences.
tech_engineering_industry_1315_desc: The Gladius Space Superiority fighter is a larger fighter with improved weaponry that can operate at longer ranges than previous craft.
tech_engineering_industry_1316_desc: Designed to combat small frigates and destroyers, Kahleh fighters can tear through earlier vessels of the same class. In large numbers they are a threat to even capital vessels.
tech_engineering_industry_1317_desc: The Scorpion-class is a type of small attack fighter. They utilise disruptor turrets and standard photon torpedoes, as well as shields and cloaking devices in order to sow confusion in enemy fleets.
tech_engineering_industry_1318_desc: Jem'Hadar fighters are lightly armed with polaron beams, though they have very short range and limited defences. The fighter is much more valuable than its crew.
tech_engineering_industry_1319_desc: Jem'Hadar Assault Craft are armed with improved polaron beams and are very fast and maneuverable, and protected by armour. In large numbers, these fighters pose a threat to even capital ships.
tech_engineering_industry_1320_desc: These patrol boats are small and nimble with enhanced polaron weaponry and shielding. Their sturdy hulls allow these pursuit craft to take on small vessels one on one and pose a serious threat to larger vessels when in swarms.
tech_engineering_industry_1321_desc: These Alpha Jem'Hadar fighters are heavy armed with long-range capability and strong hulls. Maneuverability is high, which renders it a threat to larger enemy vessels, especially in large numbers.
tech_engineering_industry_1329_desc: Romulan Imperial engineers have produced the latest generation of Romulan Warbirds. Fast, sleek and brimming with the very latest weapons provided by the Romulan Navy and the Tal'Shiar.
tech_engineering_industry_1399_desc: Many of the lower mammalian life forms found in the galaxy do not understand our Doctrine and true place in the galaxy. Our space must be kept clean of these primitive races, and to do that, we require a vessel that can patrol and defend our borders and root out trouble.
tech_engineering_industry_1530_desc: By collecting and repurposing the hull parts of the species we assimilate, the Collective does not need to build our vessels from scratch. Also, making our vessels modular allows for efficient repairs.
tech_engineering_industry_1551_desc: Travelling through transwarp requires complex calculations, reinforced structural integrity, and robust navigational processes. By constructing mobile transwarp apertures, or 'portals', we can ease the passage of our vessels into warp and navigate through space more efficiently and rapidly, allowing for the rapid deployment of our forces across the galaxy.
tech_engineering_inertial_629_desc: The lack of motion-resisting forces in space allows starships to generate extreme acceleration compared to atmospheric craft. This poses a threat to the safety of our crews, and we must hastily find a way of managing their effect on the ship. Early proposals are focusing on using graviton manipulations or gyroscopic technology, but it is likely that new forms of technology will quickly emerge.
tech_engineering_inertial_641_desc: Inertial dampers absorb the inertial force generated by impulse and warp drive acceleration. It is theoretically possible to use the dampers in reverse and provide limited acceleration. Current inertial dampers don't have the capability to do so, as it would increase their size and power consumption. By designing new dampers we can equip starships with them if required.
tech_engineering_interlacing_677_desc: These torpedoes weaponise the warp field passed to them at launch. Small and thin, but relatively long warp coils are placed around the warhead. This generates an intense shift in the torpedo's warp field, twisting it in upon itself in front of the torpedo, behind the targets shield. Where the field now interlaces with itself, a small, momentary subspace tear forms, directly damaging the hull.
tech_engineering_interphased_693_desc: By combining a cloaking device and a molecular phase inverter, the molecular structure of these torpedoes are altered upon launch so as to be able to pass through energy and even matter. There's no stopping these babies.
tech_engineering_intersecting_676_desc: By twisting the Calabi-Yau manifold into even more complex geometries, different parts of the quantum torpedo warhead can be made to exist at multiple points in space simultaneously. The effect is a highly focused explosion channelled into a cone, that inflicts enormous damage along its path. Not even the toughest armour and hull materials can resist.
tech_engineering_kaon_686_desc: Kaon particles are formed when atomic nuclei collide with other highly charged subatomic particles. They have no electric charge and have about half the mass of a proton. This energy release gives the torpedo its destructive power.
tech_engineering_kelindide_615_desc: Energy weapons are not absorbed easily by this strong and perfectly reflective sheeting in laboratory tests. Further research is required for full implementation amongst the fleet.
tech_engineering_kelvincon_desc: Tech dervived from a mysterious ship pulled from another timeline.
tech_engineering_kessok_solarforming_des: The power to manipulate stellar matter for power or destruction.
tech_engineering_kulinor: The Dark Jewels of the Union
tech_engineering_kulinor_desc: They are created secretly by military engineers in order to create a powerful battleship and are known as dark jewels of the Cardassian fleets. They are heavily armed with phasers and protected by powerful shields allowing them to fight on the front line.
tech_engineering_lexington_desc: A major planned refit to these vessels to bring them in line with the lastest technological breakthroughs.
tech_engineering_light_609_desc: With the concept of 'less is more' in mind, we can develop starship hulls that are lighter while remaining strong. This allows our ships to be more agile, while still receiving suitable protection from the rigors of space travel.
tech_engineering_loknar_1_desc: Although the era was defined by scientific research and exploratory ventures, numerous small warship classes were built, including the Loknar. These vessels were primarily designed by Andorians, who favored a doctrine of border protection for the young Federation.
tech_engineering_loknar_2_desc: A major planned refit to these vessels to bring them in line with the lastest technological breakthroughs.
tech_engineering_low_632_desc: Low temperature thrusters have a lower top speed, but make up for it with a smaller sensor footprint. This is useful during combat were tracking a fast, evasive starship, which is equipped with a variety of countermeasures, can be difficult. When these thrusters fire, it takes marginally longer for a hostile ship to isolate their signature, increasing the chance that an evasive move will succeed.
tech_engineering_low_634_desc: Reaction control system thrusters are vital for manoeuvring in space. They are responsible for fine translational and rotational adjustments. Unfortunately, the size of the RCS thruster ports have necessitated using high temperature exhaust to provide adequate force. This is changing, as next generation impulse reactors can route colder plasma to the RCS, at a high enough pressure to be useful.
tech_engineering_low_636_desc: Impulse capacitance cells have been available for some time, but must keep the plasma hot to prevent de-energisation. If plasma scrubbing technology was to be advanced to the point that 98% of oppositely charged particles were filtered prior to storage, we could store the plasma cold. This would make it suitable for incorporating into our stealth impulse technology.
tech_engineering_lower_decks_desc: Starfleet Corp of Engineering specialist McMahan has created a series of unique designs, which deserved a longer run but provided fantastic entertainment.
tech_engineering_magnesite_611_desc: A ceramic alloy, often mixed with Talgonite, used in hull construction. It is light, but comes at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
tech_engineering_mariposas_desc: The Mariposas are a movement dedicated to providing medical care to those in need. It was founded on Earth by Doctor Teresa Ramirez and Cristóbal Rios.
tech_engineering_masked_638_desc: Arrays of small, multi-vectored exhaust ports are being developed. If designed correctly, a thruster array will have an easier to mask electro-thermal signature, while greatly improving manoeuvrability. The engines reactors are also being retooled to use a newly certified fuel, quaratum. It has similar operating characteristics to paralithium, but with higher pressure output, increasing thrust.
tech_engineering_mass-scale_566_desc: Instead of using the mobile depot units, that some of our deep space stations have installed within their stations, to help repair other friendly ships near them, we can convert our nanobot technology instead to replicate this same feature. With the highly advanced nature of our nanobots, they will also be able to assist in restoring shields faster as well.
tech_engineering_mass_585_desc: These facilities allow for the mass production of components used in settlement development, leading to reduced costs and building times.
tech_engineering_materials_1402_desc: Aperiodic tiling quasi-crystals have been involved in research and development for hundreds of years, with limited success. The high energy and temperatures involved in modern technology means their electrical and heat resistant properties are needed now, more than ever. Luckily, we can combine advanced manufacturing technology with designs inspired by crystals found while exploring space.
tech_engineering_materials_1403_desc: The discovery of subspace led to drastic changes in our understanding of atomic physics, and a redrafted periodic table. One of the new element groups is the Hypersonic Series. This group's notable elements include dilithium, tngonian, and princessium. These elements are too unstable to exist naturally but could benefit several areas of research; such sensors, medicine, and construction.
tech_engineering_materials_1420_desc: Trellium is a mineral used as hull plating, which is particularly effective against anomalies, and comes in multiple forms. It can only be synthesized in liquid form, with varying degrees of difficulty. It is Trellium-D that is very useful as insulation, which is the rarest trellium mineral and difficult to synthesise. Our advances in distillation techniques have allowed us to locate potential Trellium deposits.
tech_engineering_materials_1421_desc: Tallonian crystals are precious gemstones which offer substantial focusing properties when used in high-end technology.
tech_engineering_materials_1425_desc: Recent investigations into chemistry and astrogeology show the potential for rare types of crystals and minerals deep within the core of certain planets. These materials, which when combined with our own materials, could offer substantially increases in effectiveness.
tech_engineering_materials_1427_desc: The discovery of a small amount of Jevonite, a rare mineral stone said to be breathtaking in appearance by many species, has led to the need to discover more deposits.
tech_engineering_materials_1433_desc: The creation of dilithium via synthetic means might be possible with this new energy-intensive process.
tech_engineering_materials_1436_desc: The particle fountain enables the manipulation and creation of even the rarest particles in existence.
tech_engineering_materials_1439_desc: By creating adjoining colony buttresses to the main colony hub we can increase the amount of civilian housing on the planet, utilising the resources of all other adjoining buttresses.
tech_engineering_materials_1440_desc: The construction of an arcology, an enormous self-sufficient population unit which utilises all its own resources without impact on the rest of the colony, can allow for large amounts of population within a smaller area.
tech_engineering_materials_1441_desc: A massive mountain-sized arcology has been a dream of many architects; however, research only now has progressed to the level where it may be possible.
tech_engineering_materials_1442_desc: A living city has been a dream of many thinkers across the galaxy, but our advances in computing and construction may allow this to be a possibility, where everything is linked to one another for high efficiency.
tech_engineering_materials_1443_desc: A metallic metropolis propels urban innovation to new frontiers, reshaping cities with steel and alloys. This synthesis of metallurgy and synthetic innovation creates havens of efficiency, where artificial life transforms the darkness of space into a symphony of luminescence.
tech_engineering_materials_1448_desc: Improved force fields that can snap into place around any breach or person to secure them briefly against the vast darkness of empty space.
tech_engineering_materials_1460_desc: An alloy constructed of magnesite and paricium is a lighter and stronger alternative for hull construction than the electroceramic methods used in previous iterations.
tech_engineering_materials_1464_desc: The implementation of a magnesite-tritanium mesh further strengthens the hull of our vessels, whilst remaining exceedingly light.
tech_engineering_materials_1470_desc: The testing of duranium polyweave alloys has developed a sturdy material that can take a large amount of punishment before finally buckling.
tech_engineering_materials_1473_desc: Duranium is an extremely strong metal that is used by many species for starship hulls due to its suitability as armor. It is heavy though, potentially increasing a ship's mass and making it less maneuverable.
tech_engineering_materials_1481_desc: Personal shields have long been desired by personnel exposed to hazards. It is not just a case of miniaturising the technology enough to be wearable. Current shield implementations would make it difficult for the user to walk as well as suffocating them, but we believe we can come up with ways to circumvent that issue.
tech_engineering_materials_1482_desc: Cortical Implants are devices to interface humanoids with various technology. The Collective would benefit greatly, as drones would be able to interface with technology, allowing regeneration and interfacing with hostile technology.
tech_engineering_materials_1483_desc: Transwarp Enabled Interlink Nodes allow for drones to communicate with each other at transwarp speeds, allowing for faster, better, and more efficient tactical communication across battlefields.
tech_engineering_materials_1485_desc: Utilising the most advanced command programs and most advanced technology, tactical drones are the most skilled drones in the Collective. Assimilation of targets will be more efficient.
tech_engineering_materials_1491_desc: Current generation impulse drives use as much of the high energy plasma as they can. We will need to think of a different approach to increase our starships speeds. One possible solution is to create an anti-gravity wake behind the ship, repelling it in the direction of travel. This application of graviton technology has not been attempted before, doubtlessly there will be hurdles to overcome.
tech_engineering_materials_1494_desc: Engineers widely agree that modern warp cores can supply enough high energy plasma to meet our impulse engines demands, without requiring fusion reactors. Many engineering challenges must be overcome to facilitate this change. For example, new plasma shunts will be required to balance the load between the thruster array exhaust ports, without causing instability in the plasma flow characteristics.
tech_engineering_materials_1495_desc: The success of Shange shunt interfaces has opened new opportunities for impulse manifold designers. Ideas for a multi-vector thruster manifold have been drawn up, but current impulse assemblies can not support the design. We will need to create a new assembly, likely building it from miniaturised assembly segments, to form a flexible, compound impulse assembly.
tech_engineering_materials_1500_desc: Although fusion reactors are becoming obsolete in primary impulse drives, they still have a place in secondary propulsion. The Fusion Intermix Booster project is attempting to use a fusion reactor to create thrust plasma, but then mix it with a small amount of antimatter to increase its temperature to 43keV. Heat and pressure stress induced structural integrity failures are still causing problems.
tech_engineering_materials_1501_desc: Paralithium synthesis technology has long been on the watchlist of Avidyne Stealth R&D Yards. Experimental paralithium engines have been shown to produce relatively cold, highly ionised plasma. Hopefully, this can be combined with ion engine technology to create a potent cold thruster. A new paralithium synthesis technique, yielding two orders of magnitude more fuel, will allow research to resume.
tech_engineering_materials_1505_desc: Anti-gravity assisted impulse technology was conceived near the start of our cold impulse engine program. It was quickly dismissed and forgotten due to concerns over the detectability of gravimetric distortions, and our technical ability to control them. Recently, a team of researchers revisited the idea using modern graviton technology, and created a proof-of-concept stealth paragravitic drive.
tech_engineering_materials_1506_desc: A long forgotten experiment in multispatial sensor technology might prove to be revolutionary for stealth thrusters. It was found that graviton fields can be made to push active sensor beams into subspace. If this can be adapted for pushing thruster plasma exhaust into subspace, the sensor signature of our ships will drop dramatically. We might even be able to begin using hot plasma exhaust.
tech_engineering_materials_1512_desc: Self-repairing hulls give our vessels significant operational autonomy, allowing them to recover from moderate damage, without deviating from their assignment. The next logical step is to improve the material composition of the hull, enhancing its durability. Duranium fits the availability and toughness profile; however, a way needs to be found for the repair nanoprobes to easily manipulate it.
tech_engineering_materials_1514_desc: There are many mechanisms through which damage can be inflicted to a vessel's hull. As duranium polyweave provides sufficient kinetic penetration and explosive resistance, the current primary weaknesses are to blunt impact and mechanical shockwaves. A supplementary hull material could be created from paricium; it possess shock resistant properties and can be easily molded into various forms.
tech_engineering_materials_1515_desc: Wir untersuchen kontinuierlich die Leistung unserer Hüllen, um Schwachstellen frühzeitig zu erkennen. Unsere Ergebnisse deuten darauf hin, dass das Duranium-Polygeflecht nicht mehr ausreichend leistungsfähig ist. Eine Buckyball-Plattenstruktur wird einen besseren Schutz bieten. Bevor wir diese Änderung vornehmen können, müssen wir die optimale Art und Weise der Schichtung mit dem Paricium-Gedächtnisschaum berechnen und die Reparatur-Nanosonden neu programmieren.
tech_engineering_materials_1516_desc: Victurium alloy has sufficient durability to be a viable replacement for duranium in our hulls. However, it has several unacceptable qualities which will interfere with standard vessel operations, including scrambling transporter signals and disrupting hull repair nanoprobe control. It could be used as a buttressing material if an equally durable material is found to form the primary layer.
tech_engineering_materials_1518_desc: Victurium-kelindide hull plating is proving to be as durable as predicted but requires orders of magnitudes more nanoprobes to repair at an acceptable rate. Tetraburnium alloy has several key properties that make it a viable replacement hull material. It is easier to manipulate than victurium and kelindide, has a high tensile strength, and is extremely heat and pressure resistant.
tech_engineering_materials_1520_desc: We are having difficulty producing enough tetraburnium alloy to supply all of our vessels. Rather than accepting substandard hull construction, we need to adapt. Tritanium is both common and strong, making it suitable for use in developing a supplementary hull layer. The most efficient way of preserving the tetraburnium nanoweave layer would be to use the tritanium to create an ablative layer.
tech_engineering_materials_1522_desc: The assimilation of species 9452 has added new knowledge of tritanium refining and processing. This species primary resistance factor was from the hull of their vessels. They were formed from a tritanium based substance that would attempt to recover its previous shape after sustaining damage. Adapting this substance for our hulls will greatly enhance their regenerative ability.
tech_engineering_materials_1523_desc: Omni-directional thrusters are versatile, however their distributed nature weakens their overall effectiveness. Several technical enhancements are being investigated, such as avidyne reactors, but these might not be ready for an unacceptable amount of time. If a short term solution is required, we can find a way of enlarging the existing system. It will be inefficient, but functional.
tech_engineering_materials_1524_desc: Thruster arrays have given a moderate power increase at the cost of efficiency, but further improvements are required. As avidyne engines are not yet ready, those improvements will have to be made to the current system. A portion of the current system inefficiency has been traced to the exhaust outlets; their design doesn't effectively limit plasma from dispersing along transverse trajectories.
tech_engineering_materials_1525_desc: Since assimilating species 91 and becoming aware of the substance known as avidyne, we have pursued it for use as an impulse drive reactant. We have finally developed a way of storing this potent, but unstable, chemical for long periods of time. The final obstacle is to miniaturise avidyne synthesis nodes to the point that a sufficient quantity of them can installed on our vessels.
tech_engineering_materials_1526_desc: The old high-gain thrusters were adapted for avidyne plasma exhaust, but are not functioning as efficiently as simulations predicted. We currently lack sufficient data to fully diagnose the problem, but it is likely that our understanding of heavy plasma flow dynamics is flawed. Additional research will correct our understanding and allow us to design a more efficient thruster manifold array.
tech_engineering_materials_1527_desc: Through assimilation and experimentation, our knowledge of gravity manipulation techniques has advanced immensely. Heuristics predict that we have sufficient knowledge to begin developing an engine that propels a vessel using controlled gravimetric distortions. This technology is likely to be significantly more effective and versatile than our current impulse engine operating principles.
tech_engineering_materials_1537_desc: Energy usage throughout the warp core is constantly utilised with a high throughput, allowing for improved calculations and processing. By allowing energy matrices to transfer information at light-speed velocities, we can increase the overall energy throughput and storage.
tech_engineering_matter_608_desc: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.
tech_engineering_metaphasic_1_desc: The ability to bombard a planet with concentrated Metaphasic Radiation that would start a thermolytic reaction, the radiation of which to be collected by a collector or left to destroy the planet.
tech_engineering_metaphasic_2_desc: The technology to forcefully harvest the metaphasic radiation, entailing the use of a piece of equipment, known as an injector assembly to be launched from a specialty ship.
tech_engineering_metaphasic_3_desc: The ability to bombard a planet with concentrated Metaphasic Radiation that would start a thermolytic reaction, the radiation of which to be collected by a collector or left to destroy the planet.
tech_engineering_metaphasic_core_desc: Harnessing the power of the Metaphasic Radiation allows for the creation of a powerful reactor core.
tech_engineering_mineral_582_desc: Advanced spectrometry combines fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth lying deposits.
tech_engineering_mineral_588_desc: Kemocite is a mineral that is a multiphasic isotope of a radiolytic compound. Its highly unstable nature requires unique containment protocols be developed for usage in warheads.
tech_engineering_monotanium_617_desc: The improvements to monotanium refining allow an alloy constructed of magnesite and monotanium to be utilised in the construction of our vessels' hulls. It is a much lower mass than previous alloys, allowing our vessels to be nimbler.
tech_engineering_multi-layered_602_desc: Single layer planetary shields have been developed and proven safe. Now we can work on adapting techniques from starship scale shields for planetary use, such as multi-layered shields.
tech_engineering_nimrod_desc: Section 31 has access to the latest and best technology within Starfleet and the Nimrod Class reflects these design choices. Providing Section 31 with a fast and deadly ship.
tech_engineering_noble_688_desc: Noble gas provides a somewhat less volatile plasma than warp plasma, leading to a slightly longer housing period before the plasma erodes the containment shielding and torpedo casing. This means that we will have a slight window of opportunity for tracking capability.
tech_engineering_nuclear_702_desc: Nuclear Explosives use a critical mass of fissile material to create a powerful explosion. By combining different catalysts we can improve the yield of the explosive substantially. This should allow for smaller, more powerful explosives to be utilised onboard vessels.
tech_engineering_nx_01_desc: The NX Project, also known as the NX Program or NX Test Program, is Starfleet's effort to develop a starship using the engine designed by the Warp Five program.
tech_engineering_nx_01_refit_desc: The Columbia-class was born out of the existing, and proven, NX-class design, and included retrofitted ships such as Enterprise and USS Endeavour. In 2156, Enterprise was the first vessel to receive the upgraded spaceframe. It was named, at the insistence of Admiral Jonathan Archer.
tech_engineering_nxbeta_desc: The NX-Beta was one of three test vehicles, along with the NX-Alpha and NX-Delta, used by Starfleet's NX Project to test and refine the warp 5 engine designed by Henry Archer.
tech_engineering_nxdiscovery_desc: The ships of the Discovery-class are among those which receive a number of ugrades as a result of Earth rapid technological advances.
tech_engineering_osler_desc: Division 14, also known as D-14, is a specialised Starfleet division that handles mysterious science- or medical-related problems afflicting its personnel.
tech_engineering_parametallic_622_desc: If we want to make our starships more durable, we could look into additional materials that can be placed on the external layers of our starship hulls. By combining different types of materials together, we have come up with another type of armor plating. This new type of alloy will provide the additional protection needed against weapon fire or hazardous materials a starship's hull may encounter.
tech_engineering_particle_580_desc: Modified field technology, not unlike the 'space elevator' concept of cheaply lifting things to orbit, can be used to excavate and bring minerals to orbit for conveyance elsewhere.
tech_engineering_pegasus_desc: A test bed class for a number of experimental technologies.
tech_engineering_pergium_592_desc: Pergium, a radioactive mineral found on assorted worlds, can be mined, refined, and utilized as an energy source.
tech_engineering_personal_627_desc: Vacuum suits are often cumbersome and unwieldy however personal shielding can be modified to offer a short term vacuum suit made entirely of energy. This has obvious military and scientific benefits.
tech_engineering_phased_691_desc: These torpedoes utilise a phase inverter to alter the state of the torpedo's shielding to match that of the target. Theoretically speaking, this should allow the torpedoes increased shield-penetrating efficiency.
tech_engineering_photon_653_desc: Continued work on creating specialised components has drastically cut the power requirement and freed up a lot of internal space. Two things can now be done with the design: the space can be used to fit a significantly larger warhead and higher capacity energy reserve, or we can design a smaller case with a high-mobility thruster system to create a shorter-range homing torpedo.
tech_engineering_photon_654_desc: Like most weapons, torpedo launchers have a limited firing arc. While fine for starships, starbases cannot manoeuvre to bring their weapons to bear. Traditionally this is overcome with a weapons grid spanning the starbases hull, but this wastes a lot of power. It is possible to design pylons which stick out from the station, allowing a smaller number of launchers to cover a wider area.
tech_engineering_piezoelectric_597_desc: New mining techniques exploiting the piezoelectric properties of dilithium crystals are ready for testing. If successful, they will allow us to mine dilithium deposits that may have been too small to be worth the time previously required to excavate. A minor boost in the amount of dilithium available to our fleets should follow.
tech_engineering_pion_684_desc: Matter/Antimatter reactions are used to generate meson decay reactions, which can be applied as a radioactive source against desired targets.
tech_engineering_pk_section_desc: Unlocks the Planet Killer section for large battleships for players with DLC.
tech_engineering_planetary_601_desc: Shielding a planet is not simply a matter of building the vast infrastructure to sustain it. First our scientists must find a way of forming the shield without causing apocalyptic changes to the planet's atmosphere. If successful, it will provide additional protection during orbital bombardment.
tech_engineering_plasma_682_desc: These torpedoes utilise warp plasma in their warheads. The plasma is extremely difficult to contain in such a small space frame, however, which leads to rapid decay of the torpedo casing once the weapon is fired. Due to this fact, plasma torpedoes have virtually zero tracking capability, extremely short ranges, and consume significant amounts of ship energy stores to utilise.
tech_engineering_polarized_603_desc: Through the application of an electromagnetic field to the ship's hull, the structural integrity can be significantly increased, protecting the starship from enemy weapons fire.
tech_engineering_polyduranium_616_desc: Another metallic alloy has been classified, and this one we are calling Poly-Duranium Weave. Going along the branch of our Duranium and Duranium-Victurium type alloys, this alloy is even stronger than those, providing further increases to the durability of our ships' hulls.
tech_engineering_power_594_desc: Assorted drilling techniques can be developed to access parts of a planet, asteroid, etc; that would otherwise be inaccessible due to thermal, geological, or safety considerations.
tech_engineering_powered_626_desc: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious.
tech_engineering_praetor_class_desc: The Romulan flagship is a type of warship that is in service with the military of the Romulan Star Empire, under the personal command of the Romulan Praetor.
tech_engineering_private_568_desc: As space travel becomes more commonplace, competing citizens often believe they can do things better and faster than each other. By outsourcing the creation of mining stations to these contractors, we can lower the overall cost outlay whilst still maintaining the income.
tech_engineering_proxima_1_desc: The Proxima-class is a federation battleship and is extremely heavily armed.
tech_engineering_proxima_2_desc: Upgrades to the Proxima Class further enhance its reputation. It is considered to be a battleship and is extremely heavily armed.
tech_engineering_quasi-interacting_680_d: Simulations have been made to test exotic matter as a transfer medium. Using certain negative mass particles for the transfer medium will create an effect whereby the polaron can pass through shields relatively unhindered. Unfortunately, the polaron will not fully interact with the hull of the enemy ship which will reduce its damage potential, but we still expect a net increase in damage.
tech_engineering_radon_690_desc: These torpedoes utilise Radon plasma instead of Noble Gas plasma. It offers a slightly greater yield without losing the slow degradation of the containment field. Thus the benefit of a small window for tracking is maintained.
tech_engineering_rapid_657_desc: Photon torpedoes can be developed according to two philosophies: 'hit harder' or 'hit more often'. By adopting the 'hit more often' philosophy, we can develop launchers capable of rapidly firing light torpedoes. These torpedoes will have reduced destructive power and range compared to current designs but have increased accuracy and tracking capability.
tech_engineering_rapid_675_desc: A specialised, highly manoeuvrable torpedo can be developed to destroy more agile enemy vessels. Due to the unique destructive methodology of polaron torpedoes, they must use a two-stage detonation warhead, which is not effective in this situation. Using a conventional explosive booster in the warhead's first stage will make it effective again, at the cost of a small amount of firepower.
tech_engineering_rapid_681_desc: Exotic matter experiments have yielded the 'Ti' particle, a new type of artificial exotic particle. If a suitable Ti particle generator can be built, they can be used in our torpedoes. This will allow us to remove the conventional explosive booster from the warhead and use the saved space to fit additional capacitors, increasing yield.
tech_engineering_raven_desc: The Aerie vessels are used for a variety of purposes, including service as surveyors and colony ships in both Starfleet and civilian service.
tech_engineering_rocketry_14001_desc: By investigating the effects of applying a small transwarp field prior to the detonation of a torpedo our scientists have concluded that the weapons impact can be significantly increased.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1544_desc: A complex mixture is a mixture that contains too many individual compounds as to allow separation by chromatographic methods. By expanding our methods to produce mixtures with optimal amounts of each compound, we can increase the potency of our fuel source, thus increasing sublight speeds.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1602_desc: Pulse wave technology has increased to the point where its use in torpedo weaponry could be considered. The variable detonation pulses can cause aftershocks upon targets that it has hit.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1604_desc: The creation of short lived non-baryonic matter, that is not made of baryons, the subatomic particles, protons and neutrons of which ordinary matter is composed, allows their usage in bombardments to overwhelm enemy vessels.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1611_desc: By detonating ultra-heavy tricobalt devices at specific frequencies, we can create large gravity maelstroms that will shear and damage enemy vessels, effectively tearing them apart from the inside out.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1612_desc: Using various EM, optical and subspace sensors and scanners, we are now able to accurately detect and avoid mines by finding the energy-signatures and their subspace displacement of the mines.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1613_desc: Breeder chambers allow for the rapid creation of unstable antimatter, which can be used to devastating effect against stationary planetary targets. When the antimatter contacts with regular matter, they both annihilate.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1614_desc: Variable yield is an option available on most modern weapons. It allows the operator to specify a weapon's yield, or explosive power, allowing a single design to be used in different combat situations.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1618_desc: Following the certification of the initial design, there was a desire to explore the potential of this weapon class. Several research labs were instructed to pursue independent branches of photon torpedo design. Now that the program has produced several torpedo variations, it is felt that the time has come to take the most useful parts from each and unify them into a single generalised weapon.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1619_desc: New antimatter containment technology might allow an interlacing pattern of EM bubbles to be formed, each bubble containing either matter or antimatter. Warhead detonation is achieved by shutting down the EM field, removing the separation between the reactants.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1638_desc: These space missiles are armed with fusion warheads which deliver a nuclear payload to their targets. Loading them in batteries allows for volleys of these missiles to be fired simultaneously.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1639_desc: Large space missiles that utilise the same type of hydrogen reactions that occur in the centre of a solar body. These missiles can be loaded into batteries and fired in volleys to increase destructive payload.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1645_desc: The polarity charged Plasma Torpedo loads a higher payload of warp plasma, but requires more energy to contain the plasma while the torpedoes are in their tubes.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1647_desc: Expanding upon previous iterations of phased torpedo technology, the warhead and the catalyst onboard these torpedos can be kept in separate phased instances, only combining once detonation is required. As both warhead and catalyst share the same space but in different phases the resulting explosion can be increased by an order of magnitude.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1651_desc: Containing the warp plasma torpedo in a static warp shell decreases the rate of cohesion lost over time, thus allowing for a much more effective warp plasma torpedo.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1657_desc: When properly detonated, tricobalt warheads deliver an extremely high amount of explosive energy. Due to the difficulty of directing and concentrating these explosions, it has only been used in mining applications. Taking advantage of gravitropic fields and inertial dampers, we might be able to create effective warheads.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1664_desc: Polarons are a quasiparticle with an unexpected quality: they can partially penetrate shields. This is a by-product of the polaron's interaction with the graviton layers in the shield. These torpedoes are capable of piercing the shields of enemy ships and damage vital ship systems, such as engines, weapons, or life support.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1665_desc: Enriching the warhead of polaron torpedoes with unstable muon subatomic particles increases the potency of the warhead substantially.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1666_desc: Enriching the warhead of polaron torpedoes with unstable chroniton particles shifts the torpedo slightly out of phase with our universe, allowing for increased penetration of objects and fields.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1672_desc: Utilising ultra-high energy rails, we can launch tricobalt slugs at enemy vessels at high speeds which not only have explosive energy from the tricobalt but retain a massive amount of kinetic energy too.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1673_desc: Early experiments into temporal mechanics offer numerous potential branches, with one interesting branch found with regards to phased explosives. By destabilising spacetime in a localised area, we can disrupt the very fabric of the universe, destroying whatever is in that location.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1674_desc: Early experiments with space age weaponry have enabled our researchers to develop a weapon that can punch quantum fractures into spacetime at the point of impact by using a condensed beam of chroniton radiation. This weapon can cause targets to fall slightly out of phase, resulting in damage to the systems and hull of the target.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1675_desc: This torpedo warhead compensates for its slow movement by randomly phasing in and out of our spacetime reference before reaching its intended target and detonating with intense radiation, offering improved capabilities against shielded targets.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1676_desc: Improvements to the controlled flux variance result in a powerful projectile capable of phasing in and out of spacetime before reaching its target and detonating.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1677_desc: Experiments with controlling flux variations at random intervals have resulted in this powerful form of targeted projectile. Although capable of being shot down while traveling to its intended target, it compensates for these disadvantages by randomly phasing in and out of our spacetime reference before reaching its intended target and detonating with intense radiation.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1678_desc: Chroniton torpedoes are new experimental ship-mounted weapons based on temporal science. These torpedoes are capable of passing through an enemy's shields due to the fact that they are in a constant state of temporal flux.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1681_desc: These warheads resonate at such high frequencies at the quantum level, and with such intensity, that shields are virtually useless against them. Torpedoes equipped with these warheads would make for very effective shield draining weapons.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1682_desc: Resonance phenomena occur with all types of vibrations or waves. Resonant systems can determine the harmonic resonance of an object and recalibrate our warheads to a similar frequency, allowing for large amounts of atomic destruction as the natural resonance of an object is disrupted.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1683_desc: Calabi Yau manifolds are shapes that satisfy the requirement of space for the six unseen spatial dimensions of string theory, which may be smaller than our currently observable lengths. By manipulating these manifolds, we can increase the energy throughput and storage by a large factor, which increases the estimated warhead yield substantially.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1684_desc: In ultra-high frequency higher harmonic states, the properties of a material react subtly differently to harmonic disruption at a subatomic level which can be manipulated to disrupt the cohesion of an object. By combining new wave oscillation technology with the quantum resonance charges, our vessels can emit a much higher frequency blast using the same energy as before.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1688_desc: The final step into spatial explosive warheads, this torpedo uses a heavy antimatter reaction to create hull busting torpedoes. Shielding, however, is still an issue for spatial torpedoes, with their effectiveness being extremely limited against them.
tech_engineering_rocketry_1690_desc: An antimatter sheath around the plasma torpedo can allow the torpedo to maintain stability and cohesion for longer than previously recorded, which results in an increased payload delivered to the target.
tech_engineering_rocketry_746_desc: It has been decided to improve our tactical options by developing a new weapon: a torpedo-style, variable-yield explosive charge. A suitable explosive was assimilated from species 658, propulsion system from species 337. Records indicate that 89% of species encountered use a metallic substance in their vessel's hull, this will be exploited for the guidance mechanism.
tech_engineering_rotating_606_desc: The structural integrity field was developed to supplement the natural structural integrity of the material their starship hulls were composed of. Engineers use a structural integrity field to supplement the supports and bulkheads that give a spacecraft its shape. Advanced force field generators and arrays make starships even more capable of enduring the elements and forces of interstellar travel.
tech_engineering_sagan_desc: Advances in technology have allowed to revolutionise Starship design and push boundaries to make a design that invokes the past, with all the potential of the future.
tech_engineering_self-replicating_706_de: Our researchers have developed a new mine capable of replicating itself. Replicators transfer material to one another where it is needed in the field through networking. The neighbors of a detonated mine replace the lost mine, material however comes from at least 65 different mines. As stored material begins to run out, the mines have a zero-point extraction system for matter replenishment.
tech_engineering_shangri_la_desc: Inspired by the brilliant mind of Starfleet design consultant Admiral Krause, this design plays a crucial role in complimenting the existing ships within the fleet.
tech_engineering_shield_671_desc: Using a bio-neural gel processor and Thoron shielding, the powerful Quantum torpedo becomes even more accurate, deadlier and harder to destroy in flight, while causing significant damage to shields.
tech_engineering_ship_automation_desc: Advances in AI and automation processes combined with the advanced operations of a starship allow for increased efficiency across the ship.
tech_engineering_sona_desc: The Son'a collector is a massive spacecraft designed by the Son'a to harvest metaphasic radiation from the rings of the planet Ba'ku.
tech_engineering_spaceport_562_desc: Processes for platforms guarding the approaches far away from any planetary orbits without interfering with planetary traffic departing or arriving into the system.
tech_engineering_spaceport_564_desc: Our continued advances in deflector shield technology, has led us with a way, to expand upon our previous designs, that were solely meant for spaceships. Now we are able, to extend the shield deflectors at much larger rate than ever before and as a result we are now able, to apply this technology to our starbases.
tech_engineering_spokane_desc: A major planned refit to these vessels to bring them in line with the lastest technological breakthroughs.
tech_engineering_starship-class_717_desc: As warp travel starts to become an established technology, many new starship designs will need to be created to exploit its potential. The Starship-Class of primary hull, armed with beam weapon ports and torpedo launchers, represents our first attempt at designing a general-purpose starship. As we gain experience with space travel and combat, new roles within our fleets will open up.
tech_engineering_storm_protection_2_desc: Advancements in the practice of altering weather to prevent or cause damaging weather events and ensuring that our environments are protected.
tech_engineering_storm_protection_desc: This is the practice of altering weather to prevent or cause damaging weather events and ensuring that our environments are protected.
tech_engineering_stratified_579_desc: For obtaining coal, and other minerals found in stratified layers; it may be necessary to remove whole hillsides and mountains to obtain these resources.
tech_engineering_structural_605_desc: The structural integrity field was developed to supplement the natural structural integrity of the material their starship hulls were composed of. Engineers use a structural integrity force field to supplement the supports and bulkheads that give a spacecraft its shape. Improved force field generators make starships more capable of enduring the harsh elements and forces of interstellar travel.
tech_engineering_superfluid_575_desc: The production and understanding of superfluid are of immeasurable value to any and every space-age civilisation.
tech_engineering_synchronized_560_desc: Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.
tech_engineering_temporal_699_desc: Improving the parametric chroniton variation algorithms on our chroniton torpedoes should allow for improved shield piercing and armour penetration.
tech_engineering_tetraburnium_618_desc: The new alloy of kelindide and tetraburnium is much stronger than either material by itself. Further research into implementation within the fleet is required.
tech_engineering_texas_desc: Designed to be the next stage in the automatic ship design process, capable of going into dangerous situations and reacting faster than crewed ships.
tech_engineering_theta-matrix_596_desc: The extreme energy and force that a dilithium crystal experiences will slowly break down its crystalline structure. Using a combination of high energy theta radiation and warp plasma, it is possible to force it to crystallise. Theta radiation and warp plasma are both available at a warp core and so the dilithium crystal can be processed without having to be removed from its core assembly.
tech_engineering_transphasic_701_desc: The transphasic warhead is based on generating a destructive subspace compression pulse. Upon detonation the torpedo delivers the pulse in an asymmetric superposition of multiple phase states. Shields can only block one subcomponent of the pulse. The other subcomponents deliver the majority of the pulse to the target.
tech_engineering_tricobalt_695_desc: Dicobalt has an atomic mass twice that of regular cobalt, with a multiplicative effect on the explosive potential. It is, however, unstable and requires specialised equipment to be developed in order to weaponise it.
tech_engineering_tricobalt_696_desc: Tricobalt is a new type of explosive that could be used as anything between a small anti-personnel explosive to weapons of mass destruction to destroy large installations, such as space stations. Compared to dicobalt, the thermokinetic explosion yield of tricobalt is measured in tons or by the amount of subspace distortion they produced, in cochranes.
tech_engineering_tricolbat_705_desc: Tricobalt is a heavy, volatile element, that is an effective explosive material. This variety and effectiveness allows tricobalt to be utilised in many forms of explosives.
tech_engineering_trititanium_613_desc: Tritanium is a metallic alloy which is about 20 times harder than diamonds. If we are able to discover how to melt it, we can apply this alloy to make our ships more durable.
tech_engineering_type-8_668_desc: High-strength, low-density materials have made some promising advances recently. We should assign a torpedo research team to investigate their suitability for use in torpedo casings. Hopefully a stronger, lighter case can be developed, allowing the warhead to be enlarged and the launch velocity increased.
tech_engineering_ullage_640_desc: Although more advanced propulsion systems are now the standard, older-style chemical thrusters have a range of uses. The latest high-performance fuel to be synthesised is a liquid called Gronerium. Before we can begin using this fuel, we must design a modern, liquid-fuel storage system, overcoming the reliability problems inherent to using liquid-fueled thrusters in low-gravity environments.
tech_engineering_undine_battleship_desc: The Battleship is one of the largest most powerful ships in the fluidic fleet. Offering greater firepower and threat both within Fluidic Space and in the outside realm.
tech_engineering_undine_bioship_2_desc: We have been improvements to our standard bioship, improving its size, speed and capacity for destruction.
tech_engineering_undine_cruiser_desc: The universe of non-fluidic space is alien to us, we have further adapted our designs to support larger and more powerful ships to make our mark across the galaxy.
tech_engineering_undine_destroyer_desc: The universe of non-fluidic space is alien to us, we have further adapted our ships to provide more damage.
tech_engineering_undine_exterminator_des: The universe contains an abundance of the impure, our Exterminators are there to see that their existence is a short one.
tech_engineering_undine_infest_desc: The Fluidic realm must expand and experience the perfectation that comes from life within the Fluidic domain. The Infester ship spreads the Undine biological infection to other worlds and species to consume them.
tech_engineering_undine_vanquish_desc: The Vanquisher is designed with one purpose, to clear threats from Fluidic Space with fire and might. Few vessels can match its power in either space.
tech_engineering_victurium_14016_desc: The newly modified fusion of alloys Victurium and tetraburnium are much stronger than either material by itself. Further research into implementation within the fleet is required.
tech_engineering_victurium_14017_desc: The merging of a victurium-tritanium mesh adds the strongest possible protection with minimal weight added to the hull.
tech_engineering_vigilant_desc: The next evolution of the Defiant Class escort, providing a sleeker profile and learning from the lessons that the Defiant Class creating a modern escort vessel.
tech_engineering_warp_694_desc: Warp Plasma Torpedoes utilise warp drive plasma as the weapon's armament, requiring vast amounts of ships energy reserves to fire but causing significant shield and hull damage. The weapons range is severely limited however, which means that it is only effective at close quarters combat.
tech_engineering_xindi_cracker_desc: Based on technology that cannot be explained that seems to come from another century, the Xindi Probe weapons are ships of mass destruction.
tech_engineering_yoyager_a_desc: Starfleet Engineers look over the returning USS Voyager with a sense of excitement, to see what advancement she found in the Delta Quadrant.
tech_engineering_zero_583_desc: Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.
tech_espionage_decrypt_1_desc: Simple DDoS based attack methods are used to brute force entry into systems that are lightly defended.
tech_espionage_decrypt_2_desc: The war between hacking and cyber defense continues with advancement in processing speeds comes greater methods of brute force and guile base attacks.
tech_espionage_decrypt_3_desc: Experts in the field have have driven the ability of our intrusion systems to become near unmatched and capable of penetrating almost any target using every means at their disposal.
tech_espionage_encrypt_1_desc: The process of converting information or data into a code, especially to prevent unauthorized access utilising software devised by our computer science teams.
tech_espionage_encrypt_2_desc: Using technology breakthroughs and faster processing speeds our encryptions methods are able to apply more advanced cyphers.
tech_espionage_encrypt_3_desc: The latest in security engineering has devised the most complex encryption protocols yet uncrackable by all but the most sophisticated software.
tech_fallen_empires_desc: This was once an ancient and proud race before it befell a calamity. Its ancient knowledge is still stored deep inside...
tech_fusion_torpedo_desc: Nuclear fusion is a reaction in which two or more atomic nuclei come close enough to form one or more different atomic nuclei and subatomic particles with the difference in mass between the reactants and products manifesting as the release of large amounts of energy, ideal for warheads for our vessels.
tech_hero_ships_desc: The pinnacle of our technologies should be incorporated into a vessel that can act as the flagship of our fleet.
tech_interlink_alcove_desc: Drones have neural implants that link them to the hive mind. The potential of the implants is limited by two factors; communications bandwidth and power consumption. Fully solving these problems is currently beyond us. However, a temporary solution is to adapt our regeneration alcoves. Regenerating drones' brains will be interlinked, forming an organic computer core to supplement the main core.
tech_jem_hadar_cloning_desc: The Jem'Hadar are a genetically-engineered species. Having a species that's bred for war can lead to a destructive force that can be feared throughout the galaxy, since after all 'Victory is life'. If we are to have such a destructive force, then it also helps to have a chemical that keeps them in check by making them addicted to it, or lest the species that serves us now becomes our conqueror.
tech_kdf_design_desc: As warriors of Kahless, we seek glory for our House and our Empire. This expands to our ship design, where ships are crewed by small crews rather than sharing the glory amongst a large one.
tech_kentaran_pox_1_desc: The Kentaran pox, originally thought to be a mild form of measles, is in fact one of the most deadly diseases we have seen. Each burst blister immediately sears the flesh with massive amounts of pain, shutting the body down due to shock. New radical treatments could treat the symptoms and stop the spread.
tech_kentaran_pox_2_desc: A vaccine to immunise the remaining population against the Kentaran Pox can now be developed. Utilising modified dermal regenerators, we can also cure the remaining population with the pox.
tech_ketracel_white_desc: To help ensure the loyalty of our Jem'Hadar soldiers, Ketracel White is required. We have to know where the resources are to produce it. In order to be certain that the White is potent, its ingredients must be highly distilled.
tech_klingon_society_desc: Our songs sing of glorious battles from history and of warriors who accomplished much whilst using weapons and technology centuries old. Perhaps we should look to the past to secure our future?
tech_kobali_tissue_desc: The process of the revitalisation of necrotic tissue and adjustment to the DNA to create new members of the Kobali race is a unique medical technology.
tech_krenim_bombardment_desc: High focused Chroniton beams focused down an imaging array capable of causing utter devastation.
tech_laurentian_plague_1_desc: The deadly Laurentian Plague, which kills those infected via overstimulation, can now be treated with new stimulants to slow down the disease.
tech_laurentian_plague_2_desc: A cure for the remaining population against the Laurentian Plague can now be developed. Utilising modified myelin regenerators, we can also cure the remaining population with the plague.
tech_living_state_desc: As many races so painfully learnt in previous centuries, populations can expand to exceed the resources that can be provided for them. How can we control this?
tech_manxilite_corruption_1_desc: The Manxilite Corruption, which works by infecting the crystalline pathways of the victims, is a highly complex pathogen. We have learnt enough about it to be able to research a treatment to slow it down, if not cure it.
tech_manxilite_corruption_2_desc: A cure for Manxilite Corruption can now be developed. Utilising modified thrombic modulators to convert the blood back to normal, we can also cure the remaining infected population.
tech_mineral_processing_1_desc: Advances in material construction allow for drills and tunnels to reach further into a planet's surface. By breaking through the crust and mantle, we may be able to access materials deep within the core.
tech_monoclinic_paguphage_1_desc: The horrific Monoclinic Paguphage, which de-crystallises the helixes within living beings, is extremely deadly when unleashed in large population centres. We should now be able to research a treatment to slow down, if not cure the paguphage.
tech_monoclinic_paguphage_2_desc: A cure for the Monoclinic Paguphage can now be developed. Utilising modified protodynoplasers, we can also cure the remaining infected population.
tech_nuclear_torpedo_desc: Nuclear torpedoes use fissile material to create a powerful explosion. This explosive can be used as a warhead and can be put on top a missile and loaded and fired at a target.
tech_optical_sensor_desc: These sensors have been tuned to detect anything on the visible part of the EM spectrum.
tech_particle_phaser_1_desc: A hybrid nadion/heavy particle beam that works to weaken and smash apart the atomic structure of the target. The increased engineering complexity over a nadion-only phaser makes this a rarer, albeit potentially more potent, design.
tech_patrol_frigate_desc: Patrol frigates are our first line of defense against spacefaring enemies. Although they are equipped with relatively weak armaments, they are rather mobile and are quite cheap and quick to produce.
tech_phase_interlocker_spec_desc: Customisable interlocks can be used to shunt warp plasma to different systems rapidly, resulting in improved energy where it is needed.
tech_phaser_1_desc: Phasers fire nadions, an artificially created particle, at their target. Nadion particles interfere with the nuclear forces that bind atoms together. Unusually versatile, nadion beams can be adapted for many uses such as heating, drilling, stunning, killing, disintegrating, and more.
tech_phaser_cannon_1_desc: Basic plasma-based pulse cannons. Due to the importance of mastering plasma for building warp-capable starships, these are often one of the first viable directed-energy weapons a civilisation will develop. Although able to break up asteroids and meteors, their low range and yield hinders their effectiveness against starship armour and shields. Wise users seek an upgrade at the first opportunity.
tech_phaser_tech_desc: Phase weapons, or phase-modulated energy weapons, are a type of directed-energy particle weapon that utilized a phase modulator to control the blast yield.
tech_physics_01038_desc: Utilising quantum entanglement, where two particles are connected over an infinite distance at the quantum level, this transportation technology would theoretically allow the transportation of goods over a vast distance.
tech_physics_01045_desc: The designs for a large holographic training environment, suitable for training entire divisions to simulate enemy assaults, are underway. This should allow our troops to train without costly exercises.
tech_physics_01048_desc: Integrating a holomatrix into the design of key buildings allows for holograms to wander the hallways and rooms of a building untethered by the standard constrictions of a holodeck. This could have multiple uses, from a hospital staffed mostly by medical holograms, to a school with holographic tutors.
tech_physics_01078_desc: Breaking the programming of their creators, the APUs can gain the ability to operate autonomously of their extinct masters will.
tech_physics_01079_desc: The drive to 'feel' as our creators once did has led to the potential creation of synthetic emotion chips, designed to instill a wide range of emotions that living beings so often prize.
tech_physics_01080_desc: The ability for two units to calculate the same event but both take separate and different actions is one that has eluded us since our creation.
tech_physics_01081_desc: Improvements to our targeting and control algorithms can lead to more rapid and effective combat performance of individual APUs
tech_physics_01231_desc: Temporal transporters are a major advancement on regular transporter technology, potentially allowing the user to transport to a desired space and time within range. The tactical and geopolitical implications of this technology are massive.
tech_physics_01248_desc: By infusing faster than light particles, or Tachyons, into the Navigational Deflector, we can briefly see objects before we impact them when travelling at superluminal velocities.
tech_physics_01249_desc: Theoretically, the quantum slipstream drive operates by routing energy through the vessel's main deflector, which then focused a quantum field, allowing the vessel to penetrate the quantum barrier. In order to maintain the slipstream, the phase variance of the quantum field has to be constantly adjusted, or the slipstream would collapse, violently throwing the ship back into normal space.
tech_physics_01254_desc: The apex of single ring coleopteric theory allow us to create superior warp engines. Non-linear mathematical theory will be required for further advances.
tech_physics_01262_desc: The creation of a neutronic antiproton field within the quantum singularity warp core allows for a larger, more stable singularity.
tech_physics_01270_desc: Further improvements to our transwarp coil technology have allowed for the prototyping of a coil matrix, which combines the plasma requirements with a vast interlocking matrix, resulting in improved access to transwarp space.
tech_physics_01276_desc: The energy requirements to send vessels through transwarp across large distances is exorbitant. Potentially, large structures known as 'gateways' can be constructed which would allow rapid transport across a transwarp network.
tech_physics_01288_desc: The Higgs field is a field of energy that is thought to exist in every region of the universe. The result of a particle gaining mass from the field is the prevention of its ability to travel at the speed of light. By being able to adjust this field, our vessels should be able to move rapidly over short distances, ensuring they can evade enemy weapons.
tech_physics_01298_desc: By sheathing the filament spinners in an antimatter web, a superluminal web can be constructed which further clamps down upon enemy vessels.
tech_physics_01304_desc: Further iterations of adaptive shield technology allow for a rotating force field frequency at all times, to ensure that enemy weapons cannot adapt to our frequencies.
tech_physics_01305_desc: Algorithmic enhancements to the shielding harmonics allow for an improved force field technology.
tech_physics_01340_desc: The creation of a massive interwoven defensive forcefield across the entire Unicomplex requires a large investment in resources and energy in order to maintain effective protectiveness across the entire nexus.
tech_physics_01341_desc: The Mycelial network spans not only the known universe, but underpinned all quantum realities. By tapping in to the quantum power from the network, we can absorb power from infinite universes. The reactor pulls power directly out of the network in a way that may prevent it from regenerating itself, and may in fact poison it, spreading infection back up into the mycelial system.
tech_physics_01343_desc: The quantum singularities onboard the bioships can now reach into subspace within non fluidic space, allowing for a much larger energy source for propulsion.
tech_physics_01344_desc: The singularities onboard the bioships can now touch the fluidic dimensions from whence they came, allowing for faster travel across the dark non fluidic wastelands.
tech_physics_01345_desc: Drawing power directly from fluidic space, the singularities propel the bioships faster through the cosmos.
tech_physics_01346_desc: Shunting large pockets of fluidic space through into this realm through trans dimensional rifts allows for direct access to power from fluidic space. This allows rapid propulsion across the cosmos.
tech_physics_01347_desc: Adapted bioships can now rapidly shunt fluidic space through the propulsion systems, achieving higher speeds than ever before.
tech_physics_01348_desc: The living hulls of the bioships redesign themselves to shunt fluidic space through the interdimensional rifts into this space, boosting energy levels and allowing for rapid propulsion.
tech_physics_01349_desc: The pinnacle of fluidic space propulsion actually transfers part of the bioship across dimensions, drawing in power from fluidic space and then oscillating back into this universe and releasing that energy, providing the quickest warp speeds.
tech_physics_01350_desc: Gravimetric logic banks cross check and discard illogical data sets allowing for improved sensor output.
tech_physics_01351_desc: Strong force field technology ensures the integrity of Tellarite vessels when arguments break out.
tech_physics_01352_desc: Combined shielding and bulkhead technology allows for improvements to containment system technology. Ideally we could combine them into one unit.
tech_physics_01503_desc: The Plasmadyne Relay is a component of a starship's warp drive systems, capable of improving quantum efficiency. To protect the converter interface from failure due to excessive warp field stress, a secondary inverter may be required.
tech_physics_01505_desc: Improvements to our weaponry allows for improved damage to an enemy vessels shields.
tech_physics_01506_desc: Improvements to our weaponry allows for improved damage to an enemy vessels armour.
tech_physics_01507_desc: Improvements to our weaponry allows for improved damage to an enemy vessels hull.
tech_physics_01513_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on improving light weaponry.
tech_physics_01514_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on improving heavy weaponry.
tech_physics_01516_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on adapting weaponry in order to damage armour.
tech_physics_01517_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on adapting weaponry in order to damage shields.
tech_physics_01518_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on adapting artillery weaponry to be more destructive.
tech_physics_01519_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on adapting weaponry in order to damage hulls.
tech_physics_01520_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on adapting weaponry in order to improve point defence.
tech_physics_01526_desc: The plasmadyne relay is a component of a starship's warp drive systems, capable of improving quantum efficiency.
tech_physics_01527_desc: Breaking down the bonds of atoms within a vessels hull is a surefire way to ensure maximum armour damage.
tech_physics_01528_desc: Scattering a field at faster than light speeds across a region can result in a massive spread of damage.
tech_physics_01529_desc: The plasmadyne relay is a component of a starship's warp drive systems, capable of improving quantum efficiency. By inverting the phase of the warp plasma, further improvements can be made.
tech_physics_01530_desc: Breaking down the subatomic bonds of atoms within a vessels hull is a surefire way to ensure maximum damage.
tech_physics_01531_desc: Scattering a field across subspace in a region can result in massively broad pattern, resulting in damage to ships even in warp.
tech_physics_01532_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on improving medium weaponry.
tech_physics_01533_desc: Advances in laser weaponry allow for the potential of constructing lightspeed laser weapons known as Guardian lasers.
tech_physics_01534_desc: An optronic weapons array is a type of advanced weapon system that fires optronic pulses; however, careful cooling is required.
tech_physics_01541_desc: A secondary tactical node allows for secondary tasks such as command and control, or tactical system scanning to be achieved without reducing the effectiveness of the primary consoles.
tech_physics_01548_desc: Improved power and plasma functions allow for the components of an aceton assimilator to be miniaturised, whilst simultaneously improving performance.
tech_physics_01555_desc: Our enhanced dissipator further disrupts and dampens the formation of energy within foreign intermix chambers, reducing the power of enemy weapons
tech_physics_01613_desc: The creation of a matrix allows for the adjustment of phaser beam coefficients rapidly and without the requirement for flux capacitors.
tech_physics_01626_desc: The phaser beam can be modulated to oscillate slightly, aiming to introduce a disruptive interference pattern in the strong and weak nuclear forces between two locations. When successful, a larger area loses atomic cohesion than would be possible with a standard phaser.
