tech_physics_01637_desc: A covariant phaser pulse is a theorised, specialised directed-energy discharge capable of taking advantage of phase retractions, an energy phenomenon which can occur when power is transferred from one system to another in an enemy vessel's shield configuration.
tech_physics_01642_desc: Capacitor technology increases and miniaturisation allow for the reduction of ship mounted phaser cannons to a mobile, ground suitable device. Firing small phaser bursts in a rotating gatling configuration results in low cooling requirements and heavy damage potential.
tech_physics_01660_desc: Mixing the phaser coils with small amounts of prefiring plasma allows for bursts of potent phase energy. Further work is required on the stability of the plasma and mixing of the phased energy.
tech_physics_01661_desc: Technology has advanced enough to finally put some of the more outlandish designs into operation. One of which is an extra-large spinal-mounted phaser emitter, capable of launching a powerful phaser blast able to penetrate through entire ships.
tech_physics_01662_desc: Phasers and disruptors produce nadions when they are fired. A nadion is an artificially-generated particle capable of liberating atomic nuclei, disrupting nuclear forces. By researching ways to utilise this byproduct, we could improve out weapon technology substantially.
tech_physics_01664_desc: A large spinal mount allows for almost unheard of amounts of power to be pushed into a single weapon mount, creating a blast capable of destroying ships outright.
tech_physics_01665_desc: Initially conceived by accident, the auto-phaser interlock is a byproduct of phaser technology. By configuring the beams together and activating the interlock, the ship's main deflector can release a powerful beam of energy.
tech_physics_01666_desc: Phasers and plasma weapons work on different principles. Attempting to combine the destructive mechanisms of both technologies may yield an increase in weapon effectiveness.
tech_physics_01667_desc: Starbase weaponry allows for heavy phaser mounts to be built directly into the superstructure and power grid, allowing for long-range powerful weaponry.
tech_physics_01668_desc: The phaser beam can be modulated to oscillate slightly, aiming to introduce a disruptive interference pattern in the strong and weak nuclear forces between two locations. When successful, a larger area loses atomic cohesion than would be possible with a standard phaser.
tech_physics_01669_desc: A starbase-mounted covariant phaser pulse is a theorised, specialised directed-energy discharge capable of taking advantage of phase retractions, an energy phenomenon which can occur when power is transferred from one system to another in an enemy vessel shield configuration.
tech_physics_01670_desc: Improvements to the storage chambers for the phased plasma allow for the plasma to be kept at a less stable, but more potent, intermix ratio, resulting in a larger destructive impact.
tech_physics_01671_desc: Rotating intermix chambers allow for the unstable plasma to be passed from chamber to chamber and kept at a very high energy state which, when released, results in a burst of phased plasma energy with devastating impact.
tech_physics_01717_desc: The power requirements and technology to create our own hadrons at will allows for improved long-range engagement and tracking.
tech_physics_01754_desc: Thalaron Weapons are weapons that employ Thalaron radiation, a type of radiation in the tertiary EM band with biogenic properties, able to consume organic matter at the subatomic level. It is even more deadly as even a small amount would expand at a dangerous rate. One way these weapons could be utilised is a cascading biogenic pulse.
tech_physics_01755_desc: Plasma disruptors are good weapons, but creating a specialised mounted version of them should bring new benefits. A concentrated plasma disruptor pulse is theorised to be able to punch a several centimetre wide hole in shields. Some plasma should damage the armour and bleed through to the hull. Adapting unused, compact cannon designs is the logical choice for implementing this kind of weapon.
tech_physics_01756_desc: Fitting the firing chamber with a high-energy-tolerant phase discriminator, coupled to a phase modulator, will enable the fire control computer to create a sympathetic resonance in the disruptor pulse. The resonance will increase the disruptive effect on the target more than simply boosting the pulse energy.
tech_physics_01757_desc: Improvements to manufacturing have allowed for the fitting of a firing chamber with an extremely-high-energy-tolerant phase discriminator, coupled to a resonating phase modulator. The modulator can find the optimum resonance of the hull to cause maximum disruption and damage, enabling the fire control computer to create a sympathetic resonance in the disruptor pulse that disrupts a target.
tech_physics_01758_desc: Utilising energy pulses in combination with disruptor guiding systems, we may be able to develop an enhanced disruptor with a variable phased output.
tech_physics_01807_desc: The inherent instability of plasma is what makes it a potent weapon. By researching new methods of containing the plasma in its unstable state, we can ensure the most potent plasma is released.
tech_physics_01808_desc: Improvements to the containment fields and plasma generation allow for the containment of temperatures that are beyond just 'heat'. At this stage, they are reaching Absolute Hot, the temperature at which the Planck lengths were first formed during the birth of the universe.
tech_physics_01830_desc: Weaponising the unstable and dangerous warp plasma created by propulsion systems allows for large arcing areas where vessels simply cannot exist.
tech_physics_01831_desc: Plasma weaponry often causes damage after a battle due to its caustic effects, spreading out over a larger area than the inital target. By utilising these effects, we can create a nimbus that applies damage over a larger area.
tech_physics_01832_desc: Miniaturisation of plasma cannons is now possible, but it remains highly unstable and potentially explosive due to the inherent nature of unstable plasma. On the other hand, maximisation of plasma cannons should allow for very powerful blasts.
tech_physics_01833_desc: By forcing plasma through the tight lanes of a mounted cannon, we can create a highly destructive weapon mount that fires extremely-high-temperature plasma at enemy targets.
tech_physics_01834_desc: Mounting unstable warp plasma within a cannon is a highly dangerous, but destructive, weapon.
tech_physics_01908_desc: Advances to flak dispersal and custom-designed antimatter pellets could lead to improvements in the usage of antimatter spreads. Still easily deflected by shielding, the pellets should at least cover a larger area.
tech_physics_01909_desc: Containing the antimatter pellets within regular matter sheaths, courtesy of containment fields, should allow for improved shield penetration and dispersal of antimatter particles.
tech_physics_01910_desc: Initially a theoretical fallacy, the deadly crimson field has become a potential reality by splitting the hydrogen atoms that sheath the antimatter into a large area, resulting in thousands of tiny atomic explosions across an area.
tech_physics_01917_desc: Fixed platforms provide a stable platform for weaponry. Breeder chambers built into the platform can quickly replenish antimatter supplies, allowing for a sustained bombardment of antimatter beams.
tech_physics_01922_desc: Operating under the same principles as laser weaponry, mounted muon blasters convert energy-rich gases into a glowing muon particle beam that can melt through targets.
tech_physics_01923_desc: Operating under the same principles as laser weaponry, mounted gluon blasters convert energy-rich gas to a glowing gluon particle beam that can melt through targets.
tech_physics_01926_desc: Capacitor technology increases and miniaturisation allow for the reduction of ship-mounted antimatter weaponry to a mobile, ground suitable device. Firing small bursts of antimatter in a large arc results in low cooling requirements and heavy damage potential.
tech_physics_01936_desc: A metreon is a particle which can take the form of both radiation and gas. Metreon particles have been demonstrated to react with dark matter and even to have temporal properties. In their gaseous form, metreon particles are extremely volatile and are easily ignited via weapons fire.
tech_physics_01937_desc: The metreonic radiation could potentially be directed into a beam when combined with plasma; however, the stability of this would be extremely poor.
tech_physics_01938_desc: Bursts of plasma can contain more metreonic radiation and particles; however, they remain particularly unstable.
tech_physics_01939_desc: By combining the reactive metreon particles with a focused dark matter beam, it may be possible to ignite the metreon particles and cause a cascade reaction.
tech_physics_01940_desc: Improvements to the dark matter beam emitters allow the pre-excitement of the dark matter, resulting in much more potent and rapid destructive potential.
tech_physics_01941_desc: The combination of dark matter and metreon particles has resulted in the creation of metreon isotopes. Their half-life is very short, but they do emit large amounts of energy.
tech_physics_01943_desc: A potentially galaxy changing weapon, the cascade uses unstable metreon isotopes to create a devastating explosion. The resulting radiation poisoning will likely kill those who are not destroyed by the initial blast.
tech_physics_01944_desc: The metreonic lance is a large, fixed-mount weapon that utilises extremely high energy to create a metreon cascade reaction at long ranges.
tech_physics_01945_desc: Biopulse weapons can be grown that fire powerful energetic bolts from the hull of our living bioships that could be destructive to enemy ships.
tech_physics_01946_desc: Improvements to the growth of bio-pulse weaponry allow for sustained beams rather than short bursts.
tech_physics_01947_desc: Mixing the standard biopulse with the positively charged protons within this universe cause an improved reaction upon impact.
tech_physics_01948_desc: Mixing the standard biopulse with the negatively charged antiprotons within this universe cause an improved reaction upon impact.
tech_physics_01949_desc: Mixing antiprotonic weaponry from this universe with antiprotonic weaponry from our own fluidic universe creates a highly unstable, yet powerful, beam that can be produced from our bioships.
tech_physics_01950_desc: Drawing energy directly from our own dimension allows for our bioships to fire almost continuously with powerful antiprotonic weaponry.
tech_physics_01951_desc: A directed-energy weapon is a theoretical weapon system that inflicts damage at a target by emission of highly focused energy, including laser, microwaves, and particle beams.
tech_physics_01952_desc: By combining the bio pulse with highly focused energy, it may be possible to create a directed bio pulse for highly accurate damaging shots.
tech_physics_01953_desc: By focusing the energy of a nearby bioship upon the absorbing hull of a focusing vessel, we can improve the devastation of our beams by a magnitude of 10. Further research is required into the multiplicative effect of numerous bioships firing upon a single focusing target.
tech_physics_01954_desc: The research into this universe's particles and microwaves has resulted in directed fluidic energy. Theoretically it should be possible to weaponise this.
tech_physics_01955_desc: Subspace radiation is a form of radiation associated with subspace phenomena. By turning into a weapon, it should be possible to create weaponry with warp field collapsing properties.
tech_physics_01956_desc: Further developments in subspace research have come across a lower subspace band below the initial layer of subspace. Radiation and particles are much more potent and unstable than regular subspace.
tech_physics_01957_desc: Breaching through lower-subspace has given thought to a band of subspace that is in a dimension higher than our own. The potential from breaching higher-subspace could be immense.
tech_physics_01958_desc: Subspace radiation is a form of radiation associated with subspace phenomena. By projecting the radiation across an area, it should be possible to create a field with warp field collapsing properties.
tech_physics_01959_desc: As vessels shield their propulsion system against subspace radiation, more powerful subspace generators are required to store and then surge energy across an area, disrupting their warp fields.
tech_physics_01960_desc: A major step in warp field disruption, the ability to create subspace fractures in real space can disrupt warp energy across large areas.
tech_physics_01961_desc: Composed of a large matter-antimatter charge surrounded by a set of concentric shells composed of Verterium Cortenide and Tungsten-Cobalt-Magnesium, the Isolytic charge is a powerful, yet unpredictable, weapon. In many cases, subspace tears form as the isolytic charges break holes in the spacetime continuum.
tech_physics_01962_desc: Using the power of isolytic weaponry, it should be possible to utilise the side effect of subspace tears forming to shred enemy vessels.
tech_physics_02004_desc: Interplexing the neutronic beams to put them out of phase will further destabilize the atomic cohesion of a target.
tech_physics_02012_desc: Fixed mounts and cooling brackets allow for extremely-high-energy polaron bursts, blasting quasiparticles across large distances.
tech_physics_02016_desc: Capacitor technology increases and miniaturisation allow for the reduction of ship-mounted polaron cannons to a mobile, ground suitable device. Firing small bursts of polarons in a rotating Gatling configuration results in low cooling requirements and heavy damage potential.
tech_physics_02026_desc: Neutronic weapons are directed energy weapons that are saturated with radiolytic isotopes. By affixing mounts to vessels, we could create a lance of neutronic energy.
tech_physics_02027_desc: Focused heavy polaron beams can be utilised upon starbases to cause extremely potent long-range polaron attacks.
tech_physics_02028_desc: The most significant change to the installation of this fixed mount weapon will be the use of multiple polaron generators to coat the beam in differently charged polarons.
tech_physics_02029_desc: Large polaron generators can be installed upon starbases which can flip their polarisation whilst live, resulting in a beam that flips polarity rapidly, adding charge shock to the target.
tech_physics_02122_desc: The tertiary subspace manifold is one of many domains located in the myriad layers of subspace. Many solanogen-based lifeforms call the tertiary subspace manifold their home, which emits a subspace energy level of 16.2 keV. By creating an extruder which taps into the tertiary subspace manifold, we can claim that energy for ourselves.
tech_physics_02139_desc: Capacitor technology increases and miniaturisation allow for the reduction of ship-mounted tetryon cannons to a mobile, ground-suitable device. Firing small bursts of tetryons in a rotating Gatling configuration results in low cooling requirements and heavy damage potential.
tech_physics_02149_desc: Bolstered tetryon emitters could potentially allow for a direct link to subspace in order to bombard targets with tetryonic radiation.
tech_physics_02150_desc: Utilisation of subspace gravitons within a beam emplacement should allow for an accurate and damaging weapon, capable of transmitting gravitation force upon impact.
tech_physics_02151_desc: Utilisation of faster-than-light tachyons within a beam emplacement should allow for an accurate and damaging weapon.
tech_physics_02152_desc: Directed temporal core energy can potentially be directed into a weapon that will ricochet throughout time, disrupting space-time around the impact point.
tech_physics_02153_desc: Further research into directed temporal core energy can create a weapon that will ricochet throughout time, disrupting and even erasing space-time around the impact point.
tech_physics_02154_desc: The fixed barrels of previous cannons can be replaced with a set of rotating barrels in a Gatling configuration. The ability to fire a greater number of smaller tetryon pulses will reduce the proportion of the pulse that hits with suboptimal convergence.
tech_physics_11001_desc: To every action there is an equal but opposite reaction. The fundamental laws that govern our understanding of space and time are here.
tech_physics_11006_desc: Initial forays into utilising transporter technology for more complex goods have resulted in this technology. Large dishes behind the pad serve as a focal point for matter transport, which, whilst extremely power intensive, results in successful transportation of organic and inorganic matter.
tech_physics_11014_desc: Matter synthesis is the dematerialization of matter via synthesizers and rematerialization as something else.
tech_physics_11017_desc: Entertainment at the touch of a button. Vast amounts of digital entertainment are now available at the fingertips of almost every race.
tech_physics_11018_desc: The quality of holographic communication is now suitable for use in long-range transmissions across space. However, the data is large and easy to intercept.
tech_physics_11035_desc: A neural core is a processing unit that takes the modeled workings of how an organic brain operates and attempts to replicate it.
tech_physics_11036_desc: Larger power supplies enable a neural core to undertake more calculations and processes than a regular neural core.
tech_physics_11037_desc: Improvements to the growth of organic compounds allows for larger synaptic pathways and processing ability.
tech_physics_11038_desc: Using pulses of bioenergy, we can simulate the firing of synapses, enabling a short-term memory to be created in the organic computational nodes.
tech_physics_11039_desc: Linking the computational nodes with the crew in an integrated bioprocessor is the next step in organic computational progress.
tech_physics_11040_desc: Combining the crew with the neural bioprocessor allows for a vast network to be created across a bioship.
tech_physics_11041_desc: Combining the bio energy with an artificial intelligence allows for almost sentient computer processing in real-time.
tech_physics_11043_desc: Integrated design and processing abilities with a central plexus allows for improved computational abilities.
tech_physics_11044_desc: A central AI core is the heart of a vessel and allows for networked communication between the crew of the vessels.
tech_physics_11045_desc: Larger AI nodes should allow for more automated personnel units to be linked together within our vessels, improving overall efficiency.
tech_physics_11046_desc: By utilising a distributed network where real-time processing is managed directly, while secondary routines are shunted off onto low-powered automated personnel units, the efficiency of our vessels' computational power should increase.
tech_physics_11047_desc: After the distributed network, entangling the artificial intelligence with APU crew ensures a fully real-time computational network.
tech_physics_11048_desc: The final step is linking numerous automated personnel unit vessels together into a fully entangled crew AI network, allowing data to be shared instantaneously as if that unit had discovered it immediately.
tech_physics_11054_desc: Understanding the limitations of a unit and allowing for it to decide where its labour is best utilised reduces the overall demand on processing functions.
tech_physics_11063_desc: Mechanical replacements for body parts are called cybernetic implants. They are often used by crew members who are either damaged or electing to give up part of their body for a specific mechanical improvement.
tech_physics_11095_desc: Introspective prioritisation allows for internal improvements that would otherwise not be understood.
tech_physics_11096_desc: Calculations have improved to allow us to decipher the information from sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
tech_physics_11097_desc: Multiphasic sensors can penetrate even the most advanced interference caused by natural and unnatural means, leading to vastly increased range and detection capabilities. The ability to use this new information is restricted by our ability to process it, requiring new algorithms.
tech_physics_11098_desc: Shortages can cause a spirally cascade effect, leading to degradation of core systems. A process to halt this spiral can be undertaken by reverting existing infrastructure into new nanite production facilities.
tech_physics_11101_desc: The distribution of many voices throughout the Collective ensures no drone is ever truly alone.
tech_physics_11102_desc: Processing issues that are resolved locally without requiring the real-time computation of one of the central harmonisation computers improves the efficiency of the Collective for all.
tech_physics_11103_desc: The algorithms that power the iterative calculations of drones dedicated to research can be improved substantially with new mathematical models; however, it will require a redesign of the drone cybernetics in order to process the new information.
tech_physics_11104_desc: Nodes dedicated to real-time data on space battles can process, simulate, and calculate the odds for each avenue of attack.
tech_physics_11105_desc: Nodes dedicated to real-time data in ground battles can process, simulate, and calculate the odds for each avenue of attack or defense.
tech_physics_11241_desc: The Underspace is a network of subspace corridors that extended through a large area of the Delta Quadrant, allowing starships to traverse vast distances in a short time.
tech_physics_11282_desc: Hiding our vessels has long been a tactician's dream. Our new approach is based on metamaterials, artificial arrangements of resonators with unusual electromagnetic properties which can redirect light.
tech_physics_11282b_desc: Hiding our vessels has long been a tactician's dream. Our new approach is based on metamaterials, artificial arrangements of resonators with unusual electromagnetic properties which can redirect light.
tech_physics_11283_desc: The dampening of external emissions and storage of all waste heat will be required to hide our vessels from sensors.
tech_physics_11283b_desc: The dampening of external emissions and storage of all waste heat will be required to hide our vessels from sensors.
tech_physics_11285_desc: Holoemitters can hide the true capabilities and shape of our vessels, sowing discord in the opponents ranks.
tech_physics_11285b_desc: Holoemitters can hide the true capabilities and shape of our vessels, sowing discord in the opponents ranks.
tech_physics_11287_desc: By tying in a large enough power generator with dual shield and cloaking devices, it should be possible to maintain deflector shields whilst cloaked.
tech_physics_11287b_desc: By tying in a large enough power generator with dual shield and cloaking devices, it should be possible to maintain deflector shields whilst cloaked.
tech_physics_11340_desc: Most species lack detailed knowledge of how their brains work. But we are Borg, we have not only extensively studied the brains of countless species, we have brought them closer to perfection. They can be enhanced further by linking their lower functions, forming a neuro-electric field. Healthy drones will help injured drones by superimposing the correct functioning of the damaged parts onto them.
tech_physics_11517_desc: Almost unheard-of amounts of power can be pushed into a single weapon mount, creating a blast capable of destroying ships outright.
tech_physics_11554_desc: A secondary coprocessing tactical node allows for non-critical calculations to be performed whilst not interfering with main systems.
tech_physics_11555_desc: The EPS relays and conduits are infused with plasma from the warp core, allowing for larger power usage during battle.
tech_physics_11560_desc: With the warhead explosive reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.
tech_physics_11703_desc: The basic principles of disruptor technology is that disruptors cause damage by exciting the molecular bonds of targets to such great extents that those bonds are weakened, and/or broken, by the energies emitted, which often manifest as explosive force
tech_physics_11750_desc: Although all current disruptors are linked to the primary tactical console, they are individually controlled by the weapons officer. Early attempts at creating a competent fire control AI have failed, because it never consistently outperformed the weapons officer. Some have suggested that we develop a system to assist the weapons officer and boost their performance under stress.
tech_physics_11822_desc: Paralithium cells could be miniturised and used within handheld disruptor technology to provide a much more potent and lethal pistol.
tech_physics_11932_desc: The principles of antimatter weapons are to utilise devices using antimatter as a power source, propellant, or explosive.
tech_physics_12122_desc: A tetryon is a subatomic particle that can only exist in subspace environments. Since these particles are a property of subspace, they become highly energetic and unstable when they are extruded into normal space, occurring by both natural and artificial means, such as with tetryonic weapons.
tech_physics_14050_desc: Utilising the unique properties of Fluidic Space and the technology salvaged from discovered wreckage, this technology forces a breach in the space barrier.
tech_physics_14051_desc: This technology allows for a more stable breach to be formed to allow more controlled access between Fluidic Space and other realms.
tech_physics_17023_desc: The Aquatics have mastered the ability to traverse great distances as they once migrated the oceans of Xindus.
tech_physics_20005_desc: Whilst time can be understood to be the fourth dimension which three dimensional can pass through, further phenomena require a deeper understanding of multi-dimensional theory.
tech_physics_20031_desc: Recent advances into isolinear computer chips allow for remarkable breakthroughs in software development. Now, for the first time, AI research presents fresh conundrums as the system itself begins to contemplate its own existence.
tech_physics_20035_desc: Storing data within a crystalline structure allows for a massive amount of data to be easily retrieved and accessed at all times.
tech_physics_20037_desc: Subspace Plaxan sensors detect differences in subspace from what was previously observed, rendering them difficult to spoof or hide from.
tech_physics_20040_desc: Linking the computational power across a vast planetary network is an important part of allowing processing power to be directed where it needs to be.
tech_physics_20061_desc: The vast amounts of data and reports stored within the archives of a civilization is often too much for one mind to piece together fragments of information into actionable data. By development an artificial algorithm that is smart enough to utilise all the data put before it, our scientists can ensure we remain on the cutting edge.
tech_physics_20100_desc: A simply jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, this reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.
tech_physics_20101_desc: Gravimetric particles are used to surround a vessel, making it extremely difficult to get an accurate lock on the ship.
tech_physics_20102_desc: Unique to the Gorn, the subspace jammer masks a vessels energy signature within a subspace field, making it extremely difficult to detect.
tech_physics_20103: Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer
tech_physics_20103_desc: Unique to the Gorn, the Holographical Spoofing Jammer creates hard light imagery to fool even the most detailed sensors.
tech_physics_20201_desc: The amount of raw materials required by a starfaring empire requires new synthesis techniques to provide key materials on a large scale.
tech_physics_20221_desc: The rare properties of time crystals are beyond most understanding, and require new understanding of their non-equilibrium matter state. One potential use is as a suit which could be used by a user to traverse time.
tech_physics_20292_desc: The projection of hard light holograms across a vast area requires new technology in order to function correctly. By installing emitters across a section of hull, these projections can be guided and controlled throughout numerous tasks.
tech_physics_20292b_desc: The projection of hard light holograms across a vast area requires new technology in order to function correctly. By installing emitters across a section of hull, these projections can be guided and controlled throughout numerous tasks.
tech_physics_20902_desc: The main tactical node ensures priority is given to critical combat calculations during combat situations.
tech_physics_20904_desc: A secondary coprocessing tactical node allows for non-critical calculations to be performed whilst not interfering with main systems.
tech_physics_20906_desc: The EPS relays and conduits are infused with plasma from the warp core, allowing for larger power usage during battle.
tech_physics_20908_desc: This targeting array utilises time-crystals to enable precision targeting. Whilst normal crystals repeat their pattern in space but remain unchanged in time, time-crystals repeat themselves in time too, enabling us to utilise the crystals to target objects at optimal locations in time. In effect, the Collective can see where they are the instant they arrive - with no effect from time dilation.
tech_physics_20910_desc: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a complex task that can be iteratively improved by ever increasingly complex calculations.
tech_physics_20911_desc: Iterative advances in heat dispersion improving the stability and efficiency of the Collective's weapons systems, ensuring maximal fire rate.
tech_physics_20912_desc: Advances in miniaturisation allow for more rapid loading and discharging of torpedo payloads.
tech_physics_20916_desc: An organic tactical node allows for non-critical processes to be performed whilst not interfering with main biological functions.
tech_physics_20917_desc: With the warhead explosive reaction tightly boosted by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.
tech_physics_20918_desc: Iterative advances in heat dispersion improving the stability and efficiency of the Collective's weapons systems, ensuring maximal fire rate.
tech_physics_20919_desc: Advances in miniaturisation allow for more rapid loading and discharging of torpedo payloads.
tech_physics_20920_desc: With the warhead explosive reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.
tech_physics_20924_desc: Perfecting the firing cadence of biopulse weaponry is a complex task that can be improved by ever complex evolution.
tech_physics_20925_desc: Evolutionary advances in heat dispersion improve the stability and efficiency of weapons, ensuring maximal fire rate.
tech_physics_20926_desc: Advances in miniaturisation allow for more rapid loading and discharging of torpedo payloads.
tech_physics_20927_desc: Perfecting the firing cadence of biopulse weaponry is a complex task that can be improved by ever complex evolution.
tech_physics_20929_desc: The combination of biopulse weaponry into one stream allows the surface of a planet to be ravaged and cleansed.
tech_physics_99999_desc: Timelines are extremely fragile. We have to observe them to correct any changes which are disadvantageous for us.
tech_physics_aceton_133_desc: These ancient yet ingenious devices sap energy from ship systems and, during the Promellian Menthar wars, also converted the energy to radiation, proving fatal to ship crews. We have adjusted these generators to simply drain shields.
tech_physics_administrative_3_desc: Complex heuristic algorithms developed through centuries of refinement, Virtual Intelligence aides greatly increase productivity by anticipating a user's needs.
tech_physics_advanced_124_desc: With our advancements in quantum physics we have gained a better understanding of graviton radiation. Our graviton emitters can now be advanced by aligning them with the graviton natural wavelength.
tech_physics_advanced_19_desc: Truly delving into the mysteries of the fundamental forces and subatomic particles.
tech_physics_advanced_55_desc: A design that uses fast neutrons to sustain a fission reaction and consumes Pergium, a radioactive element rich in fissionable materials that produces less radiotoxic nuclear waste and doesn't require a neutron moderator. This type of reactor uses helium as coolant, material readily available near Class I type Gas Giants.
tech_physics_advanced_84_desc: Graviton manipulation technology has matured to the point that large fields of gravitons can be generated and controlled for sustained periods of time. If a ship can be enveloped in a layer of gravitons, it should provide limited protection against a range of harmful natural phenomena and weapons fire.
tech_physics_aldean_100_desc: The Aldeans were a proud and mighty people. Their science and art are legendary to the ends of myths. The myth became fact when Aldea was discovered. Aldea became a legend by use of a planetary scale cloaking device. This cloak uses energy fields to repolarize the atoms in the upper atmosphere to become a massive impenetrable cloak.
tech_physics_anti-coagulant_307_desc: Sometimes when hunting those who oppose the will of the Founders, the Jem'Hadar can only score a wounding blow. If our weapons were to leave a residual charge that prevented the Solid's blood from clotting, any wound could potentially be fatal.
tech_physics_anti-matter_274_desc: There has been a boom of experimental antimatter weapons. Inevitably most are flawed, but a flak style weapon using antimatter pellets has passed several key tests. The pellets have been shown to burn through dense armour with ease. However, data suggests that the pellet's low mass means they can be easily deflected by shields. Further research should lead to a field ready prototype.
tech_physics_anti-matter_282_desc: Starship antimatter weapons could be adapted for use in defensive weapon emplacements against orbital bombing and invasion. Several technical details need to be worked out first. The most difficult being how to power them, without leaving them vulnerable and how to solve the atmospheric diffusion that limits their range.
tech_physics_anti-photon_285_desc: Anti-photons are a prime candidate for being the basis of a new weapon. A concentrated beam of anti-photons will partially penetrate a shield. It can even pass through several layers of armour, reducing its effectiveness. Anti-photons are easy to create in large numbers, removing the requirement for them to be held in storage.
tech_physics_anti-photon_287_desc: Our prototype anti-photon beam emitters have been used across our starship's hulls. While this gives a range of firing arcs for the number of emitters, it limits their effective power. Grouping our emitters into a smaller number of banks will concentrate their firepower, increasing combat effectiveness. Additionally, we can fit a dioptic manifold to improve the beams convergence on a single point.
tech_physics_anti-photon_289_desc: Anti-photon beam weapons have traditionally been arranged into banks of a small number of emitters. Anti-photon beam arrays contain a much a larger number of emitters, providing a direct firepower increase. Using multiple emitters to fire the collected anti-photons allows a triaxilating modulation to be used. Triaxilating anti-photons can disrupt the targets shield emitters.
tech_physics_anti-positronic_272_desc: A blaster is a type of ranged weapon that fires bolts of intense energy, often mistaken as lasers. Operating under the same principles as laser weaponry, muon blasters convert energy-rich gas to a glowing muon particle beam that can melt through targets.
tech_physics_anti-proton_208_desc: Research into weaponising positrons, particles with the same mass as an electron but with a positive charge, have initially resulting in a weapon that fires a blast of positronic radiation that disrupts systems and atomic bonds, causing damage to the surrounding area.
tech_physics_anti-proton_279_desc: Like most weapons, anti-proton emitters have a limited firing arc. Traditionally, this is overcome with a weapons grid spanning the starbase's hull, but this wastes a lot of power. It is possible to design pylons which stick out from the station, allowing a smaller number of anti-proton emitters to cover a wider area. Clustering the emitters will have the effect of simplifying the supply network.
tech_physics_anti-proton_280_desc: The rapid annihilation of anti-matter when it comes into contact with the physical world is well known. The ability to quickly and rapidly create anti-matter for use within weaponry requires new research into breeder chambers.
tech_physics_anticloak_1_desc: A Gravitational Field Emitter can be used to detect micro-shifts in the gravitational field around a cloaked vessel allowing limited detection of cloaked vessels using weak cloaking devices.
tech_physics_anticloak_2_desc: A targetted sweep can pickup energy 'distortions', manifesting themselves most often as refracting visible light energy from surrounding stellar objects very near the cloaked ship's outline, appearing as a 'shimmering' effect, while cloaked and prior to decloaking, could give away a cloaked ship when observed.
tech_physics_anticloak_3_desc: A tachyon was a subatomic particle that naturally exists at faster-than-light velocities, and can often be associated with time travel or produced as a byproduct of a cloaking device. Concentrated detection devices can be used to pin-point the localisation of concealed vessels.
tech_physics_anticloak_4_desc: Positron-based scanners at an output of two hundred gigawatts. The subassembly tolerances were isolated from the emitter algorithms, which was made possible by generating a stable flux between the positronic conductors and renormalising the tertiary wave functions.
tech_physics_applied_120_desc: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.
tech_physics_applied_20_desc: The seemingly erratic behavior of tiny things can dramatically alter the way we think about bigger things.
tech_physics_applied_75_desc: By using a feedback loop of energy we can enforce our quantum singularity warp core. A field of antiprotons and neutrons will allow for longer singularity pulses or maybe even bigger singularities.
tech_physics_artificial_116_desc: Krieger waves are a promising means of generating power outside normal nuclear reactor processes. They can also be harnessed as a potential weapon.
tech_physics_artificial_70_desc: The Artificial Quantum Singularity holds the potential to be the most powerful method of energy generation known. Such a singularity is little more than a miniature black hole with a rapid decay rate. The particles emitted from the decay can be captured and guided using quantum fields.
tech_physics_assault_175_desc: The premise of the assault phaser is simple. Shunt as much power as possible through the nadion emitter, without triggering a cascading pion decomposition of the nadion forming sub-strata. The resulting particle beam is potent, but also lacks cohesion. This limits its effectiveness against shields.
tech_physics_astrometrics_40_desc: Through advancements in Stellar Cartography, special astrometric labs are now possible. The labs are now able to map the stars a lot easier.
tech_physics_atalskes_180_desc: Atalskes Phased Energy Beam Weapons offer the latest in small arms weaponry. This will give our ground forces a significant boost to offensive capabilities.
tech_physics_auto-phaser_173_desc: Using the overflowing plasma from the warp drives plasma injectors we can augment our phasers with plasma allowing them to hold more charge and hit harder.
tech_physics_automation_desc: Unlocks the power of research automation.
tech_physics_basic_5_desc: The pursuit of AI is one fraught with practical, computational and philosophical difficulties, including moral hazards. Cautious development is however necessary to further scientific understanding.
tech_physics_beam_132_desc: Different atomic and subatomic particles can be constricted to beams that are directed at a target. These energy beams are more effective at breaching shields and causing hull damage than conventional energy cannons. Further research will no doubt produce more effective beam weapons.
tech_physics_bipolar_77_desc: An array of conduit branches, able to better improve the feed of a warp plasma manifold.
tech_physics_borg_adaption_desc: Damage data is recorded by the Adaptive Module which records and remodulates the vessels primary shield grid to the matching subspace phase compression pulse frequency of the opponents weapons, allowing Borg vessels and stations to become immune to that particular range of subspace phase compression pulse frequencies.
tech_physics_borg_aperture_desc: Creating a stable transwarp stream capable of transporting Borg assets across long distances can be realised via the creation of a new megastructure.
tech_physics_burst_160_desc: Early versions of the phaser turret have been promising. The addition of more capacitors to the pre-fire circuits will lengthen the amount of time the turret fires for before having to recharge.
tech_physics_cannon_135_desc: These weapons fire intense bursts of highly energetic particles at a target. While they inflict significant amounts of damage, the particle bursts travel at slower speeds and need to be carefully aimed and aligned with their targets.
tech_physics_carbon_56_desc: The nuclear fusion reaction of three helium 4 nuclei produces a carbon. This Triple-alpha process relies on energy resonance state that has a small probability to occur and generates carbon and oxygen as byproduct, releasing energy in a high temperature plasma.
tech_physics_cetacean_desc: In partnership with our Cetacean allies specially operated operation centres are set up onboard starships to provide expertise in navigation utilising their unique skills.
tech_physics_close_rifts_desc: Our borders are being too frequently bypassed via gateways allowing our foes to reach deep into our space. Asking our top scientists to work on a means of closing these gateways is crucial.
tech_physics_co-variant_166_desc: A covariant phaser pulse is a theorised, specialised directed-energy discharge capable of taking advantage of phase retractions, an energy phenomenon which can occur when power is transferred from one system to another in an enemy vessel shield configuration.
tech_physics_coherent_185_desc: Tunneling phasers appear to fire a single phaser beam, but it is actually a composite of several small beams. Precise convergence of these beams concentrates their energy into a smaller area, boring through thick armour with ease. Difficulty in beam convergence at distance reduces their maximum effective range.
tech_physics_coherent_189_desc: Our tunneling phaser emitters have been used in low numbers, spread across our hulls. While this gives a good range of firing arcs for the number of emitters, it limits their effective power. Grouping our emitters into a smaller number of banks will concentrate their firepower. Mounting existing tunneling phaser emitters across a flexible strip mount allows them to be focused on the same point.
tech_physics_coherent_193_desc: Phasers have traditionally been arranged into banks of a small number of phaser emitters. Phaser arrays contain a much a larger number of emitters, providing a direct firepower increase. Some configurations allow energy to be channelled along phaser strips so that more emitters may be used against a target. These arrays can easily act as up-scaled tunnelling phasers.
tech_physics_coleopteric_67_desc: An early warp drive, the Coleopteric Warp Engine utilizes a ring-like outboard coil manifold rather than common linear warp nacelles. This technology is an icon of early Vulcan warp technology as well as early warp technologies used by humans during the mid 21st century.
tech_physics_compressed_174_desc: Initially conceived by accident, the auto-phaser interlock is a byproduct of phaser technology. By configuring the beams together and activating the interlock, the ship's main deflector can release a powerful beam of energy.
tech_physics_compressed_176_desc: The success of assault phasers against hull material has led to the formal declaration of the 'Hull-Breacher' classification of phaser. Weapon specifications, manufacturing plans, logistical chains, maintenance guides, combat doctrine training manuals, and more are required to use this effectively and to lay the foundation for their future development and incorporation into new starship designs.
tech_physics_compressed_257_desc: Compressed pulses of plasma focus their destructive potential on a smaller area, causing more damage to the hull than phased plasma pulses. They are expected to be significantly less effective against shields, which can be modulated to use the tension in the pulse to trigger decompression. When a pulse decompresses, its energy will harmlessly dissipate.
tech_physics_compressed_261_desc: As component miniaturisation advances, the benefit of changing to dual barrels has not been forgotten. Smaller components should allow a triple-barreled cannon to be built. The latest advances in plasma compression involve using graviton infusions. Simulations suggest that weaponising this technique could make it harder for enemy shields to prematurely decompress the plasma pulse.
tech_physics_compression_167_desc: Improvements to compression beam technology allow for the miniaturisation of the compression fields, resulting in more portable, more effective compression beam weaponry. Able to be utilised inside dampening fields and at close range, the compressed beam bursts out multiple volleys of energy for maximum damage.
tech_physics_compression_181_desc: This is the handheld version of the Type IV phaser. It has been enhanced in that it has the ability to take out groups of enemies using a wide-beam setting and being able to function inside a dampening field, unlike previous models. This will definitely be a welcome addition to any armory and weapons' locker.
tech_physics_computing_10_desc: ODN relays are an integral part of any advanced optical data computer networks. They use quantum tunneling modelling to reduce interference and allow for extreme high-bandwidth data transfers. This in turn makes having a distributed computer network, with backup computer core, far more feasible and practical.
tech_physics_computing_13_desc: To give our scientists more avenues of research, we have developed and built a virtual assistant. This assistant is able to quickly analyse our previous research projects and identify the best choices for the next project.
tech_physics_computing_17024_desc: Unique to the Xindi based on Insectoid technology, the interface allows one individuals to control multiple ship functions.
tech_physics_computing_17_desc: The fifth in a series of experiments by Doctor Richard Daystrom, who used his own memory engrams as a basis for this computer's neural network. The M5 Multitronic Computer can think and reason in a similar manner as humans, allowing for faster advances in technology.
tech_physics_computing_23_desc: Borg vessels currently maintain a connection to the hive through subspace interlinks to regional distribution nodes. This system simplicity has now been exceeded by the speed and bandwidth gains of using a vessel-to-vessel model. Complex new communications and data processing equipment will be need developed, and housed in a secure setting.
tech_physics_computing_24_desc: The nanoprobes which permeate our bodies and technology use a nanoscopic sized intramolecular processor. These processors are idle when the nanoprobe is traveling or regenerating. We should focus on developing a nanoprobe that'll link this processor directly into the hive. Offloading the majority of simple calculations to them will free time on our computer cores for more difficult computations.
tech_physics_computing_25_desc: The Collective has grown to the point that the unicomplex based thought harmonisation megacomputers, the source of our hive mind, are struggling to impose order. Chaos is mounting. Our best solution is to switch to a distributed system of smaller neural integrators, each responsible for a single vessel, facility, or unicomplex submatrix. Their output will be sent to the Queen for unification.
tech_physics_computing_26_desc: It would be beneficial to our vessels if they could generate the hive mind locally, instead of waiting for the hive mind data stream from the Queen. We might achieve this by interlinking their vinculums, directly sharing the integrated neural patterns of their drones. This local hive mind pattern would be updated a few moments later by the primary hive mind pattern from the Queen's unicomplex.
tech_physics_computing_29_desc: The idea of a small independently powered sensor station is an old one, but with the advances that we have made in astrometrics and hull design, we could create small posts that focus entirely on scanning nearby space.
tech_physics_computing_31_desc: Advances in data storage and transfer rates allow us to store more signatures at once in the pattern buffers, allowing faster transport of larger amounts of colonists.
tech_physics_computing_33_desc: A subspace telescope is a remote imaging device that made use of subspace in its operation. By combining numerous telescopes into a large array we can create a massive sensor net that can span light years.
tech_physics_computing_36_desc: Replicator technology has now increased to the stage where dematerialised matter can be reconstituted into delicious edible foods.
tech_physics_computing_39_desc: Large networks of subspace relays enable near-simultaneous communications over incredible distances. These subspace relays are found on most modern stations and ships, which help to constantly expand the size of the network.
tech_physics_computing_60_desc: By emitting gravimetric waves, we are able to produce multiple gravimetric signals that can look like other ships, making it more difficult for enemy ships to target us.
tech_physics_computing_67_desc: By creating a specialised corps for our smartest researchers, we can reduce the cost it takes to station these scientists at our research outposts.
tech_physics_computing_68_desc: This dedicated and independent computer module would monitor our ships hardware and software in real time for any intrusions and interferences from a wide variety of possible enemy devices.
tech_physics_computing_70_desc: Utilising powerful verteron particles in a high powered configuration allows us to use them in our jamming technology used by our vessels.
tech_physics_computing_72_desc: The installation of central plexuses on our vessels has lead to a variety of performance improvements. At present, these plexuses are only responsible for the communication between vessels. The next logical step is to move the primary hive interlink to the plexus. This will reduce the amount of unnecessary redundant equipment aboard the vessel, and improve hive-to-vessel data integration speeds.
tech_physics_computing_73_desc: The continued development of metamaterials has reached the stage that nanoscale processing units can be embedded into our hulls, without compromising their strength. This would offer a significant boost to the local processing power available to a vessel. Further research is required to develop a method of powering and communicating with the processors.
tech_physics_computing_9_desc: Using advanced cortical implants, every member of the crew can quickly access and utilize every facet of the ship controls at any time and from any location. Merging this tactic with next-stage neural gel computer network, the ship becomes almost a living thing, capable of performing a great deal of calculations instantaneously and predict enemy movement in an almost instinctive way.
tech_physics_covariant_101_desc: Shield emitter technology has advanced enough that multiple layers of gravitons may be contained around a starship. The shield emitters would run near capacity in order to achieve this, limiting the rate at which new gravitons may be added to the matrix. This line of shield technology will focus on making the shields as strong as possible, at the expense of all other concerns.
tech_physics_crescent-wave_207_desc: Rather than use space-time or simple plasma impact, a disruptor battery using gravimetric energy as the main emitter will use the force of gravity to destroy the target.
tech_physics_crm_221_desc: A new shock rifle has been requested by our troops with a preference for one that will kill slowly and painfully. A rifle that fires electromagnetically-contained packets of electron-less krypton, cooled to near absolute zero, should suffice. Early prototypes can incapacitate most targets with one shot, causing unbelievably excruciating pain, followed by death one to two minutes later.
tech_physics_defensive_83_desc: It has been found that dense fields of gravitons can absorb or deflect a range of harmful phenomena. Current graviton emitters do not allow for a whole ship to be encompassed. However, they can create force fields inside a ship to seal hull breaches and absorb structural stress from incoming fire. This should improve the durability of a ship's hull.
tech_physics_dervish_149_desc: It seems that a calm mind conquers all. With some adaptation inspired by religious symbolism to the weapon consoles onboard our ships, we can increase their effectiveness. Furthermore phased hand weapons out an airlock can increase our damage output by 20%.
tech_physics_dicyclic_73_desc: A very advanced form of the warp VII engine. The warp field rotation, produced by its dicyclic warp coil configuration, is build for speed and perfect for longer jumps. This combination makes it excellent for long journeys and chasing hostile ships.
tech_physics_disruptor_212_desc: Disruptor turrets are attached to the outside of a ships hull. Lacking armour, they rely on being small enough so that hostile vessels can not maintain an accurate weapons lock. Changing to relying on armoured barbettes will allow larger models of disruptors to be fitted.
tech_physics_doomsday_273_desc: Utilising the technology found in a Doomsday Device, we may be able to reverse engineer the weapon technology found in its planet killing beam. Initial tests show its destructive potential is beyond anything we have ever seen.
tech_physics_drednok_desc: The Diviner's deadly robot enforcer is cold and heartless. His sole purpose is to follow the Diviner's orders and stop at nothing to execute them. Drednok is friend to no one and in extreme circumstances will use his spider-like form to intimidate and attack enemies to impose the Order's will.
tech_physics_dual-bank_163_desc: Improvements to our power supply and storage devices allow for incremental improvements to our phaser technology as well. By utilising Andorian flux capacitors within our primary phaser coils, we can adjust the phaser beam coefficients easily, from a low-powered setting to a high-powered, searing blue beam.
tech_physics_duotronic_4_desc: Duotronics, a form of 23rd century computer technology designed by the Federation Doctor Richard Daystrom, followed after circuitry that used components such as resistors and transistors.
tech_physics_early_96_desc: A use of metamaterials, remote-hacking, and radar distortion, that enable one to mask the visual and remote perception of an object.
tech_physics_early_96b_desc: A use of metamaterials, remote-hacking, and radar distortion, that enable one to mask the visual and remote perception of an object.
tech_physics_energy_134_desc: A device that dampens energy use. As a weapon this will greatly reduce a ship or stations energy output, starving their systems of much needed energy.
tech_physics_exo-comps_17_desc: An exocomp consists of a micro-replicator, a boridium power converter and an axionic chip network. The axionic network gives the exocomp formidable computational power. The micro-replicator creates tools that the exocomp uses to solve problems and creates new circuit pathways in the memory of the exocomp when it performs new tasks.
tech_physics_experimental_71_desc: Transwarp Drives are unique in that they tunnel through space instead of move through it. Unlike traditional warp drives, a type of artificial wormhole is created which the starship can travel through. This allows for vastly increased speed. However, the Transwarp Drive is a dangerous technology in that it requires more time to charge and can prevent rapid escape from enemy vessels.
tech_physics_exploration_68_desc: The main-stage warp engine creates a powerful and stable warp field that increases the speed of our vessels, and allows them to travel greater distances, though they do take longer to charge up.
tech_physics_explosive_136_desc: These weapons release huge amounts of energy in the area of impact. They are very effective at draining shields and causing general damage, but not very effective at tactical strikes. Further research would no doubt improve the abilities of these weapons.
tech_physics_extendable_87_desc: Shield emitters can be recalibrated to change the shield's geometry. More extensive modifications can allow a shield emitter to project a shield at a greater distance from the ship. While this doesn't provide effective protection, it can be used to help re-energize the gravitons in other ships' shields if the frequencies match.
tech_physics_field_110_desc: Many energy fields require proper calibration and modulation. This technology allows us to better control field emitters to not interfere with their counterparts and compensate for underperforming units.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_113_desc: Calabi Yau manifolds are shapes that satisfy the requirement of space for the six unseen spatial dimensions of string theory, which may be smaller than our currently observable lengths. By manipulating these manifolds, we can increase the energy throughput and storage by a large factor.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_117_desc: Polaric Ion energy is a highly volatile form of energy based on Polaric Ion particles. Polaric Ion energy can be used in power generation with extremely high potential, though polaric ion devices are dangerously unstable and prone to causing chain reactions.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_126_desc: Mysterious instructions from the future have enabled our people to construct this building. Now we gain glimpses of the future and knowledge that can assist us.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_131_desc: A Temporal Shockwave is a powerful buildup of temporal energy which travels through space, changing or altering the timeline as it moves through space.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_134_desc: Harnessing the power of subatomic particles with temporal properties known as Chronitons has enabled our reactors to draw energy from space-time itself. This new type of reactor nears the pinnacle of energy generation itself.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_136_desc: The Yoyodyne warp drive allows faster warp speeds by utilising a matter antimatter intermix chamber, creating a more stable warp field.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14004_de: Improvements in the plasma flow regulators as a result of faster processing speeds have produced a cleaner more efficent warp bubble that is capable of extending the life of the engine and the top speed.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14005_de: Assimilation has allowed us to further perfect our transwarp technology to advance the speed and distance of travel.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14006_de: Taking the concept of modulated shields further, initial research into MFS shielding has been conducted. A modulated shield grid uses variable quantum effects to squeeze gravitons closer together, allowing more to be added to a shield layer. This process requires both a large, continuous power supply, and a significant amount of extra computing power, in order to maintain the effect.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14007_de: Advanced Quantum-Triaxilating Field technology has provided a breakthrough in defence field technology.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14008_de: Decalithium provides a purer source of fuel for our reactors and a greater energy yield.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14009_de: By combining the technology assimilated from Species 2204 and Species 4228 we have refined our cutting bean with a resonance effect. Further increasing the power to aid the collective.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14024_de: Applying a Gravimetric Flux to the Singularity has meant we can manipulate the core to the extreme increasing the speed in which our vessels can travel at warp. Allowing us to compete with our rivals.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14025_de: The final evolution of fluidic space propulsion allowing Bioships to adapt to the changing dimensional shifts to provide clearer energy and faster speeds.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_14032_de: Our engineers have been able to further secure the injectors within the Warp Core that so often became a weak point during battle. This additional shielding means that the Warp Drive can now be pushed harder and further without fear of overload.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_142_desc: By cycling the warp engine constantly we generate a high-frequency warp field which increases the efficiency of our warp engines and allows ships to travel greater distances.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_146_desc: With the addition of Secondary Deflector Arrays, our ships are now able to detect and deflect particles at a much further distance than was previously possible. This enables ships to travel more quickly while at warp.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_148_desc: By utilising unique translink frequencies, our navigational deflector can now penetrate subspace with ease, ensuring ships can travel rapidly at warp.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_151_desc: In order to ensure rapid warp travel, the dilithium matrix must be kept in a state of high flux, which is inherently unstable. The Graf Matrix Restoration coil detects these instabilities and restores cohesion to the crystals.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_152_desc: Over time Dilithium begins to lose its cohesion and begins to fracture and shatter. The introduction of a matrix compositor can detect these subatomic fractures and repair them before permanent damage is done. This allows warp core availability to be kept to the highest order.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_160_desc: Advancements in Coleopteric theory allow us to create better warp engines.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_161_desc: Utilising non-linear mathematical theory we have unlocked the secrets to utilising more than one ring coil manifold at once.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_162_desc: The logical progression from two interlocking ring manifolds was to introduce a third stabilising ring which should allow the construction of even faster vessels.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_163_desc: Logic dictates that if arcs of different sizes can be arranged across the hull then it should theoretically be possible to construct ships with numerous rings allowing rapid warp travel.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_164_desc: To counter the variables of rapid warp travel navigation, the mathematics states that should a coleopteric ring be able to pivot whilst rotating it will enable more manouverability within the coleopteric field itself, resulting in an overall increase to warp speeds.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_169_desc: Advances in manipulations have enabled us to solve the theory behind the inefficiencies inside the core. By manipulating the emissions inside the singularity core to enable peak efficiency we could increase our power generation and warp speeds.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_170_desc: By shifting the singularity partly into another dimension, we can manipulate the core to the extreme without worrying about radiation or accidental discharge.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_172_desc: Our initial crude attempts at harnessing transwarp space have surpassed even the most advanced warp drive available. We understand now that entering and traveling through transwarp space has little in common with normal space. Enough data has been collected to facilitate the development of a 'transwarp coil', which will perform a refined version of the procedure used by the modified warp drive.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_173_desc: We have discovered that the interfold layers between normal space and subspace contain numerous roaming high energy subspace oscillations. Theoretically, bombarding an oscillation with triaxilating tetryons will amplify it, causing a low energy distortion to form. As this distortion weakens the separation barrier between normal space and subspace, it should allow easier access to transwarp space.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_174_desc: A critical intersection between transwarp manipulation and power generation technology has been reached. We theorise that our technology is sufficient to generate and sustain our own transwarp conduits, instead of relying on the natural ebb and flow of energy through transwarp space. Transwarp aperture installations are planned, which will open gateways into the conduits for our vessels.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_175_desc: Transwarp conduits can be modulated in a number of ways. We have calculated a set of parameters that will optimise them to minimise our vessels travel time. The transwarp apertures must be permanently open in order to maintain this optimal modulation. As per prior requirements, transwarp aperture projection installations were not designed to stabilise the opening, and will have to be redesigned.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_176_desc: As the Collective grows, so does our need for transwarp access. Centralising our transwarp support facilities into monolithic superstructures is projected to greatly reduce wasted power, and simplify conduit maintenance. The resulting transwarp hubs will better facilitate the deployment of the interspace warping manifold network, which will allow conduits to be extended or temporarily redirected.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_177_desc: The interspace warping manifold network can be upgraded into the superior interspatial manifold network. Each manifold will be powered by syphoning energy from multiple layers of subspace. Fitted with energy to matter converters, they will create the material to autonomously repair and improve themselves, almost forever. Every Borg facility will be permanently interconnected to one another.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_182_desc: Multiphasic sensor masking allows for the masking of many emissions from different sources, rendering vessels harder to detect.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_182b_des: Multiphasic sensor masking allows for the masking of many emissions from different sources, rendering vessels harder to detect.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_183_desc: By shifting our ships slightly out of phase with the normal universe, we can shift our vessels to new positions and then reemerge. This will be extremely difficult for our enemies to detect.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_183b_des: By shifting our ships slightly out of phase with the normal universe, we can shift our vessels to new positions and then reemerge. This will be extremely difficult for our enemies to detect.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_184_desc: Utilising chroniton particles we can project a shell around our vessels that will shield them from causing space-time distortions that can be detected by tachyon scans.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_184b_des: Utilising chroniton particles we can project a shell around our vessels that will shield them from causing space-time distortions that can be detected by tachyon scans.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_191_desc: Theory has advanced to the point where theoretically infinite rings could be used to create a warp field, and thus if required we can sheath our coil manifolds beneath the hull until it is time to warp. This is the pinnacle of Coleopterics warp theory.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_192_desc: Certain characteristics of an energy beam or field can be hard to ascertain during combat but these characteristics can be of great importance. Having more sensors working on detecting the modulation of an energy pulse increases the speed at which it can be determined. For this reason, it would be wise to adapt the computers of certain ships to function as fleet sensor data coordination centres.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_194_desc: Shield emitters have struggled to maintain the coherence of medium range graviton beams. The higher the graviton density of the beam, the sooner it dissipates. If the emitters were refit with a triaxilating graviton beam behaving in a similar way to other triaxilating energy patterns, it should gain a more stable cohesion, increasing the rate that nearby ships shields can be reinforced at.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_195_desc: Each band of singularity shifting has resulted in more rapid travel between two points as subspace is condensed into narrower and narrower bands. By finally cracking the lower subspace dimensions, we can reach the fastest speeds possible by singularity drives.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_205_desc: The stacked graviton layers of a covariant shield suffer from an inter-layer interference phenomenon. When emitting gravitons into the shield matrix, each layer a graviton must travel through consumes extra power. The problem can be partially mitigated, but not solved, by emitting higher energy pulses to maintain one layer at a time, starting from the furthest out.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_208_desc: Our scientists are making progress in understanding the concepts and relationships that underpin all types of energy. Using the current theories, lab tests have shown that the range of radiation which each graviton phase modulation interacts with could potentially be expanded. Each interphased graviton modulation could therefore reinforce other, mathematically related, modulations even further.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_211_desc: Taking the concept of multiphasic shields further, initial research into hyper-phasic shielding has been conducted. A hyper-phasic shield uses quantum effects to squeeze gravitons closer together, allowing more to be added to a shield layer. This process requires both a large, continuous power supply, and a significant amount of extra computing power, in order to maintain the effect.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_212_desc: There are many variables that can affect shield regeneration rates. Current shield management systems use case-based reasoning databases to manage emitter parameters. It would be more effective to make use of advances in computing, and equip each shield emitter with an autonomous management system, allowing it to better adapt to its precise environmental conditions.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_214_desc: The shield geometry of immersion shielding was originally created for use in high pressure environments, not the vacuum of space. Having a series of variations of this geometry, each tailored for a different pressure range, allows the shield to be adjusted for the current circumstances. A set of suitable test sites for each pressure range will need to be located before geometry testing can begin.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_218_desc: The miniaturisation of ultra-high discharge rate shield capacitors has reached the nanoscale which can be embedded in the hull material. Capacitor material availability, and the time required to embed it in a host material, serve to limit the amount that can be installed per starship. Despite this, a significant gain in combat shield regeneration rates is expected.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_219_desc: By attracting one side of an enemy spaceship while repelling the other, we can create severely damaging shear effects in its hull. Another mode of destructive use of such beams is rapid alternating between pressing and pulling force in order to cause structural damage to the ship as well as inflicting debilitating forces on its crew.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_220_desc: A neuro-electric field generator is a component aboard every Borg vessel, responsible for the production of an energy form capable of healing both organic and inorganic body parts of injured drones.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_222_desc: Our vessels' power generation capabilities are exceeding their power demands. This presents the opportunity to begin reinforcing our vessels with energy based armour systems. Multiple independent force field grids can act to reinforce the hull and absorb weapons fire which breaches the hull. When one grid is taken offline, another will activate while the damaged grid regenerates.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_223_desc: Species 1453 attempted to resist our efforts to bring perfection to their species by combining common tractor technology with directed laser energy. This technology can be outfitted onto our vessels in order to hasten our path to perfection.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_224_desc: Our past attempts to use quantum fluctuations to dissipate energy were met with failure. Heuristics predict that our new understanding will lead to success. If so, our vessels can use this technology as a defence, dissipating a portion of incoming weapons fire to reduce the damage inflicted.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_226_desc: Adaptive force field technology has been assimilated from species 3603, adding their knowledge of self adaptation to our own. Synergy. When impacted with weapons fire, our force field analyse and adjust the frequency of the enemies weapons, enabling the adjustment of shielding frequencies to lower effectiveness of enemy weapons.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_227_desc: Species 2204 superimposed coaxial vessel beams into their tractor technology, strengthening the beam by an order of magnitude. By assimilating this technology into our Collective we can increase the output of our vessels beams.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_228_desc: The development of fast goal seeking algorithms to automatically devise and apply triaxilating field geometries has been slower than expected. It has been noted that the brains of certain species are capable of applying uncommonly accurate heuristics for this task. Drones formerly of these species should be used to guide force field adaptations until the algorithms are refined.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_231_desc: By modifying the emitters for our tractor beams to produce high-energy pulses, as opposed to the normal continuous stream, we have managed to increase their strength and effectiveness way past their old limits.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_232_desc: The ancient Tkon Empire used modified crystals to sap the energy from starships orbiting their planets, preventing their escape. By researching how this was done, we may be able to create a way of adapting this technology for our own use.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_235_desc: A limitation to regular tractor technology has been the interference of subspace particles and radiation in affecting the beam coherence. By rapidly remodulating the beam to match the interference it should increase the potency of the beam.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_236_desc: Our experiments into subspace have stumbled across an interesting phenomenon. By creating a weakened subspace field that does not interfere with the impulse engines we can reduce the effective mass of a ship to almost zero, increasing its mobility and making it considerably harder to target.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_238_desc: By creating an isolytic burst in normal space, we can tear a hole in subspace rendering warp drives inoperable for a period of time. This is highly destructive to subspace.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_239_desc: By utilising energy filaments arranged in a net like pattern we can create an almost impenetrable web around a target. Once the web is complete, it would become self generating.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_240_desc: Producing large amounts of energy filament to criss cross the web requires specialised craft that emit them from the aft section. At least two ships are needed to spin the web, if one breaks away prior to web completion, the filaments would presumably dissipate.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_241_desc: Enhancements to the filament spinners may be possible, enabling faster spinning of the web.
tech_physics_field_manipulation_243_desc: Two researchers have come up with a rare idea that at a quantum level, there is no difference between biology or physics. By using mycelium spores harvested from Prototaxites Stellaviatori which is found in normal space and subspace, it may be possible to travel along the mycelial subspace network which spans across the entire galaxy.
tech_physics_flash_143_desc: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.
tech_physics_focused_296_desc: Polaron beams were found to have an unexpected quality; they can partially penetrate shields. This is a by-product of the polarons' interaction with the graviton layers in the shield. Physics models updated with this information now suggest that decreasing the size of the beam's focal point could actually disrupt the graviton layer it hits. An increase to shield damage can be expected.
tech_physics_focusing_142_desc: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the Engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.
tech_physics_forced_247_desc: Improvements to the magnetic containment technology used in our plasma weaponry has led to the theory that a beam can retain a brief 'memory' if constrained by electromagnetic charges. By forcing this beam along a path, we can increase the effectiveness substantially over large distances.
tech_physics_gatling_325_desc: In order to increase the damage of the cannons, it is possible that firing smaller bursts of thorons in large amounts can cause more damage. Capacitor technology increases allow for more charge per volley.
tech_physics_gravimetric_65_desc: Through the use of specialised and improved plasma conduits, our cores can efficiently provide the Warp plasma needed to create vastly more stable subspace fields.
tech_physics_graviton_326_desc: Manipulating streams of gravitons into a coherent beam allows for numerous stressors to be placed on a target area, literally tearing and shearing it apart via gravity.
