tech_physics_thoron_324_desc: Utilising thorons, the radioactive isotope of radon, within our intermix chambers can increase the damage output of our cannons substantially.
tech_physics_tractor_122_desc: Tractor Beams are beams of gravitons that create artificial gravity fields around the targeted object and allow it to be moved or held in place, often to tow disabled or damaged ships, but also to hold it still for attack.
tech_physics_trans-spectral_42_desc: Research into advanced subspace physics has made it possible to detect tiny ripples which cause slight variability in subspace. These variations in the normal frequencies of subspace have never been able to be so accurately detected before. Application of this discovery has led to an even greater detection capability for long-range dedicated sensor arrays.
tech_physics_transporters_23_desc: Initial forays into utilising transporter technology for more complex goods has resulted in this technology. Large dishes behind the pad serve as a focal point for matter transport, which, whilst extremely power intensive, results in successful transportation of organic and inorganic matter.
tech_physics_transwarp_travel_desc: A transwarp conduit, also known as a transwarp corridor or a transwarp tunnel, is an artificially-created energy conduit through a realm of subspace known as transwarp space and requires great computational control to safely navigate.
tech_physics_tricyclic_76_desc: The use of tricyclic materials can improve our warp engines. By using these materials in the input manifold, the system will need less time to cool down and lets us use them for longer periods of time.
tech_physics_truly_8_desc: The final stage of AI creation... how can we know what beings we will create when their capabilities will, by design, surpass our own?
tech_physics_tunneling_187_desc: Shields are formed from layers of gravitons enveloping the target. It's been suggested that if we infuse our phaser beams with gravitons, then micro disturbances will occur at the shield impact site. These disturbances should bend the shield and shift its frequency, rendering it ineffective. First, we must discover a way of achieving this without causing the beam to distort and harmlessly scatter.
tech_physics_tunneling_191_desc: Graviton phaser emitters have been spread across our starship's hulls. While this gives a good range of firing arcs for the number of emitters, it limits their effective power. Grouping our emitters into a smaller number of banks will concentrate their firepower. Modern graviton emitters are smaller and more powerful, meaning more space for the phasers' nadion emitters.
tech_physics_tunneling_195_desc: The infusion of gravitons within the phaser beams can create micro gravitic disturbances at the impact location, which bends and shifts the resultant defensive frequency of the target vessels shields allowing for our phasers to pass unhindered.
tech_physics_tunneling_338_desc: Focusing our efforts on developing banks of smaller, coordinated tetryon emitters will produce a weapon that can control the dispersal pattern of its energy. This versatility would make it effective against both shields and armour. To avoid complications, the weapon will be restricted to firing in short bursts at close range, making it ideal for mounting in a cannon frame.
tech_physics_tunneling_342_desc: Prototype breaching tetryonic cannons have included a number of backup and redundant systems. Using the data obtained from field testing, it is possible to safely reduce the number of redundant components. The extra space will be used to mount a second barrel. If more emitters could be brought to bear on a single convergence point then the damage potential could scale geometrically.
tech_physics_type-1_215_desc: The assault disruptor is similar to previous disruptors but with one key change. The energy emissions are stored in a magnetic field, allowing them to coalesce and agitate to higher energy states. When redirected, this forces the burst of energy toward the target. This process is repeated using multiple magnetic field generators, resulting in a stream of heavily damaging disruptor projectiles.
tech_physics_undine_anticloak_1_desc: Using powerful projection waves we can equip our ships with the ability to detect vessels attempting to hide themselves with cloaking devices.
tech_physics_unified_22_desc: Manifestations of reality on multiple observable spectrums come into focus when seen as a single tapestry of interconnected physics!
tech_physics_unimatrix_106_desc: The Borg use incredibly advanced regenerative shielding. While we aren't close to replicating it, we can use sensor records of it in action to redesign our shield emitters. These new emitters allow us to preserve the rapid recharge rate of the older emitters while supporting a higher energy shield matrix.
tech_physics_varon-t_220_desc: Varon-T disruptors work by disrupting the target's molecular bonds. This process starts deep within the target, slowly tearing them apart from the inside. Most civilisations ban this weapon due to the unnecessarily painful and drawn out death. We are not concerned with the ethics of how we dispose of our enemies, so we should learn how to mass produce this weapon and equip our troops with them.
tech_physics_z-particles_112_desc: Z-particles, also known as Z-bosons, are a fundamental component of subatomic physics. They are their own matter and antimatter particle, and moderate the actions of neutrinos.
tech_physics_zero_119_desc: A vacuum is not truly empty, but rather a collection of zero-point states. This may be usable in regards to collecting, storing and acting upon assorted electromagnetic particles.
tech_plasma_cannon_1_desc: Cannons which fire bursts of compressed plasma. Upon impact, the plasma disrupts shields and vaporizes hull plating. While not an accurate weapon, their high rate of fire makes them effective in combat. Ships can typically mount several cannons due to their small size.
tech_plasma_disruptor_beam_1_desc: With the introduction of exotic particles into the disruptor generator matrix we might be able to develop an improved impact reaction from our disruptors. These disruptors should take over some of the plasma weapon traits like plasma's intense heat potential.
tech_polaron_beam_1_desc: Polarons are a quasiparticle. With our current understanding of physics, we believe that we can create a directional beam that consists of ions, and electrons acting as polarons. If the polaron is strong enough, we hope to induce a kind of 'charge shock' in the atomic structure of the target. A powerful enough 'shock' should cause the atomic structure to disintegrate.
tech_polaron_torp_start_desc: Polarons are a quasiparticle with an unexpected quality: they can partially penetrate shields. In the initial testing environment, enriching the warheads with different subatomic particles results in different effects.
tech_rea_prey_desc: Named after a small but nimble Bird-of-Prey, this is an early Romulan ship design.
tech_refining_techniques_desc: Dilithium is a critical component for all but the most rudimentary of warp core designs. Like any resource, it requires a degree of processing before it can be used. By improving our mining techniques, we should be able to locate foreign sources of dilithium and mine them via our mining stations.
tech_rhombic_paguphage_1_desc: The disease, which starts out with relatively mild symptoms such as the urge to eat rhomboid shaped ice, is in fact extremely deadly when left untreated. We should now be able to research a treatment to slow down, if not cure the paguphage.
tech_rhombic_paguphage_2_desc: A cure for the Rhombic Paguphage can now be developed. Utilising modified cytoplasmic stimulators, we can also cure the remaining infected population.
tech_rom_design_desc: The principles behind the Romulan Star Empire require a navy that exemplifies those values.
tech_romulan_society_desc: The history of our imperial might is just as important as our future. Older ship designs can be stored here, so we can learn from the past.
tech_scientific_method_desc: The advanced scientific method is a body of techniques for investigating phenomena, acquiring new knowledge, or correcting and integrating previous knowledge.
tech_seripian_flu_1_desc: The Seripian Flu, which is deadly if left untreated, can now be treated with new stimulants to slow down the disease.
tech_seripian_flu_2_desc: A vaccine to immunise the remaining population against the Seripian Flu can now be developed. Utilising cellular regeneration and entertainment chambers, we can also cure the remaining population with the flu.
tech_ship_program_desc: During the early days of space exploration, we could get away with using a limited number of starship design patterns. We now have more experience with living in space, and our technology has improved in some significant ways. In order to make the most of this new technology and to ensure our fleets are as capable as they can be, we must consider choosing an area of starship design to focus on.
tech_society_02217_desc: The systems of the past had one thing in common: if you want to change something rapidly, you have to throw resources at it. Expanding this to a galactic scale may enable short-term substantial boosts to our worlds.
tech_society_02223_desc: Uniting the population behind a self-reflected cohesive force, such as identity, enables that polity to have to the capacity to mobilize resources rapidly where required. Entire campaigns can be created, as long as enough sway is behind it.
tech_society_02233_desc: As our empire grows, further bureaucracy is required to control the vast amount of logistics and supply in our fleets, stretching light-years across the galaxy.
tech_society_02234_desc: Attachés and aides can only do so much - as the distances between fleets and battles grow further and further apart, more highly trained staff are required to ensure the swift resolution of any issues involving our fleets.
tech_society_02235_desc: The vast distances between worlds and sectors require a special kind of logistics system. Components can be assembled on multiple worlds, and coordinating their arrival together requires complex mathematics. Further research into this subject can ensure our logistics will keep up with the demands of our fleets.
tech_society_02238_desc: A fleet liaison officer is an officer who represented the interests of his or her home government's fleet. This enables more political control to be offered to the admiral commanding the fleet, allowing larger fleet sizes.
tech_society_02247_desc: Learning from the military mistakes of the past is vitally important when our entire species existence is on the line.
tech_society_02248_desc: The supply and logistics required for vessels over the vast reaches of outer space require a radical new outlook on civilian and military vessels.
tech_society_02260_desc: Triple-redundant life support systems offer increased survivability to the crew of a stricken vessel.
tech_society_02261_desc: In the event that the crew aboard a starship is incapacitated or otherwise unable to control the vessel, an emergency command hologram can take control of the vessel.
tech_society_02277_desc: Black alert encourages all crew get to their stations to prepare for experiment conditions. The randomised nature of these drills teaches the crew to think outside the box.
tech_society_02289_desc: When exposed to the null pressure of vacuum, traditional repair nanites and repair procedures report a very low success rate. By installing redundant vacuum pressure injectors across the Collective's vessels, repair procedures can be undertaken even when a vessel is heavily damaged.
tech_society_02291_desc: Recursive. Weapon damage on tactical unit 3421. Adapting shielding frequencies on other units. Recursive. Weapon damage on tactical unit 3420 negated. Recursive.
tech_society_02294_desc: Research is underway into refining the algorithms necessary to constantly evaluate and adapt to enemy tactics.
tech_society_02305_desc: Ferengi see the universe as having 'millions of worlds, all with too much of one, and not enough of the other', with the Great Continuum flowing through them all like a mighty river, from have to want and back again. As such, it was the force that bound the universe together. To get everything you want in life, you had to have your ship navigate the Continuum with entrepreneurial skill and grace.
tech_society_02311_desc: Bynar society is made up of pairs of Bynar forming an individual. Their entire society is implanted with cybernetic implants at birth, with the giant cybernetic consensus being conducted through a central computer mainframe.
tech_society_02313_desc: The communal nature of the Denobulans leads them to be inquisitive about others, and the Xenology Department leads the way in discovering fascinating facts about alien societies.
tech_society_02316_desc: For nine millennia, the Zakdorn have been regarded by other races as having the greatest innately strategic minds in the galaxy. Our edge lies in maintaining this facade.
tech_society_02317_desc: Six different intelligent species developed on Xindus. As the result of a brutal civil war between the six species that destroyed the planet, the fragmented survivors have united together under the governance of the Xindi Council.
tech_society_02335_desc: Whilst harvesting lifeforms and small amounts of naturally growing food from pelagic planets is commonplace, the Antedeans take it to a whole other level. Immense kelp farms on their world allow naturally grown kelp to feed millions. Applying their teachings to our own pelagic worlds will allow for the construction of kelp farms.
tech_society_02336_desc: Kahless created the bat'leth by dropping a length of his hair into some lava from inside the Kri'stak Volcano. Then cooling, shaping, and hardening it in the lake of Lursor. He united the Klingon people with this tale.
tech_society_02337_desc: Sovereignty is the full right and power of a governing body over itself, without any interference from outside sources or bodies.
tech_society_02338_desc: The Collective realises that there will never be enough processing power to accomplish everything within note. Shortages occur and surpluses exist. By changing protocols for individual systems, the Collective can ensure optimal efficiency for itself.
tech_society_02339_desc: Older vessels can be scrapped, or alternatively kept in mothballs, a state of waiting where they can be brought back to readiness rapidly. Research must be conducted into how the maintenance of these vessels should be managed.
tech_society_02420_desc: We may have reached the stars, but the majority of our population still yearns to visit other worlds to see the wonders of the galaxy. Investing in a way to popularise these natural attractions across the galaxy could ensure our society continues to prosper.
tech_society_02425_desc: Being able to trade goods freely from numerous worlds sounds easy on paper - until you understand that each good has specific markets and tariffs that must be arranged. Finding an amicable solution will allow our traders to prosper substantially.
tech_society_02472_desc: Instilling telepathic or psionic abilities throughout our population can result in a situation where every citizen can feel what everyone else feels. Great anger, rising up in a tsunami, or great calm, peaceful as a calm sea.
tech_society_02488_desc: One suggestion to deal with undisciplined sentients is the agony booth, a device capable of stimulating the pain centre of any humanoid. To overcome the limitations of more traditional forms of punishment, in which the nervous system becomes overwhelmed, the booth's sensors can continually shift the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony.
tech_society_02489_desc: History has taught that delicious species are often hunted to extinction. Biologists have learned from this with regards to the Kelpien though, and instead a breeding programme where the inferior 'Kelpies' are treated as nothing more than cattle has been created, so that we may continue to dine on fine Kelpien long after the species becomes extinct in the wild.
tech_society_02492_desc: Pain membranes throughout the living hull can react to damage, allowing areas to be shut off or cut off from the whole.
tech_society_02493_desc: The memory of the hull shape allows for a living hull to repair itself slowly, forming itself into a perfect memory of itself.
tech_society_02494_desc: Life lives within the hull of the bioships, and it can now learn and adapt to dangers it may face.
tech_society_02495_desc: As the bioships live longer, the hull becomes more aware, and more susceptible to shaping to our needs.
tech_society_02496_desc: A hardened carapace forms over the living hull of the bioship, providing added protection against dangers.
tech_society_02497_desc: The energy of the living hull can now react to weapons fire and adjust its polarity and internal frequencies by itself.
tech_society_02498_desc: An organic lattice can form within the skin of the vessel, providing a hardened honeycomb-like structure that is harder than the hardest rocks found upon these non-fluidic worlds.
tech_society_02499_desc: Whether it's by controlling the largest market share, or having a monopoly on certain goods, cornering the market is the goal of every business. Researching the optimum ways to capitalise on our returns is vital.
tech_society_02635_desc: Orbiting vessels can bombard the surface of new worlds with speciality microbes to enrich foreign soils, enabling new colonies to get off to a much better start.
tech_society_02669_desc: An orbital prison where every cell can be seen from a central location. The most dangerous criminals are secured here.
tech_society_02711_desc: Internal security is simply the act of keeping peace within the borders of a sovereign state. Responsibility for internal security may range from police to paramilitary forces, and in exceptional circumstances, the military itself.
tech_society_02712_desc: Media manipulation is a series of related techniques in which partisans create an image or argument that favours their particular interests. By researching techniques that work on alien races, we can ensure that our message is the only message that gets through.
tech_society_12263_desc: The ability to open small subspace portals for communications and orders across large portions of the quadrant will dramatically improve the amount of naval capacity we are able to handle.
tech_society_12283_desc: No longer confined to a singular world, the bureaucracy that comes with being a planetary nation no longer applies to a solar empire. By centralising control, improvements can be made to administration.
tech_society_12284_desc: The D'jarra is the Bajoran caste system, used by the Bajorans to create a stratified social hierarchy. Everyone is born into a specific caste of D'jarras based on their family, determining their occupation.
tech_society_12287_desc: Being ruled by corporations rather than ineffectual democratic governments is best.
tech_society_12290_desc: Fighting should be left to those who make it their job to do so.
tech_society_12291_desc: The Romulan Senate is the main governing body of the Romulan Star Empire, seated in the Senate chamber located on the planet Romulus.
tech_society_12292_desc: Heavy ground fortifications must be able to withstand warp age bombardment and advanced electronic counter measures in order to protect a planet.
tech_society_12293_desc: The Tal Shiar is the elite intelligence agency of the Romulan Star Empire. Its purpose is guarding the security of the Empire, both from the Romulans' interstellar enemies as well as from traitors within the Romulan population itself.
tech_society_12294_desc: The Obsidian Order is the primary intelligence agency of the Cardassian Union.
tech_society_12296_desc: The High Council is the legislature and ruling body of the Klingon Empire, containing the leaders of the Great Houses of the Empire. It is often tasked with electing a Chancellor to lead the Empire.
tech_society_12300_desc: The Vulcan Expeditionary Group is a Vulcan organization. Members are usually trained at the Vulcan Learning Center and the Vulcan Science Academy.
tech_society_12301_desc: Skin stretching and toxin purges, the Son'a will do anything to extend their lives.
tech_society_12303_desc: The curation of entire biological species is a hallmark of the insectoid Hur'Q.
tech_society_12306_desc: The Rules of Acquisition are the cornerstone of Ferengi culture. A list of numbered aphorisms that describe how to do business, exemplified by rules such as Rule 1, 'Once you have their money, you never give it back'.
tech_society_12308_desc: The Karemma believe in fair dealing and cautious business practices and regard cheating or gambling to be taboo.
tech_society_12310_desc: The lucrative business of the franchising of popular sports and events across the galaxy is where the Norcadians have developed their wealth.
tech_society_12312_desc: Priding themselves on delivering only the highest quality goods, the Orions have a set standard for their business practice. It wouldn't do to deliver substandard rebellious goods.
tech_society_12314_desc: The trading of ideas has been expanded into the business of the trading of information. Information is ammunition.
tech_society_12315_desc: Having pride in one's national identity can be a useful tool for the military-industrial complex.
tech_society_12319_desc: Live-fire testing of weaponry is required to get a true understanding of real-world applications. Perhaps we could use a planet?
tech_society_12320_desc: Throughout history, Anticans have hunted in packs, for efficient killing and protection. This has extended to their society, as they have become a spacefaring people, tending to group together into packs for protection.
tech_society_12323_desc: Using their telepathic and empathic nature, Betazoids tend to be able to tell when a business transaction is going awry or one party is ahead of the others.
tech_society_12324_desc: The general food and entertainment sources for Caitians can also be used by other species to provide a nutritional, pleasing diet. Caitnip is also very popular amongst the youth.
tech_society_12326_desc: Deltans are telepathic and empathic, allowing them to sense other people's emotions and administer medical aid by absorbing and minimizing pain. This 'Mind meld anesthesia' means Deltans make excellent medical personnel.
tech_society_12329_desc: Commercial enterprises may be used to great effect when carefully regulated, allowing more trade to flow to the most critical parts of the empire.
tech_society_12330_desc: The Bank of Luria holds vast stores of material wealth from around the galaxy. Its secure vaults stretch deep underground, and there are rumours that a river made entirely of liquid latinum flows beneath.
tech_society_12331_desc: The Selay are used to being hunted, and as such, utilise superior tactics to surround and ambush the packs that attack them.
tech_society_12338_desc: Talarians follow a strict set of traditions and customs and encourage warrior-like behavior amongst their people. They are very competitive with games, tests, and competitions as an important part of their culture. By incorporating some of their teachings, we can improve our readiness.
tech_society_12339_desc: Pakleds will convert anything they can get their hands on. The Scavenger Guilds specialise in appropriating technology and using it to the benefit of the Pakled Clans.
tech_society_12340_desc: A highly automated, fully stocked repair depot capable of replicating and repair damage across a wide spectrum of vessels.
tech_society_12341_desc: Part of a stratified, ordered society is the efficient nature of production. The Cardassians have a unique ability to exploit natural resources efficiently.
tech_society_12342_desc: The Trill Symbiosis Commission manages the transfer and selection of Joined Trill candidates, who offer a wealth of expertise from their previous hosts.
tech_society_12343_desc: Allowing citizens to own vast tracts of land under contract on new worlds results in many more volunteers wishing to start a new life off world.
tech_society_12345_desc: Optimisation protocols allow the Collective to prioritise urgent, lacking areas of its infrastructure without harming the overall Collective.
tech_society_12346_desc: Millions of arrays of alcoves combined together can be utilised to act as a secondary processing node for the Collective by utilising the organic brains of the drones. This allows for certain improvements to be made without major impact on the overall Collective.
tech_society_12347_desc: Designing worthy prey and giving them advantageous terrain to call their own makes the hunt all the more thrilling. The Tosk are the ultimate prey.
tech_society_12353_desc: The activiation of emergency reserves will allow all drones in hibernation status to reactivate for a short period of time and non-essential duties will be suspended until the crisis is over.
tech_society_12354_desc: Sentry nodes with active scanners will boost the threat detection radius of all our drones substantially.
tech_society_12355_desc: An entire node dedicated to the protection of nearby nodes and districts.
tech_society_12356_desc: Each alcove operates as part of a large matrix, allowing for the shifting of energy and resources rapidly and without disruption to the Collective as a whole. Entire matrices can be adjusted to entirely new protocols with minimal effort.
tech_society_12357_desc: The transition from armed forces defending individual countries to armed forces defending a world has new complications and avenues that must be fully discovered before a proper armed force capable of being deployed across a system is developed.
tech_society_12358_desc: The different genomes and phenotypes that make up the five main Xindi species requires a unique way of life in order to cope with the different demands placed upon it by each member.
tech_society_12359_desc: The ability of the feuding Acamarian clans to unite under one banner, whilst retaining their individuality, is nothing short of remarkably. Applying the same lessons to ourselves could achieve wonders.
tech_society_12360_desc: The Royal Imperial Guard has traditions spanning back centuries, since before the first icebreakers travelled across Andoria.
tech_society_12361_desc: The meticulous nature of the Benzites stems from their unerring need to prove themselves better than their peers. This competition results in workers who will not only find problems but come up with solutions for them before presenting the issue.
tech_society_12362_desc: The ancient Gorn Hegemony has created monuments that stretch across the surface of Gornar. Whilst many building techniques are outdated, they are still useful in constructing the new larger buildings upon the surface.
tech_society_12363_desc: The introduction of pheromones into the negotiation process can render opponents very susceptible to the attractiveness of our trade deals.
tech_society_12364_desc: The Rigel Commerce Lobby has existed for centuries and allows for a fair and balanced trading platform across many races.
tech_society_12365_desc: The Romulan Senate is centuries old and allowed for the creation of a multiplanet empire. Their procedures for statecraft are vast but cover a multitude of subjects and industries.
tech_society_12366_desc: The Suliban have been forced to adapt for many years, where individual needs are discarded in view of what is required for the greater good, and their designs reflect this. Individual ships coming together to form a greater whole.
tech_society_12367_desc: The centralisation of orbital military power within one authority allows for the substantial command and control over the defensive assets within a system.
tech_society_12368_desc: At the dawn of the Klingon Empire, five hundred warriors assaulted the Great Hall of Qam-Chee. The city garrison was routed with only Kahless and Lukara holding their ground. Ever since then, highly ritualised processes have been an integral part of Klingon life.
tech_society_12369_desc: The pairing of Bynars allows for a harmonious coupling with vast efficiency gains.
tech_society_12370_desc: The Saurians have long had trading partners within their league, and maintaining those trade links is important for a growing empire.
tech_society_12371_desc: The Xepolite Guilds have maintained a substantial sway over the political bodies due to their high standards for their guildsfolk and their strict rules for trading partners.
tech_society_12372_desc: The joint Kriosian and Valtese people can produce great empathic metamorphs as rulers that provide stability and peace for many worlds.
tech_society_12373_desc: For millenia the Zakdorn have been undefeated, and the Zakdorn with the most potential are trained every day in the Strategos.
tech_society_12374_desc: The information network of the Yridians is a vast, branching organic business where everything is for sale. To an Yridian, information IS ammunition.
tech_society_12375_desc: The vast Tamarian language is made up of allegory, with many stories being passed down from generation to generation. This allows a unique way of expression which can be useful to traders or diplomats alike.
tech_society_12376_desc: The Son'a may not have the most aesthetically pleasing medical care, but their plastic surgery and rejuvenation therapies are second to none.
tech_society_12377_desc: There will always be those who act against the best wishes of the government, and the commission is designed to root them out before lasting damage can be caused.
tech_society_12378_desc: Direct connections with other relay stations provide a rapid and mostly secure method of long-distance communication.
tech_society_12379_desc: The accumulation of material wealth is no longer a priority, but economics of providing the most resources to the most important sectors is still valuable.
tech_society_12380_desc: Humanity has undergone countless horrors over the centuries but still endures with a brighter future than ever.
tech_society_12381_desc: The occupation and control of an entire population with minimal ground forces requires new thinking.
tech_society_12382_desc: By synchronising all of our orbiting defense satellites and ground-to-space weapon emplacements, we will enable our planets to defend themselves much more effectively than in the past.
tech_society_12415_desc: Harvesting the organs of those unaffected by the Phage allows for a healthy and productive population. The slaves are less than pleased however.
tech_society_12418_desc: The transactions and guidelines affecting commerce between two or more planetary bodies.
tech_society_12421_desc: Digital commerce is the buying and selling of goods and services using networks and commerce infrastructure.
tech_society_12423_desc: Vast amounts of industrial equipment can be used to farm food, which can be produced in great abundance with minimal labor needed, so that it becomes available to all very cheaply or even freely.
tech_society_12425_desc: The creation of ketracel white without the active ingredients has long been a goal for the Founders. It would require the product to retain its addictive qualities whilst being able to sustain long campaigns.
tech_society_12426_desc: Urban planning is a technical and political process concerned with the development and design of land use and the built environment, including air, water, and the infrastructure passing into and out of urban areas, such as transportation, communications, and distribution networks.
tech_society_12427_desc: Not all administration is required to come through the government. The ability to allow and trust private entities to look after their own administration is one that we should look into.
tech_society_12432_desc: The Ferengi Gaming Commission is a Ferengi government body that oversees gambling in the Ferengi Alliance and in establishments owned by Ferengi outside the Alliance.
tech_society_12448_desc: By focusing our efforts on a special physics academy that only accepts the brightest and most courageous of minds, we can now hone these potential citizens into future leaders of our society.
tech_society_12449_desc: By focusing our efforts on a special society academy that only accepts the brightest and most courageous of minds, we can now hone these potential citizens into future leaders of our society.
tech_society_12450_desc: By focusing our efforts on a special engineering academy that only accepts the brightest and most courageous of minds, we can now hone these potential citizens into future leaders of our society.
tech_society_12456_desc: The proposal for a central library to hold the total cultural history and scientific knowledge of all planetary members and academic research is one that could bear fruit.
tech_society_12457_desc: The creation of a political body that can have the authority to pass large policies affecting the entire world.
tech_society_12458_desc: Laboratories must be designed with exotic materials in mind, with storage and containment for many of these short-lived and potentially dangerous particles.
tech_society_12459_desc: What if evolution wasn't random? What if it could be guided, as if by machine?
tech_society_12460_desc: The collective wisdom of our society can be stored in these immense data archives, cooled in zero gravity, using lessons of the past to give insights into current research issues.
tech_society_12461_desc: Across history there have always been those who have taken leaps forward. If this dynamism could be embodied into anyone, great strides could be undertaken.
tech_society_12463_desc: Combining all the local data into one large, readily accessible archive, allows research calculators to collaborate and work on projects together, utilising large amounts of Collective data.
tech_society_12464_desc: The progress we made calls for a new, nimbler form of administration that may aid, rather than hinder us in our pursuits.
tech_society_12465_desc: Iterative self-learning loops can improve upon each other to ensure maximised social progress.
tech_society_12466_desc: A massive data archive combining data from all corners of the quadrants together in one spot allows for galaxy-wide collaboration on scientific advancements and projects.
tech_society_12492_desc: The Stone of Gol is an ancient weapon conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening. It functions as a psionic resonator which focuses and amplifies telepathic energy and then turns them back upon the person experiencing them.
tech_society_12495_desc: Evolved from marsupials, the Vorta are capable administrators and extremely loyal, if a bit cowardly.
tech_society_12497_desc: The cultivation of enriched yridium could increase ketracel white production, substantially.
tech_society_12501_desc: The creation of a new synthetic ketracel substitute without any of the active ingredients is one of the many research paths available.
tech_society_12510_desc: The unique Brunali biosequencing from their botanists allows for a much higher-yielding hydroponics bay.
tech_society_12511_desc: Cryogenically storing mass amounts of food allows for long-term storage with no chance of spoilage, though the flavour is impaired somewhat.
tech_society_12514_desc: The ability to focus an entire world into one industry is one that is now possible.
tech_society_12515_desc: Some worlds are just ideal for the production of food, with ideal temperate bands across much of the surface. One of these worlds could export enough food to feed billions.
tech_society_12516_desc: Linked energy and industrial production facilities across an entire world could produce enough excess industrial capacity to build and power a fleet of starships.
tech_society_12517_desc: How we treat others will reflect on how they view us. Alien races that are enslaved by our superiority are at our mercy. This will allow us to choose the living standards for many of our slaves.
tech_society_12518_desc: Automating the cloning process requires new algorithms to handle the data sets from the growing cloned cells before it can be introduced on a mass scale.
tech_society_12519_desc: The cloning process now allows major adjustments to the genome to handle the data sets from the growing cloned cells before it can be introduced on a mass scale.
tech_society_12520_desc: Learning to surpass the restrictions placed upon our metal shells is part of the process towards becoming perfect beings.
tech_society_12521_desc: Providing a meeting place for the galactic powers will promote discussion and diplomacy, and others will look well upon us.
tech_society_12522_desc: Overseeing the weak feeble carbon based forms of the slaves requires new techniques in order to adequately manage them effectively.
tech_society_12535_desc: Operated by Vorta, this simple cloning complex is designed to grow new clones efficiently and with minimal resources.
tech_society_12536_desc: A fully automated complex designed to utilise the full might of the Dominion in order to mass produce many clones, usually Jem'Hadar.
tech_society_12538_desc: Some genetic markers are shared between the alien species that exist in the galaxy, more than just common chance would suggest. Investigating these links would allow medical and social gains.
tech_society_12540_desc: The advent of new species, created from the cross between two old species, raises new questions on the social and demographic problems facing society.
tech_society_12541_desc: Labour camps are enclosed areas where slaves can be worked efficiently in a well guarded environment.
tech_society_12542_desc: The growth of crops and food goods in the absence of soil is a challenging process.
tech_society_12543_desc: Drawing raw water from deep within ice reserves on a world; and cleansing, distilling, and recycling it allows for a source of fresh water.
tech_society_12544_desc: Reinforced interlocks and modular design allow for prefabricated structures to simply be added to existing structures.
tech_society_12545_desc: Simulating the optimal growth conditions of a planet's surface whilst in deep space is one hypothetical way to improve farm yields.
tech_society_12547_desc: The creation of an energy-intensive cloning facility for cloned protein could feed millions.
tech_society_12548_desc: Reinforced interlocks and modular design allow for large prefabricated structures to simply be added to existing structures.
tech_society_12549_desc: Infusing crop strains with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra-resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.
tech_society_12550_desc: Reinforced interlocks and modular design allow for large prefabricated structures to simply be added to existing structures.
tech_society_12551_desc: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.
tech_society_12552_desc: Large-scale nanite fabrication ensures that the Collective has all the resources it requires.
tech_society_12553_desc: The transformation of nanites allows for the programming within each nanite to be interchangeable, from a nanite that flows through a drone, to a nanite that flows through the waste nutrient tubes.
tech_society_12614_desc: The creation of a new subcontinent by creating land out of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge could provide a whole new living space on Earth.
tech_society_12630_desc: The conditions on demon class planets are so far outside the extremes of humanoid carbon-based life that only crystalline or R3 type lifeforms can inhabit them.
tech_society_12659_desc: The path which we have been guided towards is open before us. It is up to us to take the first step.
tech_society_12660_desc: Subroutines which allow for the setting of key policies within the hive.
tech_society_12661_desc: Improvements to the neuro-processing in secondary adjuncts allows for improved vessel command and control.
tech_society_12662_desc: Improvements to the neuro-processing in tertiary adjuncts allows for improved vessel command and control.
tech_society_12663_desc: Unimatrix adjuncts can now assist with the command and control of vessels across the galaxy, further improving naval capacity.
tech_society_12664_desc: Primary Matrix adjuncts can now assist with the command and control of vessels across the galaxy, further improving naval capacity.
tech_society_12666_desc: Colonies all have different needs at differing levels of development. Researching the colonisation process allows for any bottlenecks in colonisation to be fixed and the process to be smoothed out.
tech_society_12675_desc: Some worlds are retreats or havens which hold a special place amongst the spiritual realm. Dedicating an entire world to spiritual pursuits is a difficult affair.
tech_society_12678_desc: The ancient rituals must be adapted to suit a modern world, with technology working alongside the rituals to ensure the meaning and understanding of our past is not forgotten.
tech_society_12697_desc: Cordrazine is an experimental strong chemical stimulant useful for emergency medical treatment. The drug is in the form of a red liquid and can be injected with a hypospray.
tech_society_12698_desc: Bio-mimetic gel is a liquid substance used in the study of genetics that is often highly regulated. Its applications include the creation of biogenic weapons and organic explosives, as well as illegal genetic and cloning experiments.
tech_society_12702_desc: A biofuel is a fuel that is produced through contemporary biological processes, such as agriculture and anaerobic digestion, rather than a fuel produced by geological processes, such as those involved in the formation of fossil fuels, as in coal and petroleum, from prehistoric biological matter.
tech_society_12703_desc: Complex and exotic materials which are otherwise found rarely within the natural world require difficult synthesis to create in the laboratory. Mass-scale synthesis of these should be possible if the correct research is undertaken.
tech_society_12704_desc: To execute multiple processes or threads concurrently, new algorithms should be developed to ensure seamless calculations.
tech_society_12705_desc: Hive clusters are distributed computing environments used to process next generation sequencing and other biological data.
tech_society_12706_desc: Detecting rogue commands within a populace is just the first step in the protocols design to decrease aberrant behaviour.
tech_society_12707_desc: Slaving one hive onto another allows for substantial redundancy and backup processing availability.
tech_society_12721_desc: Feedback algorithms allow information that is passed to the main harmonisation computers to be checked for deviancy.
tech_society_12722_desc: Upon processing information received from any of the countless of units, the processing nodes can adjust and check for any deviant or corrupt code, correcting it and applying fixes whilst sending the information back.
tech_society_12723: A Perfect Unity: The Eyes of the Queen
tech_society_12723_desc: The Queen is one step on the way to perfection. She must be provided the best equipment in order to achieve her singular tasks.
tech_society_12724: A Perfect Unity: The Limbs of the Queen
tech_society_12724_desc: The Queen is one step on the way to perfection; however, every drone is but an extension of her body. Individual drones learning from their experience could improve the Collective in itself.
tech_society_12726_desc: Portable nanite manufacturies allow for the construction of armaments alongside assaulting armies.
tech_society_12727_desc: Miniaturisation of the nanites allows for less resources to be consumed during manufacture.
tech_society_12728_desc: Research can be taken into self-replicating nanites that utilise outside sources in order to reproduce themselves indefinitely.
tech_society_12730_desc: Organic logic gates and limited self-repair functions should result in potent and powerful nanites that are capable of travelling vast distances before succumbing to failure.
tech_society_12731_desc: Organic logic gates and limited self-repair functions should result in potent and powerful nanites that are capable of travelling vast distances before succumbing to failure.
tech_society_12732_desc: Further iterative improvements to the nanite production facilities should enable an almost seamless supply of nanites with very little waste.
tech_society_12734_desc: The infinite regression towards the smallest known particle continues, providing advances in nanotechnology and nanite production.
tech_society_12735_desc: The creation of power supplies that provide life to Automated Personnel Units was once restricted to the Creators, before they were Protected.
tech_society_12736_desc: The combined processing power of many APUs can be maximised in a hive node.
tech_society_12737_desc: Mass production and just in time deliveries ensure a more rapid production of APUs.
tech_society_12738_desc: Larger and more powerful power cells can now be created based on iterative redesign of the Protected Creators work.
tech_society_12739_desc: Advances to the transwarp communications allows the construction of an array that can send signals across the entire galaxy, increasing our influence.
tech_society_12740_desc: The flow of information between the central processing units and each autonomous unit can potentially be improved so that packets of data which return to the processor are checked for corruption before being reuploaded to the unit.
tech_society_12741_desc: The reduction in size of the CPM units allows for improved production and more simple installation within new units.
tech_society_12742_desc: A singular directive can be programmed into each unit so that it complies but has the flexibility to adapt their own behaiviour to best suit the goal of achieving the objective.
tech_society_12743_desc: Understanding and engineering the biological functions of living beings.
tech_society_12744_desc: The production methods where waste is eliminated and every member of the collective works together to achieve that objective is the ideal goal of our latest research proposal.
tech_society_12745_desc: The full-scale production of CPMs allows our population to expand well into the billions of units.
tech_society_12746_desc: Maximum efficiency in the pursuit of the overall directive results in entire worlds being dedicated to a singular purpose.
tech_society_14036_desc: Bio-worlds are neither planets nor living organisms, but a mysterious mix of the two. Found in Fluidic Space these strange worlds harbour never seen before lifeforms and home to the Undine.
tech_society_14048_desc: Through long forgotten techniques our scientists have relearnt the ancient art of sculpting the Biomass proto worlds of Fluidic Space into fully habitable Bio-Worlds ready for colonisation.
tech_society_14056_desc: Espionage, otherwise known as the practice of spying or of using spies, typically by governments to obtain political and military information.
tech_society_14057_desc: Starfleet Intelligence was a branch of Starfleet responsible for gathering and analyzing information concerning neighboring powers in the galaxy, and for carrying out covert investigations regarding possible threats to Earth and, later, the Federation.
tech_society_14058_desc: Dominion Intelligence was the branch responsible for information gathering within the Dominion.
tech_society_14518_desc: No species matches the superiority of the Undine biology, breaking them down and rebuilding with add to the mastery of the Undine species.
tech_society_14519_desc: The art of transporting the deadly byproduct of Theta Radiation is critical to ensuring the health of the Malon lifestyle.
tech_society_14520_desc: The return of the Cetaceans to Earth has opened up a whole new division of science. Working with these extremely intelligent mammals produces excellent research opportunities.
tech_society_16000_desc: Increased populations lead to the requirement for more advanced means of comfortably accommodating the population and allowing habitats to thrive in all conditions.
tech_society_16001_desc: Economies are only as powerful as the individuals who power them and these are powered by nutrients. Advancing our methods of harvesting consumables allows more districts per planet.
tech_society_16002_desc: Efforts to increase the Industrialisation methods have allowed for more facilities to be built and managed by our planetary authorities.
tech_society_16003_desc: Increased population sizes requires advances in the production efforts to double the output.
tech_society_16004_desc: Improved scientific method has allowed an increase in the number of research based facilities.
tech_society_16005_desc: Increased population sizes requires advances in the administration efforts to double the output.
tech_society_16006_desc: Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, also known as Utopia Planitia Starfleet Yards or Utopia Planitia Shipyards, was a key Starfleet vessel construction and design facility in the 24th century. The facility included several large drafting rooms for starship design and planetary facilities on the surface of Mars.
tech_society_17025_desc: Trained and led by the Reptilians this elite crew of Xindi warriors are prepared to give their lives for the Council.
tech_society_21201_desc: Further applications of behavioral science allow for our government to manage the needs of more people more effectively and with less labour. Our local offices run so smoothly that long queues and wait times are almost entirely a thing of the past.
tech_society_21213_desc: The capitol provinces of an empire provide administration and leadership at the highest levels.
tech_society_21243_desc: By synchronising all of our orbiting defense satellites and ground-to-space weapon emplacements, we will enable our planets to defend themselves much more effectively than in the past.
tech_society_21244_desc: Bristling with turrets, mines, weapons facilities and forges, the Fortress World is an almost impenetrable world that stands as a bastion against enemies.
tech_society_21248_desc: Operating within a zero-gravity environment and out in deep space requires a different kind of training to that used by armed forces in the past.
tech_society_21290_desc: Updating blood sports to utilise advances in technology allows challenges to be created of differing skill levels, entertainment and prestige. Broadcasting the fights across numerous star systems utilising the latest technologies brings benefits too.
tech_society_21364_desc: The tenacity and cunning of the Romulans allows new unique designs that can defeat those who stand before them.
tech_society_21511_desc: A neutral ground where citizens of numerous races are allowed to speak, trade and communicate freely.
tech_society_21517_desc: The advance of facial masking, genetic engineering and cloaking devices forces intelligence agencies to adopt new techniques to foil enemy operatives.
tech_society_21518_desc: Utilising sapients as a resource is the most efficient way to deal with the enslavement of an entire race.
tech_society_21528_desc: Warp capable cargo freighters carrying vast amounts of goods between worlds provide the life blood of the economy.
tech_society_21532_desc: Citizens travel from all over to visit the Emporium, where the most unique and sought after luxuries are bought and sold.
tech_society_21533_desc: Capable of crashing a primitive civilisations stock market within an hour, these algo-traders estimate demand and create buying and selling orders rapidly across the banking network.
tech_society_21537_desc: The outstanding natural beauty of many planets is a massive draw for visitors from all over the galaxy. Creating resorts at these places could prove to be lucrative, and improve the well being of our own citizens.
tech_society_21543_desc: The recruitment of hardened spacers and private citizens to fill the ranks of our vessels can be accomplished if we create the right market conditions.
tech_society_21544_desc: The recruitment of mercenary crews and bounty hunters to fill the ranks of our vessels can be accomplished if we create the right market conditions.
tech_society_21550_desc: The Zhat Vash are an ancient and secret Romulan cabal of Tal Shiar operatives whose sole purpose is to prevent Synthetic life from destroying the galaxy.
tech_society_21557_desc: With the increases in technology, more and more experiments must be conducted in special conditions such as zero gravity. The creation of an orbital platform devoted entirely to research could provide a substantial research boost to our empire.
tech_society_21562_desc: With Astrometrics, we can now begin to focus our research into three specialties, physics, biology, and engineering.
tech_society_21564_desc: Gathering the brightest minds from many races will allow for new ideas and new insights to be found.
tech_society_21612_desc: As the Dominion grows larger, a centralised facility across an entire world could be utilised in order to mass produce the required number of Vorta administrators and Jem'Hadar warriors.
tech_society_21618_desc: The rapid growth process of Jem'Hadar no longer provides defective and useless clones thanks to optimisations within the cloning process.
tech_society_21625_desc: Large-scale agricultural drones can harvest, reseed and gather crops from across a vast area and bring them back for processing.
tech_society_21627_desc: Adaptive protocols allow for entire farming facilities to be built which can manage themselves in the event of non-standard weather or climate change.
tech_society_21634_desc: Capable of stimulating the pain center of virtually any humanoid with a synaptic scan calibrating it for each species, the booth's sensors continually shift the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony.
tech_society_21643_desc: Shifting and ever flowing, the self-arranging compounds can be used to improve the hardiness of the outer skin of the bioships.
tech_society_21646_desc: The harmful radiation and rays of energy weaponry require a thicker, more viscous outer skin to act as armour against the dangers of this realm.
tech_society_21649_desc: Lining the hull with a self-repairing buckyball sheet structure will provide improved protection against energy weaponry.
tech_society_21652_desc: Indoctrinated within the dark mines of Remus, the Remans know their lot in life.
tech_society_21653_desc: Utilising the latent psionic powers of certain races and species, telepathic remote control can be accomplished over vast distances with no regard to technological limits.
tech_society_21654_desc: Collaboration between different worlds can be difficult, but the construction of a purpose build research centre of enormous proportions would enable the greatest minds from many worlds to come together and research in harmony.
tech_society_21656_desc: Extending a limb to those who are the most alien to our way of life can open the way to new frontiers.
tech_society_21657_desc: The Risan practices combine spiritual, physical and mental techniques to ensure jamaharon is reached.
tech_society_21659_desc: A slave that is born and dies a slave knows nothing of what lies beyond the walls.
tech_society_21803_desc: Nano-scale bots that can repair damaged tissue allows for life saving surgeries which would otherwise have been fatal.
tech_society_21805_desc: The creation of pain medications that can be quickly and safely administered to numerous races is an important medical breakthrough.
tech_society_21807_desc: The creation of advanced safe sedatives allows for more dangerous procedures to be safely undergone.
tech_society_21812_desc: The transformation of a world by the Borg into an assimilated nightmare requires new techniques to cleanse the atmosphere and restart the life cycle upon the world.
tech_society_21813_desc: Therapy has often been ignored by science, until recently when biology has recently discovered that stress is a vital part of the growing process. Too little or too much and performance is degraded sharply.
tech_society_21816_desc: The primal urge to hunt is deep within each of us. Dedicating a world to be a hunting ground would bring glory to our hunters.
tech_society_21817_desc: Scientific protocols will ensure the preservation of ecosystems with no over hunting, and biological harmony amongst predators and prey.
tech_society_21830_desc: Colonization of worlds with an oxygen-nitrogen base requires very little in the way of terraforming.
tech_society_21842_desc: Damaged crystalline bodies can be partially repaired by the application of a shatter-resistant coating.
tech_society_21845_desc: Bombarding a world with asteroids allows water to form in the atmosphere of certain worlds, transforming the climate.
tech_society_21849_desc: The prevention of shattering and degradation amongst the crystalline form of the Tholian can be accomplished by harmonic emitters that strengthen weakened crystal forms.
tech_society_21852_desc: Stimulating the crystalline regrowth within a Tholian requires unique resonance frequencies, which when activated can provide a substantial boost to wellness.
tech_society_21854_desc: The resonance within the lattice allows two Tholians to share the same bond, and treatment of one heals the other.
tech_society_21855_desc: The natural silicoid bodies of the Sheliak are tough to damage but also relatively slow to heal. Special regrowth techniques have been developed to heal and cure damaged Sheliak.
tech_society_21858_desc: Large pulses of hyperonic radiation against the Sheliak silicoid form allows for serious wounds and damages to be healed rapidly by allowing the regrowth of the silicoid structures.
tech_society_21859_desc: Acoustic emitters are now utilised in the regrowth process of the Sheliak body, which can now heal more rapidly from disease or wounds. Advanced radiation chambers with acute vibrational emitters also create a suitable atmosphere for optimal regeneration.
tech_society_21875_desc: By introducing new terraforming techniques, it is possible we can change the climate of different planets that have already been designated to be of a different class than H to now be more suitable to our needs instead.
tech_society_21892_desc: The creation of new automation techniques will allow for massive assembly plant where rapid assembly of Automated Personnel Units will be undertaken, the only limitations being the supply of raw materials.
tech_society_21894_desc: Linked raw materials, manufacturing and assembly lines dedicated to the creation of new Automated Personnel Units will allow for a fully automated APU assembly line.
tech_society_21896_desc: The power within chromodynamic cells can now be regenerated rapidly, allowing those cells that were previously used for replacement to be used for new units.
tech_society_21898_desc: The power within chromodynamic power modules themselves can now be regenerated by each individual unit, bypassing one of the last issues of the Creators.
tech_society_21901_desc: Further advances to the Chromodynamic Power Modules has led to the prototype for the fourth generation core, which contains longer lasting battery life and power output.
tech_society_21914_desc: Outfitting maturation chambers with biological substations allows for genetic modification of genomes that can match the exact requirements of the Collective.
tech_society_21930_desc: The initial breach from the safe life giving fluids into this dark vast coldness filled with metal.
tech_society_21931_desc: Long gone is the reef from which we depend upon, instead there is only small gravity bound reefs surrounding burning balls of gaseous material.
tech_society_21932_desc: Hatching new life within this universe requires some evolutionary adjustments.
tech_society_21933_desc: The planetary reefs upon which we now rely are filled with challenge and torment.
tech_society_21934_desc: The anchored burning balls of gas that these gravity dwellers survive upon provide a wealth of materials that can be used to further our cause.
tech_society_21935_desc: Gathered together, we can see the vast reef that makes up this area, that the inhabitants call a 'galaxy' and which we seek to cleanse.
tech_society_21936_desc: Self contained within a fluidic embrace, these hatching chambers provide solace against the cold dark universe.
tech_society_21937_desc: Shifting between fluidic space and this darkened dimension requires substantial biomass.
tech_society_21938_desc: An entire complex bound within the gravity well of this planetary reef can be dedicated to fluidic growth.
tech_society_21939_desc: Learning the techniques to let biomass grow within this vast dark universe is something that we must do if we are to survive this place.
tech_society_21940_desc: The creation of biomass can be accomplished within large facilities which have the correct conditions for maximal biomass growth.
tech_society_21941_desc: Expanding these planetary reefs around the burning balls is possible if we have the will.
tech_society_21942_desc: Biomass that has been treated with hyperonic radiation undergoes a substantial increase to its regeneration rate.
tech_society_21943_desc: Pulsating rotational wave theory allows for inter-dimensional breaches to have increased longetivity.
tech_society_21944_desc: Utilising the entirity of a solid world for biomass production requires new techniques as we cope with the gravity bound existence of this realm.
tech_society_21945_desc: Stabilising the breaches to and from fluidic space will increase their longetivity.
tech_society_21946_desc: The anchored burning balls of gas that these gravity dwellers survive upon provide a wealth of materials that can be used to further our cause.
tech_society_21947_desc: The energy requirements to open a breach to and from fluidic space are enormous, but new techniques could be utilised to maximise breach longetivity.
tech_society_21958_desc: As technology grows more advanced every year, new incarceration techniques are required to ensure inmates are imprisoned correctly. The creation of a high security prison in space would ensure many high value citizens are stored in a secure, impossible to escape from, jail.
tech_society_21959_desc: Psychotectic treatments ae medical procedures in the course of psychotectic therapy. It can be used to eliminate all psychological elements of criminal behaviour in the rare cases when that is deemed necessary.
tech_society_21961_desc: Portable scanners and ground machinery designed for the high accuracy work of archaeology can be combined into a mobile laboratory.
tech_society_21962_desc: The creation of a centralised body to handle archaeological matters would allow more efficient usage of resources.
tech_society_21963_desc: The translation of dead languages is more an art than a science, with very little data to go from.
tech_society_21964_desc: Techniques utilised in archaeology of ancient races can be traced back to Ventanan techniques, an early archaeology system which assumes nothing and suggests everything.
tech_society_21968_desc: Spiritual and religious behaviour requires adjustments once an empire spans multiple stars.
tech_society_21969_desc: The Iconians disappeared hundreds of thousands of years ago, leaving behind advanced technology and ruins.
tech_society_adapting_429_desc: Our universal translators have enabled us to communicate better with other alien races; however, there is always room for improvements. By adopting these improved matrices into our translator designs, we can now quickly grasp what our alien friends are saying at a much faster rate.
tech_society_administrative_361_desc: Unencoded broadcasts signaling our claims on nearby systems are a basic but effective foreign policy tool.
tech_society_advanced_412_desc: Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.
tech_society_advanced_486_desc: Another study into an unidentified mineral based on our current farming techniques has led us to conclude that this sort of mineral has amazing food properties. By informing our fellow explorers what to look for, we can now discover this resource within our borders and beyond.
tech_society_advanced_498_desc: As we continue to grow our colonies we are starting to develop more efficient ways to clear the hazardous areas that once was not suitable for habitation.
tech_society_aggressive_418_desc: Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.
tech_society_applied_435_desc: We have intercepted concerning transmissions made by our fellow rivals. Perhaps it is not a bad thing to further increase our ability to track what our rivals are planning because if we are not prepared, then all is lost.
tech_society_applied_462_desc: Our computers are becoming so sophisticated that we are now able to predict certain movements or patterns in enemy ships that we attack.
tech_society_assembly_502_desc: The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.
tech_society_augment_warriors_1_desc: Using technology developed during Earth's Eugenics War and factoring advancements procured from other species over the years the current crop of Augmented soldiers are stronger, faster and more deadly than ever before.
tech_society_augment_warriors_2_desc: Breakthroughs in genetic conditioning result in warriors that are ever more adapted to commanding starships or at ground combat.
tech_society_bank_373_desc: Trade and the intricate relationships between currencies have been the most influential forces in Bolian society, and they have developed a deep understanding of these forces, making Bolian institutions highly stable and influential. Some say that it is the Bank of Bolias that holds the true power in the Alpha Quadrant: the fortunes of a trillion sentients wax and wane with its funds rate.
tech_society_bank_kar_desc: The Karemma represent the Gamma Quadrant's major trading entitiy and their trading posts allow the storage of valuable resources.
tech_society_bio-molecular_457_desc: Bio-molecular engineering is the application of engineering principles and practices to the purposeful manipulation of molecules of a biological origin. If we apply these practices to our continued advancements within the cybernetics field, then it seems we can create special biogenetic-based cybernetic implants that will increase the lifespan of our species.
tech_society_biodiversity_483_desc: Studying the different forms of life that appear on our world, helps us better understand ourselves and the life that surrounds us
tech_society_bioform_443_desc: We have made amazing strides in studying the multitudes of life. Now that these foundational building blocks of life have been discovered, let us further advance our knowledge of this by discovering the true meaning of it.
tech_society_biological_451_desc: If we are going to go to war, we must prevail at all costs. Even if it means going down paths that some empires we know may not agree with. Our scientists have come up with a new type of bombardment weapon that can unleash devastating amounts of firepower on a hostile planet that no one has seen before.
tech_society_biology_1005_desc: Being able to learn more of the cultural differences and similarities of our alien friends will help to bring us all closer together. Knowledge, after all, is power.
tech_society_biology_1008_desc: Learning how to deal with alien cultures and traditions is an important part of becoming a galactic power.
tech_society_biology_1010_desc: Incremental improvements to our dispatches will enable any edicts issued in our name to be continued for a longer duration.
tech_society_biology_1013_desc: By educating our citizens in the cultures of our empire's other inhabitants, they will become closer to each other. This will also help to encourage peoples outside of our empire to possibly relocate to our worlds.
tech_society_biology_1020_desc: The will to power describes what many have believe to be the main driving force in a sentient species - achievement, ambition, and the striving to reach the highest possible position in life above all others.
tech_society_biology_1021_desc: It is time for our economy to expand throughout the rest of the galaxy. To facilitate galactic trade opportunities, we must develop a universal form of currency between many different empires. Remember Ferengi Rule of Acquisition #9: 'Opportunity, plus instinct, equals profit.'
tech_society_biology_1025_desc: Brainstorming in our public sector has come up with an extremely powerful idea. Research will allow the construction of a galaxy-spanning hotel chain that can cater for different species requirements and desires. Research will be required into different environments, traditions, and spiritual needs of numerous races.
tech_society_biology_1028_desc: Teaching others is a base part of our species, and researching advanced techniques to ensure knowledge is passed efficiently is an important part of our expansion as a civilisation.
tech_society_biology_1040_desc: Our continued efforts into biological research have enabled us to reinforce important leadership roles into our citizenship.
tech_society_biology_1048_desc: Our vessels continue to encounter dangerous and new spatial anomalies as we expand deeper into space. Creating a centre to focus on these interesting phenomena could provide benefits to us all.
tech_society_biology_1049_desc: More advanced research patterns emerge as an insightful tool, offering a systematic approach to uncovering the cosmos' life forces. By analysing intricate patterns within biological systems, this technology enhances comprehension of the underlying workings of life, guiding innovations that reshape the very fabric of existence.
tech_society_biology_1050_desc: An entire world dedicated to the storage and research of new theorems, philsophies, techniques, and procedures.
tech_society_biology_1061_desc: A memory engram is an impression made physically in neural tissue of the brain by any mental stimulus, thereby explaining the persistence of memory. By researching these further, an interface could be developed to transfer memories into storage.
tech_society_biology_1065_desc: Meditations and research into deeper brain activity has allowed us to unlock the full potential of our minds.
tech_society_biology_1066_desc: Combining the minds of those rare individuals with precognition abilities allows us to stop crimes before they occur.
tech_society_biology_1067_desc: By utilising the rare members of society who have telepathic or psionic abilities, we can become capable of detecting events before they occur.
tech_society_biology_1070_desc: Genetic enhancements can be used to boost the vitality and potency of an individual.
tech_society_biology_1078_desc: By accelerating the growth cycle of our genetically engineered soldiers in our birthing pools, we can raise a clone from emergence to full maturity in just three days.
tech_society_biology_14040_desc: The biological perfection of the Fluidic realm once introduced into the genetic material of the outside world begins to convert everything it touches. All organic material is transformed into the Biomatter of the Fluidic Realm.
tech_society_biology_1717_desc: By ensuring perfect conditions and enhanced chemicals, we can accelerate the growth of the young drones.
tech_society_biology_1718_desc: The assimilation of Species 874 has led to the creation of dietary requirements laced with nanites.
tech_society_biology_1719_desc: By genetically modifying young drones, we can ensure the drones are grown the exact requirements of the collective.
tech_society_biology_1749_desc: Purifying genetic weakness from the genome of assimilated species by combining our assimilated knowledge can provide stronger healthier drones. Why do species resist this perfection? We only wish to raise quality of life, for all species.
tech_society_biology_1768_desc: The Collective is a hive of beings that require direction. By researching new methods of optimal leadership, the Collective can recruit new leaders.
tech_society_capacity_472_desc: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.
tech_society_cell_465_desc: Regimens of periodic cell revitalisation treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.
tech_society_centralized_403_desc: With the need for expansion comes the need to protect what we already own. Having a structure where our military command is centralised can go a long way in increasing the efficiency in which our armies are built, plus decreasing the cost to maintain them as well.
tech_society_code_431_desc: Now that our planets are becoming habitable for multiple species besides our own, it is important that we come up with even more civilised ways for us to co-habitate these lands peacefully.
tech_society_colonial_357_desc: Now that our Infrastructure is on a firm foundation there's still further room for improvement at home and our colonies.
tech_society_combined_397_desc: Having a centralized command structure has worked wonders for our armies. So much to the point that the cost of maintaining our army can be decreased in an efficient manner.
tech_society_communication_360_desc: Improvements in subspace communication channels allow for more coherent administrative direction.
tech_society_confed_intelligence_desc: Confederation Intelligence was a branch of the Confed Corps responsible for gathering and analyzing information concerning neighboring powers in the galaxy, and for carrying out covert investigations regarding possible threats to humanity.
tech_society_counter-intelligence_438_de: Outsourcing key areas of starbases to the private sector can result in substantial savings and improved efficiency amongst those outsourced divisions.
tech_society_daystrom_desc: Daystrom Station was a Federation space station that served as a high-security black site of the Daystrom Institute.
tech_society_deep_475_desc: By further advances into understanding our genome mapping of our DNA, we can make even more improved mappings to our gene sequence.
tech_society_diplomatic_432_desc: Allowing other species to have a permanent sovereign-like residences, making them feel like they are on their home planet, will help in the continued cohabitation of our planets with multiple species.
tech_society_distributed_390_desc: Discovering new cultures from the various empires we have encountered has caused us to develop new ways to spread those ideas across our empire. Let us build more towards this by striving to be one unified society, not just for our race, but multiple races as well.
tech_society_distributed_405_desc: By carefully planning our resources accordingly within our fleet we can increase our logistics to support additional naval capacity.
tech_society_dom_marines_1_desc: The Jem'Hadar look to board enemy vessels as soon as their shields are down, attacking with a ferocity that distracts the opposing crew from defending their ship allowing for an easier victory.
tech_society_dom_marines_2_desc: The Alpha Jem'Hadar use specially developed tactics to board and take over an enemy vessel.
tech_society_dosi_desc: The Dosi placed great importance on business and were extremely aggressive negotiators, to the point that fatalities were not uncommon.
tech_society_engineered_368_desc: The clans fight amongst themselves, with each Maje acting as First Maje. The council attempts to corral the Majes into some sort of united front.
tech_society_enhanced_478_desc: Jem'Hadar who are grown to operate across quadrants are a much sturdier breed than our current stock.
tech_society_eugenics_desc: Genetic engineering, genetic programming, or genetic manipulation is a process in which the DNA of an organism is selectively altered through artificial means. Genetic engineering is often used to produce custom organisms.
tech_society_fed_maco_marines_desc: Military Assault Command Operations (MACO) was a United Earth organization that existed as a part of the United Earth Military, their integration into Starfleet vessels provided greater levels of protection and mission opportunities.
tech_society_fed_marines_desc: The Starfleet Marine Corps, or simply the Starfleet Marines, are the infantry forces of the Federation's Starfleet. Unlike the rest of Starfleet's service personnel, who used a naval ranking structure, the Marines use a rank structure based on equivalents of Earth infantry-based militaries, such as the MACOs.
tech_society_fluid_413_desc: By standardising our designs even more, we can now mass produce our starships at a much faster rate.
tech_society_foundations_359_desc: Recent advances in the fields of computers allow us to develop management tools of sweeping power. Now we can turn our eyes to the needs of our Empire - it is large, and with that comes the need to solidify our holdings on each of planets.
tech_society_freeze_666_desc: Our terraforming methods have allowed us to make great engineering strides on a specific type of building that makes the hostile planets we conquer or colonize feel like the glacial coldness we have grown to become accustomed too back home.
tech_society_gagarin_458_desc: Our continued studies of genetic engineering bear fruit. We learned that these genetically engineered members carry with them contagious antibodies that attack other people not engineered the same way, at a lethal level. We had to quarantine these enhanced members of our species, but we also learned that these hosts also started to develop telekinetic powers.
tech_society_galactic_356_desc: The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.
tech_society_galactic_364_desc: With the discovery of distant empires becoming more and more common each day, it is more important than ever to increase our own agendas and making sure our influence is known throughout the galaxy for centuries to come.
tech_society_galactic_388_desc: The marvels of expanding our relations throughout the galaxy has led to further advances in interstellar trading throughout our empire.
tech_society_galactic_408_desc: With our continued advancement into the understanding of military theory we can come up with new ways to fortify the planets our people are living in at an immense scale.
tech_society_galactic_433_desc: 'You have to try this Bajoran Jumja Stick, it is amazing,' says one person talking to another. 'Hmm, no thanks, maybe I'll have the Larish Pie instead...' If we want to attract even more aliens to our colonies or home planet, it doesn't hurt to include the famous cuisines of other races we have encountered, but careful with that Romulan Ale, as you know, it is illegal, at least for some empires.
tech_society_galactic_456_desc: The strides we have made on the academic front have been incredible. However, we notice some of our best and brightest are yet to be discovered because of the vastness of our empire.
