By focusing our efforts on a special academy that only accepts the brightest and most courageous of minds, we can now hone these potential citizens into future leaders of our society.
tech_society_galactic_archivism_desc: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.
tech_society_gene_481_desc: Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.
tech_society_genome_447_desc: Mapping the genome of an individual through the sequencing of their DNA opens up for tailored medical treatments and therapies.
tech_society_glacier_665_desc: The Breen are one of the few races that prefer the coldness of Class P planets even more so than Andorians. By introducing new terraforming techniques it is possible we can change the atmosphere of different planets, that have already been designated to be of a different class than P to now be more suitable to our needs instead.
tech_society_global_394_desc: If we are to be a long-lasting empire, it is vital that we come up with ways to better protect what we already have.
tech_society_gravitational_501_desc: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.
tech_society_heuristic_450_desc: Heuristics is a technique that employs a practical method utilising self-learning protocols via trial and error. By using this approach and creating a large dataset, it has allowed us to foresee many possible defective genes and circumvent them, thereby leading to an increase in quality of life.
tech_society_hir_marines_1_desc: The Hunt is always on and what better place than on our preys own ship.
tech_society_hir_marines_2_desc: Led by the Hirogen Beta the hunting party is prepared to take the hunt to the preys ship.
tech_society_hir_marines_3_desc: Led by the Hirogen Alpha the hunting party is prepared to take the hunt to the preys ship.
tech_society_holographic_414_desc: With our fleet growing to ever-expanding numbers and our continued advances in the field of logistics, we have now developed a way for us to track our fleets at an unprecedented level. Since our fleets are now easily tracked across many light-years via central command, our ability to control them is improved.
tech_society_holographic_461_desc: With our continued advancements into holographic fields, we can now make new educational outlets available for all our students in our academies by introducing these advanced holographic simulations of what we know or may not know is out there. Doing so will better prepare our future leaders to expect the unexpected that goes with traveling through space.
tech_society_hyperonic_660_desc: Our terraforming methods have allowed us to make great engineering strides on a specific type of building, that makes the hostile planets we conquer or colonize feel like the eternal deserts we know all too well back home.
tech_society_imperial_370_desc: We have come up with better methods to present our edicts in a more favorable light to our people, as a result implementing our edicts will now be less of a hassle for us.
tech_society_improved_477_desc: Our continued studies in understanding this most important substance that is key to our genetically engineered soldier's survivability, will lead us to an even greater ability to mass produce this important isogenic enzyme at a much larger scale.
tech_society_intergalactic_499_desc: As a colony grows, so does its medical needs. Larger colonies are potentially exposed to more dangerous pathogens on alien worlds.
tech_society_interstellar_363_desc: Further advances to our subspace communications will allow us the ability to be in constant contact with our most far reaching outposts.
tech_society_interstellar_410_desc: War is sometimes inevitable and if this is going to be the case we must expand our fleet capacity even further, so that our empire will feel secure from our rivals.
tech_society_interstellar_427_desc: Ferengi Rule of Acquisition #74 'Knowledge equals profit'. Most find them annoying or selfish, but perhaps they do know a thing or two about profits. Knowing our friendly empires and understanding what makes them tick can only be beneficial for us in the long run, especially when negotiating trade deals with them.
tech_society_interstellar_446_desc: Introducing global buildings of education in each of our planets about our interstellar journeys will make further generations even more prepared to face/understand the rigors of space travel and how we can better prepare ourselves for what is truly out there.
tech_society_kdf_marines_1_desc: The honour and glory of ship to ship combat is bountiful, but nothing comes close to the feel of a Bat'leth in a warriors hand and the taste of a foes blood on your tongue.
tech_society_kdf_marines_2_desc: Specially trained warriors trained in hit and run tactics prepared to board enemy vessels and cause as much damage as possible.
tech_society_kdf_marines_3_desc: A Klingon warrior is prepared to give their lives in service of the empire and these elite forces are prepared to give their lives to damage or capture their target.
tech_society_long-term_401_desc: Space is infinite, to that end we need to make sure our crew and supplies is well taken care of for the long journeys that space travel entails.
tech_society_manifest_365_desc: We must have the courage to seize our fate and make true what was always meant to be.
tech_society_marines_1_desc: Space combat is usually reserved for phasers, torpedoes however on occasions it is necessary to fight hand to hand. Marine training onboard a starship is specialised work.
tech_society_marines_2_desc: Advanced training methods allow for greater ship boarding and crew to crew fighting methods, utilizing the unique contours of a starship.
tech_society_mars_503_desc: Mars, a planet that's been slowly made habitable due to our advances in creating natural habitat domes for our people to live in. However, with our increased understanding on how comets work there could be a way to divert them to the Mars polar ice caps. It may be worth investigating this to see if we can truly change the atmosphere on Mars itself for the better.
tech_society_mass-scale_490_desc: This is the way of the Doctrine, as it has always been.
tech_society_mass_471_desc: Gene Banks filter and curate available genomes for deployment in clones.
tech_society_mobile_409_desc: Due to our constant studies of field repairs we think we have made a significant breakthrough. By introducing this new component within our battleships we believe it can be an effective method to now act as the staging point that will send out mobile repair units to our surrounding ships that will automatically start repairing damaged parts of the affected ships out in space.
tech_society_mod_undine_desc: The spawning process now allows major adjustments to the genome to handle the data sets from the growing fluidic cells before it can be introduced on a mass scale.
tech_society_modular_407_desc: By introducing a streamlined concept into the way our ships are being designed, we can reduce the cost it takes to maintain these types of ships.
tech_society_modular_416_desc: Introducing common formation terminology amongst our vessels will help us grow more accustomed to working in large cohesive formations.
tech_society_morphegenic_474_desc: From its cradle as a purely pharmaceutical venture, advancements in our understanding of the morphogenetic field allow for direct, subconscious interfaces with organic units.
tech_society_nano-vitality_484_desc: Infusing crop strains with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.
tech_society_naval_404_desc: By placing navigational markers across sectors of space we have already explored, not only provides an aide or safety for our people that travel the stars, but it also increases the capacity for us to deploy more ships to protect what we already own.
tech_society_nerve_420_desc: Careful tuning of pain receptors allows soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.
tech_society_new_worlds_1102_desc: The colonisation of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.
tech_society_new_worlds_1105_desc: While flesh and blood doctors may be preferred over their holographic counterparts by patients, the usefulness of long-term holographic doctors is hard to disagree with. The holograms may lack a certain 'bedside manner', but they are able to act as general knowledge doctors, specialists, and even sometimes as nurses, all at the same time.
tech_society_new_worlds_1110_desc: Pioneering incentives such as land, titles, mineral rights or absolution from crimes allows the amount of manpower dedicated to new worlds to be increased magnificently. Our peoples are excited about our new worlds.
tech_society_new_worlds_1113_desc: In order to standardise our terraforming efforts, a terraforming device containing all the necessary seeds, fertilizer, power generators, and replicators that a planet needs has been designed, known as the G.E.C.K. for short.
tech_society_new_worlds_1114_desc: Our advances in nanite technology allow us to introduce programmed nanites on a foreign world which can break down harmful pathogens and obstacles on the planet in preparation for colonisation.
tech_society_new_worlds_1116_desc: Several members of our private sector have decided to commercialize colonisation. While this does reduce the mineral cost for establishing new colonies, the colonists that these businesses recruit may have different cultural and political philosophies from the rest of our citizens.
tech_society_new_worlds_1117: The Call of the Great Beyond
tech_society_new_worlds_1117_desc: Our citizens have heard, and answered, the creed of exploration. Some of our brightest minds have volunteered to serve on distant outposts, for the sake of expanding our territory.
tech_society_new_worlds_1118_desc: Our mastery of the natural world allows our colonies to work in harmony with nature across numerous worlds, allowing the removal of dangerous areas.
tech_society_new_worlds_1122_desc: To remove pollutants from the atmosphere of our worlds we have theorised a barystatic atmospheric filter. Functioning by projecting negatively-charged ions into the stratosphere, which then transfer their charge to atmospheric pollutants, the thus-charged pollutants are then collected by the positively-charged intake vents of the barystatic filter.
tech_society_new_worlds_1132_desc: Dedicating a planet to the pursuits of happiness in numerous forms increases its desirability and the happiness of those already on the planet.
tech_society_new_worlds_1134_desc: In order to purify worlds outside the regular temperature range of our Y class planets, our people require armoured exosuits that can enable us to bring the purity of our world to them.
tech_society_new_worlds_1136_desc: Creating a colony dome that brings the atmosphere, pressure, and heat of Tholia to other worlds is of vital importance. Research into creating a standardised colony module for our ships must be a priority.
tech_society_new_worlds_1137_desc: By bombarding the atmosphere with thermionic radiation, we can eventually bring worlds to more closely match the pure temperatures of Tholia.
tech_society_new_worlds_1140_desc: By generating hyperonic radiation and emitting it into the atmosphere of our worlds, we can further increase their habitability.
tech_society_new_worlds_1141_desc: The Corporate requires more resources be invested in terraforming worlds to be more suitable for habitation. The initial sunk cost will be recouped over time.
tech_society_new_worlds_1143_desc: By bombarding the atmosphere with thermionic radiation, we can eventually bring worlds to more closely match the pure temperatures of Class Y magma worlds.
tech_society_new_worlds_1149_desc: To combat the searing temperatures found often on other worlds across the galaxy, our Vel'sh scientists and engineers are putting together a suit that will allow our peoples to inhabit many worlds.
tech_society_new_worlds_1161_desc: Penal systems can be unruly, but the introduction of a bureaucracy that deals specifically with penal issues can increase the productivity of indentured workers.
tech_society_new_worlds_1162_desc: In order for our civilisation to make better decisions moving forward, we must learn from the successes and failures of our past. 'Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.'
tech_society_new_worlds_1163_desc: For minor crimes, rehabilitating the criminal may be possible if resources are invested in the education and counselling of these individuals.
tech_society_new_worlds_1166_desc: Research into subspace radio allows for communications over long distances. By opening subspace radio up to the population, we can increase our communications and logistics lines.
tech_society_new_worlds_1168_desc: By modifying the minds of those under therapy, we can potentially remove deviations from the norm. There are potential side effects, however, which require further research.
tech_society_new_worlds_1169_desc: Xenoarchaeology, a branch of xenology dealing with extraterrestrial cultures, is a form of archaeology. The field is concerned with the study of material remains to reconstruct and interpret past life-ways of alien civilisations.
tech_society_new_worlds_1172_desc: Turning the entire surface of a world into a living museum where biological beings are stored, harvested, and controlled is the epihpany of Hur'Q curation.
tech_society_new_worlds_1184_desc: Cardassia First, above all else. Cardassians must work together to form a perfect Union, and any dissidents or alien influences must be crushed.
tech_society_new_worlds_1185_desc: The first members of a species into space are part of their space corps and are often the bravest members of that species.
tech_society_new_worlds_1190_desc: Deep studies of our crystalline nature, as well as naturally forming crystal structures, has led us to the belief that we can adjust our harmonic resonance within our own growing crystalline bodies, resulting in potential enhancements to our crystalline base.
tech_society_new_worlds_1191_desc: Deep studies of our silicon nature as well as naturally forming silicon structures has led us to the belief that we can adjust our harmonic resonance within our own growing silicon bodies, resulting in potential enhancements to our silicon base.
tech_society_new_worlds_1704_desc: Transwarp Communications allow rapid communication and data transmission between far flung colonies and species, increasing the rate in which we can expand across new worlds.
tech_society_new_worlds_1708_desc: Research into a vast industrial manufacturing hub connecting throughout the unicomplex would allow for the Collective to grow larger.
tech_society_new_worlds_1709_desc: Generating power and distributing across the unicomplex is a process that takes many resources. By researching more efficient ways to do this, the Collective can grow larger.
tech_society_new_worlds_1710_desc: The expansion of the Unicomplex will provide additional segments available for housing drones, manufacturing or research.
tech_society_new_worlds_1735: A Perfect Unity: Body of the Queen
tech_society_new_worlds_1735_desc: As perfection grows near, our Queen can invoke her will upon the infrastructure of the Collective, ensuring a more optimal usage of resource, reducing the burden of maintenance.
tech_society_new_worlds_1756_desc: Improvements to logistical requirements and transport arrangements allows for a more rapid reallocation of drones to areas where they are required.
tech_society_new_worlds_water_desc: The sulfuric skies of these wet worlds are hostile to all species that require oxygen to breath. However, species who spend their lives in the water have unique insight into how to manipulate underwater ecosystems to remove the toxins.
tech_society_open-standard_430_desc: If we allow the ability to share these upgraded matrixes of our universal translator to our alien friends, it will make contact with these empires more fluent and beneficial for us.
tech_society_orbital_480_desc: The challenges inherent in cultivating crops in zero-g are fairly unique, but far from insurmountable.
tech_society_planetary_355_desc: Administration teams will help to streamline processes in the economic and logistics chains on our planets resulting in increased efficiency.
tech_society_planetary_367_desc: Ancient warring tribes, historic nations in conflict, now unified in empire. We must not, will not, crumble.
tech_society_predictive_454_desc: Sometimes through the hard rigors of education, our young need a little guidance. Let us offer special tutoring programs to assist them, so that they may one day be as effective as the best and brightest of our students who graduate.
tech_society_protein_479_desc: Space travel can be long and with that comes the need to pack more than we need for our travels in space. Luckily, we believe we have found ways to replicate certain foods at the molecular level. These food replicators give us the ability to now lessen the amount of edible food supplies we have to give to our ships, decreasing food consumption at a global scale.
tech_society_psycho-history_444_desc: The earth-shattering discoveries we have made about the foundational building blocks of life have caused us to perfect the evolution in what we study as a whole. Let us create a building that showcases all we have learnt to increase our society research to unparalleled heights.
tech_society_radical_453_desc: Unidentified minerals brought back to us for study has led us to believe that there are certain properties within these deposits that can increase the lifespan of our people. Now that we know what to look for, we can easily spot them in planets we have or haven't discovered yet.
tech_society_retrovirus_468_desc: By introducing various non-lethal viruses into the genome mapping of our species, we can further increase the growth within our population of our colonized planets.
tech_society_ritualized_381_desc: Tellarites take great pleasure in arguing for the sake of seeing who can come up with better reasoning and supporting evidence. Although this has led to great misunderstandings, once their culture became understood, this concept led to an openness and willingness to confront ideas and the established order, in turn leading to a society governed by reason, rather than tradition and spiritualism.
tech_society_rom_marines_desc: The Reman's serve little purpose in our military, but their impressive strength and fearsome nature make them excellent shock troops.
tech_society_s31_desc: Section 31 was an organization which claimed to protect the security interests of United Earth and, later, the United Federation of Planets. The organization claimed to be sanctioned by the original Starfleet Charter, Article 14, Section 31 of which allowed for extraordinary measures to be taken in times of extreme threat
tech_society_science_455_desc: If we are to one day be on the cutting edge of technology, then we need to make sure we have multiple options presented to us at each critical step in deciding what to research next.
tech_society_scion_663_desc: In a time long past, the Scions of the Great Link lead the changelings. Now they lead the Dominion in an effort to make the galaxy's planets more hospitable for them.
tech_society_secret_436_desc: Sometimes to get the job done, we need a special branch that is outside the norm of our standard armies. Let us create a new branch within our military that we can use for when these situations arise.
tech_society_secrets_442_desc: Having the opportunity to study the multitudes of life lets us find some common ground for all living beings. The foundational building blocks of life.
tech_society_selected_470_desc: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivised, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.
tech_society_self-assembling_402_desc: Our medical scientists have been experimenting with Nanotechnology for quite some time. In our studies of these robotic creatures we think it is now possible to improve upon this tech at an engineering level as well. Now our newly designed Nanobots can use these new forms of nanites and apply it to our ship building process to save ourselves some of the cost that goes into upgrading our starships.
tech_society_sentient_464_desc: The concept of managing individuals as resources within larger systems of production must, by necessity, become more flexible as the potential natures of the managed individuals grow ever more numerous.
tech_society_sheliak_517_desc: The Sheliak are one of the few races that are able to settle on Class H planets as they prefer an environment that is the same temperature as their bodies. By introducing new terraforming techniques it is possible we can change the atmosphere of different planets that have already been designated to be of a different class than H to now be more suitable to our needs instead.
tech_society_space_393_desc: Our continued advances with the construction of interstellar ships have developed a need for more specialised bridge designs for our spaceships. More importantly, if we are going to explore the stars we must better prepare ourselves for the dangers or perhaps enlightenment that comes with exploring the unknown.
tech_society_space_396_desc: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger manoeuvres.
tech_society_special_395_desc: Let us come up with better methods to improve our armies for when the situation arises.
tech_society_stasis_507_desc: We have found worlds that can be extremely habitable for settling, but are very far away from our home planet and dangerous to our colonists if they touch down and settle right away. By suspending all cellular activity, we can now develop our distant colonies at a much faster rate while our colonist remain in stasis whilst the most dangerous hazards are cleared away.
tech_society_statecraft_1179_desc: The threat of danger, the taste of fear in the air, the exultation and pride as prey is located and hunted. All these sensations come from the thrill of the hunt - whether you catch the prize at the end is irrelevant, as long as the chase is there.
tech_society_statecraft_1180_desc: Armed ships owned by private individuals have been used in the past to bolster navies, as long as they are issued the correct letter of marque.
tech_society_statecraft_1181_desc: Whilst researching ways of privatising exploitation of resources, our researchers came upon the idea of private companies which can exploit native populations and resources alongside our naval forces. Offering these private charters could be extremely lucrative.
tech_society_statecraft_1714_desc: A Queen allows for situational improvements in the allocation of drones. Improvements to the Queen protocol will further increase the Collective's goals.
tech_society_statecraft_1715_desc: A Queen allows for situational improvements in the allocation of drones. Improvements to the Queen protocol will further increase the Collective's goals.
tech_society_statecraft_1721: A Perfect Unity: Hands of the Queen
tech_society_statecraft_1721_desc: As perfection grows near, our Queen can invoke her will upon the armadas of ships, ensuring less wastage of resources and more efficient use of the vessels.
tech_society_statecraft_1763_desc: Continual improvements to the manufacturing of the focusing, powering and emittance of high energy pulses can be transferred to weapon design.
tech_society_statecraft_1764_desc: The installation of armoured exo-plating to the body of a drone can increase survivability and combat effectiveness.
tech_society_statecraft_1765_desc: Modular limb attachments ranging from heavy weaponry to repair tools can enable a tactical drone to perform numerous tasks with efficiency.
tech_society_statecraft_901_desc: Before we can continue to expand our borders, we must look inwards and make sure our infrastructure is sound. Not only at home, but to our colonies as well.
tech_society_statecraft_907_desc: Through elegantly crafted computer networks and an advanced understanding of sapient behavior, we can optimise our institutions to maximise efficiency while minimising corruption.
tech_society_statecraft_911_desc: Further applications of behavioral science allow for our government to manage the needs of more people more effectively and with less labour. Our local offices run so smoothly that long queues and wait times are almost entirely a thing of the past.
tech_society_statecraft_912_desc: Coupling recent advances in the understanding of the behavior of individuals with new methods of analyzing large data sets allows us to predict how billions-strong groups of individuals will respond to the actions of our government. These methods constitute a powerful new tool for our propagandists - we can be more responsive than ever to the needs and concerns of our key supporters.
tech_society_statecraft_915_desc: Managing a nation spread over several planets brings new challenges that call for an entirely new set of governmental paradigms. Our political experts have a proposition for a new form of government that will clarify the powers and responsibilities of our local and regional administrators while maintaining the central authority of our homeworld.
tech_society_statecraft_916_desc: The lowliest of workers are easily forgotten in a galactic-scale bureaucracy, and without someone to advocate for their interests, those forgotten workers can easily become disaffected. Centralized representation for labourers increases the perception of fairness and good governance throughout our empire.
tech_society_statecraft_918_desc: By further improving our computer networks and interfaces, adapting our institutions to suit the individual needs of each colony, and applying cutting-edge developments in sociology, psychology, and political science, we can manage more of our holdings directly without overburdening our bureaucrats.
tech_society_statecraft_923_desc: As the rightful rulers of the entire galaxy, the Xeno scum remain a threat and a nuisance to Husnockian dominance.
tech_society_statecraft_924_desc: As colonies expand further into the darkness, more and more bureaucracy is required to keep the logistical problems at bay.
tech_society_statecraft_925_desc: Strange, weird, and wonderful sights come from the darkness of space. We should investigate ways of ensuring the borders are secure and monitoring signals from the deep black.
tech_society_statecraft_929_desc: Sometimes the written form is the best way to convince our people that our traditions and beliefs are superior. Let us create a charter that reflects the benefits of our governing ethics for the rest of our subjects to finally understand what it means to be a part of something great.
tech_society_statecraft_930_desc: This palatial estate is not just a status symbol for our planetary governors, it is a state-of-the-art governmental facility in its own right. Adaptable dining halls can accommodate guests-of-honor of any species or culture with ease, and the living quarters are optimized to make the job of managing a planet as easy as possible, such that even a mediocre bureaucrat can govern a planet effectively.
tech_society_statecraft_931_desc: Military Assault Command Operations troops (MACOs) are some of the best-trained in the quadrant. Extensively drilled in top-of-the-line simulations at a variety of locations across the Sol system, MACOs are more than mere infantry, whose broad training and high mobility allow them to conduct operations in any environment.
tech_society_statecraft_956_desc: While the most obvious use of holodeck technology is recreational, it also carries significant military applications. Holodecks provide on-demand access to an effectively endless variety of intense, realistic training scenarios for students at our academy, such that a recently-minted ensign can have a quality and quantity of field experience on par with that of a seasoned officer.
tech_society_statecraft_961_desc: The Master Situation Monitor summarizes the huge amount of data monitored by a starship's computer into a single display for the ship's bridge officers. This streamlined system allows the commanders, engineers, and tactical officers to ascertain the most important variables affecting the vessel's performance quickly, allowing them to make informed decisions even in the chaos of battle.
tech_society_statecraft_964_desc: Advances in nanotechnology have allowed us to equip our mobile repair units with Nano-Repair Bots. They are able to repair and rebuild any damaged system on the molecular, and even atomic, level.
tech_society_statecraft_965_desc: Incorporating holodeck technology into our starship bridges means that we can adapt our interfaces to the needs of a situation, as well as the preferences and unique needs of their operators. Whether exploring, engaging in diplomacy, or in battle, our officers will always have exactly the resources they need at their fingertips.
tech_society_statecraft_972_desc: If we allow the formation of a civilian militia, it could help to ease the constant strain on our regular military officers, thereby letting them focus more on their training, enhancing their training speed.
tech_society_statecraft_973_desc: A combat salvo analysis that studied the effective use of photon torpedoes. The Neo-Wayne Model is considered to be more traditional than the Onafuwa model.
tech_society_statecraft_978_desc: The vast technological advances of the last century open up a whole new world of options for creative military commanders to outrun and outlast numerically superior opponents. We can analyse these tactical innovations and add them to the standard curriculum for our cadets, whether they are to be used to outmaneuver a larger opponent or merely to counter similar tactics by our opponents.
tech_society_statecraft_979_desc: Attracting, selecting, and appointing suitable candidates for our naval positions is of vital importance. Research into how best to retain and attract the best and brightest can ensure we can always recruit the best.
tech_society_statecraft_980_desc: The ability to locate optimal approach avenues allows for the consolidation of defenses to protect planetary bodies.
tech_society_statecraft_981_desc: Rather than teaching new warriors the dangerous and time-consuming nature of seeking out worthy prey, holographic representations can satiate the warriors' needs and teach valuable lessons.
tech_society_statecraft_983_desc: Detecting damage early and repairing it without needing to confirm with the Collective enables our vessels to undertake rapid repairs, even in the heat of battle.
tech_society_statecraft_984_desc: The Will of the Collective is the power to compel drones into action without regard to their wellbeing, safety, or health. This will enable an extremely efficient army of drones that will stop at nothing to complete their goal.
tech_society_statecraft_986_desc: By utilising neurolinked transceivers in each drone we can form networks utilising the processing power of each drone to problem solve. More drones increases the computational power available.
tech_society_statecraft_989_desc: Most of our efforts to keep drones functioning while their vessel is under attack have focused on repairing them or allowing them to function for longer without requiring regeneration. Although it will likely require proportionally more resources to achieve and enact, we should investigate ways of making drones more resistant to damage.
tech_society_statecraft_991_desc: Unifying the nation states on a planet's surface is an important task in bringing planetary governments into the fold. By researching ways to do this effectively, we can increase our sway over entire worlds.
tech_society_statecraft_992_desc: The violent stimuli and psychiatric processes associated with battle are so far beyond what any normal being goes through that specific psychological evaluations can be designed in order to ensure soldiers do not freeze up or panic during battle.
tech_society_statecraft_993_desc: Unifying planetary governments behind a centralised interstellar body is a difficult task, but researching ways that governance over planetary bodies can continue, whilst not crippling the empire with bureaucracy, is a vital task.
tech_society_statecraft_994_desc: The Central Command is the military authority of the Cardassian Union. Officially, it reports to the civilian Detapa Council, but unofficially, it rules the Cardassian Union.
tech_society_steam_515_desc: Our terraforming methods have allowed us to make great engineering strides on a specific type of building, making the hostile planets we conquer feel like the swirling magma pools of Tholia itself.
tech_society_stimulant_491_desc: Regimens of periodic cell revitalisation treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.
tech_society_tactical-optimal_399_desc: Our engineers continue to come up with more innovative starship bridge designs especially with the stations surrounding a starship bridge. One such design is more tactical in nature and better suited for possible combat encounters a starship may encounter during interstellar travel.
tech_society_talent_463_desc: Propaganda programs and subtle manipulation of economic records ensure talent rises to the top.
tech_society_targeted_473_desc: Stricter control of RNA and protein production on the cellular level.
tech_society_teaching_375_desc: A legendary Vulcan scientist, philosopher, and logician. He is the father of logical Vulcan as we know it. His teachings turned his people from war to science and philosophy, and would greatly benefit our society in the same manner.
tech_society_that_487_desc: Assorted societies have no qualms about enslaving members of their own race or others with the growth of interstellar contact. Some do it for martial conquest. Others, for profit.
tech_society_the_372_desc: No starship may interfere with the normal development of any alien life or society before they develop warp capabilities.
tech_society_the_380_desc: A Klingon legend speaks of the end of Kahless, the Unforgettable. He instructed his people at the time: 'You are Klingons. You need no one but yourselves. I will go now to Sto-vo-kor. But I promise one day I will return.'
tech_society_the_382_desc: Alar was a famous philosopher from Skorr. When alive, he led his people into space and brought a new era of peace. Before his death, his brain patterns were recorded and preserved in an indurite sculpture and is referred to as the 'Soul of Skorr'. By analysing the recording of this sculpture, we feel it could be the key to understanding how to reach new heights in developing our own colonies.
tech_society_the_476_desc: We believe we have finally perfected our genome mapping, and now we can apply these advances to create a genetic soldier with unprecedented strength.
tech_society_tholian_514_desc: Unlike most species, Tholians require a specific kind of atmosphere to survive long-term. So, if we wish to expand beyond our initial borders, then we must come up with terraforming practices that makes the planets we colonize suitable for us.
tech_society_transgenic_485_desc: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.
tech_society_undine_infiltration_desc: The Undine infiltrators have the ability to become their enemy before attacking, causing havoc and chaos.
tech_society_university_452_desc: By devoting our academies to specialised areas of research, we can better understand how to increase our output in these particular fields.
tech_society_ushaan_377_desc: The 'Code of the Ushaan' is a law regarding death-by-combat and legal instruments, governing the assorted ritual aspects of Andorian society.
tech_society_weather_500_desc: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can affect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.
tech_society_words_379_desc: The Bajoran religion is based on a reverence of aliens that live in a nearby wormhole. They make their will known through assorted orbs, codexes, and instructions to members of the Bajoran clergy.
tech_society_xenobiology_441_desc: Studying the life that arises on other worlds and beyond allows us to understand fundamental aspects of biology that were previously beyond our reach.
tech_society_xenobotany_482_desc: By learning the bio-genetic properties of edible plants, we can increase our food supplies to an even greater amount.
tech_society_zero-g_449_desc: Zero-G: the ability to achieve weightlessness. By applying our understanding of gravity, we can create a new module for our starbases that replicates this scientific marvel. In doing so, we are able to further study on chemicals and materials within an environment that could never have been done until now. If perfected, this will lead to sizable increases in the scope of what we can research.
tech_specialization_anti_desc: Our weapon technology has served us well. The development of new forms of firing mechanisms has given us a choice. Developments in covariant resistant phase modulators can be used as the lynchpin of new antiproton weapons. Alternatively, breakthroughs in industrial plasma compression and containment technology can be copied and adapted to create highly compressed proton cannons.
tech_specialization_diplomacy_desc: How we treat others will reflect on how they view us. Are alien races to be enslaved by our superiority, or can we deal with them as friends? This will allow us to choose the path our civilisation goes down.
tech_specialization_disruptor_desc: Our primary disruptor weapons are devastatingly effective. However, those who do not innovate are doomed to stagnate and fade into history. We should begin a search of our empire's labs and sensor records to find promising new technology that we can weaponize. The search will likely consume a significant amount of resources. We'll have to carefully choose which lead to follow.
tech_specialization_frontier_desc: Offering the thrill of adventure and incentives to those brave enough to take on the new frontiers of space allows for more resources to be given to this path.
tech_specialization_hull_desc: Through exploring space, we have seen many wondrous new materials that we never dreamed existed. Combining these discoveries with the latest technology, such as matter-energy manipulation, is leading to the biggest revolution in material science history. Soon, we will not be limited by what we can mine or smelt, but by how we tweak these materials to suit our needs, whatever we decide they are.
tech_specialization_phaser_desc: The invention of the phaser coil has driven a revolution in phaser engineering. As a result, independent research teams have created a few theoretically sound specifications for new types of phasers. Due to the highly specialised equipment that would need to be developed in order to apply each theory, we can only pursue one idea.
tech_specialization_plasma_cannon_desc: Plasma weapon technology has served us well. The development of new forms of firing mechanisms has given us a choice. Developments in covariant resistant phase discriminators can be used as the lynchpin of a new phased plasma weapon. Alternatively, breakthroughs in industrial plasma compression and containment technology can be copied and adapted to create highly compressed plasma weapons.
tech_specialization_plasma_torp_desc: With some of the difficulties of containing plasma now resolved, new technologies are emerging which can take our plasma-based explosives down certain paths. We can aim for a raw increased damage output or improving its effectiveness against shields.
tech_specialization_polaron_beam_desc: Combat strategists are becoming increasingly vocal about the weakness of relying on a single type of polaron weapon. If a countermeasure is found, our forces would become combat ineffective. Research departments have been working on new weapon designs and put forward some prototypes for our inspection.
tech_specialization_polaron_torpedo_desc: Polarons are a quasiparticle with an unexpected quality: they can partially penetrate shields. In the initial testing environment enriching the warheads with different subatomic particles results in different effects.
tech_specialization_quantum_torpedo_desc: The quantum torpedo utilises a zero-point energy reaction to create a large isoton explosion.
tech_specialization_shield_desc: In recent years we have begun running limited tests on prototypes of advanced new shield systems. It has been found that these designs have differing strengths and weaknesses, suited to different situations and combat doctrines. The final round of testing has begun and we will soon be required to make a final decision on which type of shielding to adopt.
tech_specialization_tetryon_desc: As technology advances and we develop new combat tactics, new weapons are required to fill specialist roles within our navy. Strategic commanders have devised specifications for a set of desired weapons. Limitations on our resources means that we'll only be able to pursue one of the final prototypes.
tech_specialization_thruster_desc: Despite the importance of a starships propulsion system, they have often received relatively little attention. Most improvements are simply iterations of existing designs. However, general advances in technology and a starships technical capability, mean that engineers are now developing prototypes of advanced engines. We will have to examine our needs and chose a complimentary design.
tech_specialization_torpedo_desc: Upgrades to manifold technology and launch technology have granted us two avenues to go down. Which should we specialise in?
tech_specialization_warp_desc: We now have several generations of warp drive behind us. We have learnt a great deal about how best to apply warp theory from these designs. Engineers have been trying to push the power and efficiency of our warp cores for decades, but have reached their limit. To gain more engine efficiency or main power output, we'll have to decide which one we want to prioritise and pursue designs accordingly.
tech_specialization_weapon_desc: Our weapons knowledge has proven fairly useless in this new era of interstellar exploration and conflict. The technological boom that warp travel wrought has given us more avenues of weapon technology to explore than we have the ability to investigate. We must merge all of our research, from prefire particle excitation chambers to exotic matter warheads, and decide which path to develop further.
tech_starbase_6_desc: Designed as the ultimate in Starbase design, this new base will become a castle and planet in the sky, providing the last line of defense for any home system. Many would now consider this facility as the true capital of our civilization.
tech_starfleet_aquarius_desc: As development progressed on the new Odyssey-class starships, Starfleet Command saw the need for variants of the class in order to fill the various roles fulfilled by Starfleet vessels. As such, the aft section of the Odyssey variants were converted into docking ports for Aquarius-class light escorts.
tech_starfleet_design_desc: The iconic saucer and twin-nacelle system are just some of the unique Starfleet Design Principles that ship design is based upon. Whilst some designs deviate from this, the core design remains the same as it has since the beginning.
tech_starfleet_society_desc: Rather than mothballing old vessels, we have aging veterans of Starfleet looking to set up the old vessels in working order, just in case we ever need them.
tech_supreme_genetics_undine_desc: Undine biology is unmatched in its power and dominance over anything that stands in its way, but even this biology needs improvement and the Undine genetic modification ability allows the Undine to perfect this.
tech_tanerian_plague_1_desc: The deadly Tanerian Plague, which appears to be manufactured rather than natural, can now be treated with new stimulants to slow down the disease.
tech_tanerian_plague_2_desc: A cure for the remaining population against the Tanerian Plague can now be developed. Utilising modified blood-gas infusers, we can also cure the remaining population with the plague.
tech_tb_dangerous_wildlife_desc: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.
tech_tb_deep_sinkhole_desc: Specialised aerosol construction stabilisers can be used to quickly and cleanly seal existing sinkholes as well as stabilise any subterranean hollows that may give rise to them.
tech_tb_dense_jungle_desc: Flash deforestation is, in and of itself, nothing revolutionary. Accomplishing it in a tightly controlled area on a strict schedule, however, is.
tech_tb_massive_glacier_desc: Flash-vaporisation engines quickly and efficiently erase glacial ice, at the expense of some increased heat and atmospheric humidity in the local area.
tech_tb_mountain_range_desc: Sometimes there is very little difference between terraformation and demolition.
tech_tb_noxious_swamp_desc: Focused drainage and detox efforts allow for the complete eradication of swampland.
tech_tb_quicksand_basin_desc: Introducing hydrogels engineered for stabilisation allows for near-instantaneous solidification of quicksand basins.
tech_tb_toxic_kelp_desc: Specialised drones can mechanically clear vast swaths of toxic kelp with minimal use of biocides.
tech_tb_volcano_desc: Tectonic stabilisation techniques allow for the pacification of active volcanoes.
tech_terraforming_base_1_desc: There are many planets out there that could be habitable if we are able to somehow modify the planet to suit our livable needs.
tech_terraforming_base_2_desc: Humidity regulators and chemical dispersal units are the first step towards a fundamentally altered atmosphere.
tech_terraforming_base_3_desc: As we continue to advance our terraforming techniques, we can now come up with even greater methods to terraform the most hazardous areas of a planet.
tech_tetryon_cannon_1_desc: Rapid-fire cannons that fire pulses of tetryon particles. Tetryons are native to subspace; once extruded into normal space they become unstable, making them useful as a weapon. A high rate of fire compensates for a lack of accuracy.
tech_titanium_hull_desc: Titanium is a strong, ductile, low-density, lightweight metal that is quite reflective. With these impressive qualities, titanium is a good material to make our ship hulls from until we inevitably find a better material.
tech_transwarp_borg_desc: Most species are still exploring the capabilities of warp drives. We, however, have discovered a new layer of subspace that might allow travel at greatly increased speeds. 'Transwarp Space', as we have called it, does not follow the same topology as normal space. Modifying our warp drives to tunnel into transwarp space is the first step in exploring the shortcuts around the galaxy that it offers.
tech_transwarp_test_desc: Test Only - should not be seen
tech_undine_aura_1_desc: This field serves as an adaptive shield, employing regenerative properties to fortify their ships against the rigours of spacefaring. Through manipulating quantum-level biological processes, the Undine forge an enduring defence, a testament to their mastery of the life forces that permeate the cosmos.
tech_undine_aura_2_desc: Through advanced manipulation of quantum-level biological processes, we forge an indomitable defence. This resilient field regenerates with amplified speed and fortitude, protecting our ships with invincible vigour against the myriad challenges lurking in the depths of space.
tech_undine_bio_ship_desc: The universe of non-fluidic space is alien to us, and our vessels require adaptation to be able to survive in the absence of fluid.
tech_undine_coordination_desc: Bio field coordination allows our vessels to synchronise quantum-level emissions, creating a unified front that amplifies the defensive attributes of their adaptive shields. Through intricate manipulation of bio fields, we elevate our survival capabilities, weaving a resilient protective web across our fleet.
tech_undine_defense_1_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_2_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_3_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_4_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_5_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_6_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_7_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_8_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_9_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_defense_desc: A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creates a powerful defensive field.
tech_undine_hull_desc: Grown in fluidic space and hardened against the dangers of a non-fluidic universe.
tech_undine_reactor_1_desc: Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production.
tech_undine_reactor_2_desc: Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production. This energy is then amplified using the psychic power of the Undine mind.
tech_undine_reactor_3_desc: Specially mixed concentrations of fluidic matter and bio-matter generates powerful waves of energy that can be used to power Undine Technology.
tech_undine_reactor_pk_desc: Mass detonation of biomass is harnest by the powerful minds of Undine engineers and directed towards powering their most powerful vessels.
tech_undine_thruster_2_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_3_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_4_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_5_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_6_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_7_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_8_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_thruster_desc: Using chemical processes produced naturally by the bioships Undine vessels are able to prepel themselves along at sub warp speeds.
tech_undine_torpedo_1_desc: Compacting Bio Matter and enfusing with mutualistic bacteria creates an explosive on-par with anti-matter.
tech_undine_torpedo_2_desc: Pre-charged Bio Matter thats been enfused with mutualistic bacteria creates an further instabilities with the torpedo and a higher weapon yield.
tech_undine_torpedo_3_desc: Increasing the density of the Bio Mass before infusing creates a purer form of the torpedo, which in turn adds to the damage radius.
tech_undine_torpedo_4_desc: Offsetting the phase modulation of the Bio Mass generates mltiple instabilities within the detonation sequence this subsequently results in superior damage.
tech_undine_torpedo_5_desc: Adding a multi-phase modulation to the Bio Mass generates mltiple instabilities within the detonation sequence this subsequently results in superior damage and range.
tech_undine_torpedo_6_desc: Enriched Chroniton particles infused with raw Bio Matter cause extreme devastation.
tech_undine_tracking_1_desc: Utilising the inherent bio-ship connection to the surrounding space, the Undine tap into their telepathic mastery to create specially created tracking nodes.
tech_undine_tracking_2_desc: Further development to the inherent bio-ship connection to the surrounding space, the Undine tap into their telepathic mastery to create specially created tracking nodes.
tech_undine_tracking_3_desc: Maximising the the inherent bio-ship connection to the surrounding space, the Undine tap into their telepathic mastery to create the most tuned tracking nodes possible.
tech_undine_warp_desc: Breaching the barrier into the cold dimension of non fluidic space requires quantum singularities to be utilised to power a bio warp drive, propelling vessels throughout this dark wasteland.
tech_warp_engine_desc: An early warp drive that uses common linear warp nacelles to generate a warp field that propels a vessel faster than light.
tech_weapon_mod_spec_desc: The vast interstellar distances and speeds that warp age combat can occur over require an entirely new design of research and weapons.
tech_weapon_slot_size_spec_desc: Specialising in weaponry allows for unique properties on our weapons. This branch focuses on miniaturising our weaponry.
tech_xahean_dilithium_desc: The Xaheans have productionised their Dilithium Incubator, which will provide a positive boost to our Dilithium production by recrystallising dilithium.
tech_xcv330_1_desc: Originally built as a Starliner, a manned interstellar probe from the United Earth Space Probe Agency, as one of Earth's earliest attempts at interstellar travel. It was the only class to reach its destination of Alpha Centauri before being phased out.
tech_ynorian_pox_1_desc: The horrific contagious pustules that form and rupture upon the skin of a humanoid infected with the Ynorian Pox often lead to massive transmission rates, along with infection and death. New radical treatments could treat the symptoms and stop the spread.
tech_ynorian_pox_2_desc: A vaccine to immunise the remaining population against the Ynorian Pox can now be developed. Utilising dermal regenerators and laser scalpels, we can also cure the remaining population with the pox.
